AI.conclusion: 结论:上下文学习提供了半自动生成可持续采购目录的可行路径,在可解释性、可追溯性与结构一致性上足以支撑政府决策支持,但当前输出尚不足以完全替代专家水平,需在政策采纳前进行生成后专家审阅;LLM-as-a-Judge 可承担结构有效性、一致性、表层依据的自动化预筛以降低专家工作量,但因过度泛化与弱监管锚定等失效模式,必须采用"自动筛 + 定向专家复核"的分阶段人机协同流程。局限与权衡:质量受参考文档覆盖度与具体性制约(指南稀疏领域仅形式正确而缺乏可操作细节);为抗瞬时 API 失败与结构违规采用固定重试预算的有界多轮生成,以引入受控非确定性、延迟与成本为代价换取鲁棒性与模式合规;存在"看似合理但依据薄弱""跨 GGS 过度泛化""抱负层级间重复冗余"等失效模式;source-of-truth 约束降低但未消除幻觉引用风险;现依赖高能力闭源模型(长上下文、指令遵循、结构化输出稳定性),开源替代需额外调优或后处理。用户研究进一步指出:模型倾向于改写/概括而非逐字引用源文,削弱可追溯性与法律精确性并带来大量后编辑负担;生成结果不完整(AA 更少、标准缺失、抱负层级遗漏),偶发虚构数值阈值与抱负层级;多文档处理支持有限。改进方向:严格逐字抽取模式与显式来源溯源、文档章节到 SPC 列的预定义结构映射、更有效的 RAG 设计、多文档支持、基于维度的细粒度评估框架、引入 agentic 框架让模型论证并迭代修正、扩展至缺乏官方指南的行业、以及借助非官方/预标准化来源发现新兴可持续标准。作者将 SwissSPC 定位为决策支持系统而非自主采购工具。

title: Session Risk Memory (SRM): Temporal Authorization for Deterministic Pre-Execution Safety Gates
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Companion paper to arXiv:2603.13247. Benchmark dataset and artifacts available on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.15410944
summary: Deterministic pre-execution safety gates evaluate whether individual agent actions are compatible with their assigned roles. While effective at per-action authorization, these systems are structurally blind to distributed attacks that decompose harmful intent across multiple individually-compliant steps. This paper introduces Session Risk Memory (SRM), a lightweight deterministic module that extends stateless execution gates with trajectory-level authorization. SRM maintains a compact semantic centroid representing the evolving behavioral profile of an agent session and accumulates a risk signal through exponential moving average over baseline-subtracted gate outputs. It operates on the same semantic vector representation as the underlying gate, requiring no additional model components, training, or probabilistic inference. We evaluate SRM on a multi-turn benchmark of 80 sessions containing slow-burn exfiltration, gradual privilege escalation, and compliance drift scenarios. Results show that ILION+SRM achieves F1 = 1.0000 with 0% false positive rate, compared to stateless ILION at F1 = 0.9756 with 5% FPR, while maintaining 100% detection rate for both systems. Critically, SRM eliminates all false positives with a per-turn overhead under 250 microseconds. The framework introduces a conceptual distinction between spatial authorization consistency (evaluated per action) and temporal authorization consistency (evaluated over trajectory), providing a principled basis for session-level safety in agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"会话风险记忆"(SRM)——一个轻量级确定性模块，将无状态的逐动作安全门扩展为轨迹级(会话级)授权。SRM在门控输出的同一语义向量表示上维护紧凑语义质心,并对基线减去的门控输出做指数移动平均累积风险信号,无需额外模型、训练或概率推断。在含80个多轮会话(慢速渗漏、渐进权限提升、合规漂移)的基准上,ILION+SRM取得F1=1.0000、误报率0%(无状态ILION为F1=0.9756、5% FPR),两者检出率均为100%,每轮额外开销低于250微秒。
AI.motivation: 现有确定性"执行前安全门"(pre-execution safety gate)仅判断单个动作是否符合其被分配的角色,在逐动作授权上有效,但在结构上对"分布式攻击"具有盲区:恶意意图被分解为多个各自合规的步骤,逐步通过检查。这属于结构性盲点而非检测能力不足,因此需要一种不破坏确定性、低开销、且能与现有门控无缝结合的会话级风险机制。
AI.method: 核心方法是在无状态执行门之外并联一个会话级风险累积模块:(1)维护会话演化行为画像的紧凑语义质心(semantic centroid),基于门控所用的同一语义向量表示,不引入额外模型组件;(2)对门控输出做基线减除(去除正常/合规基线)后,通过指数移动平均(EMA)累积风险信号,刻画跨步骤的风险趋势;(3)以确定性阈值判定会话是否越权,从而把"分布式攻击"的多步证据汇聚为单次轨迹级判定。整个流程无训练、无概率推断,额外开销每轮低于250微秒。论文同时提出概念区分:空间授权一致性(spatial authorization consistency,逐动作评估)与时间授权一致性(temporal authorization consistency,轨迹上评估)。
AI.result: 在80会话的多轮基准(涵盖慢速渗漏exfiltration、渐进权限提升、合规漂移三类场景)上:ILION+SRM 的F1=1.0000、误报率0%、检出率100%,相比之下无状态ILION的F1=0.9756、误报率5%、检出率同为100%。即SRM在保持检出率不变的前提下完全消除了误报,单轮额外延迟<250微秒。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明:在语义向量空间中引入会话级的确定性风险记忆,可在不牺牲检出率、不引入模型或训练成本的前提下把安全门从逐动作授权提升为轨迹级授权,显著降低误报。论文主张"空间授权一致性"与"时间授权一致性"的概念二分,为智能体系统中的会话级安全提供了原则性基础。需注意的边界:评测规模较小(80会话)、三类攻击模式由基准合成,零误报结论依赖基线减除与EMA阈值的标定,跨域泛化与阈值鲁棒性仍待更大规模与真实轨迹验证。

title: CN-Buzz2Portfolio: A Chinese-Market Dataset and Benchmark for LLM-Based Macro and Sector Asset Allocation from Daily Trending Financial News
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly transitioning from static Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks including sentiment analysis and event extraction to acting as dynamic decision-making agents in complex financial environments. However, the evolution of LLMs into autonomous financial agents faces a significant dilemma in evaluation paradigms. Direct live trading is irreproducible and prone to outcome bias by confounding luck with skill, whereas existing static benchmarks are often confined to entity-level stock picking and ignore broader market attention. To facilitate the rigorous analysis of these challenges, we introduce CN-Buzz2Portfolio, a reproducible benchmark grounded in the Chinese market that maps daily trending news to macro and sector asset allocation. Spanning a rolling horizon from 2024 to mid-2025, our dataset simulates a realistic public attention stream, requiring agents to distill investment logic from high-exposure narratives instead of pre-filtered entity news. We propose a Tri-Stage CPA Agent Workflow involving Compression, Perception, and Allocation to evaluate LLMs on broad asset classes such as Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) rather than individual stocks, thereby reducing idiosyncratic volatility. Extensive experiments on nine LLMs reveal significant disparities in how models translate macro-level narratives into portfolio weights. This work provides new insights into the alignment between general reasoning and financial decision-making, and all data, codes, and experiments are released to promote sustainable financial agent research.

AI.tldr: 提出了CN-Buzz2Portfolio基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在动态金融市场中的决策能力，通过新闻驱动的方式测试模型将宏观叙事转化为资产配置的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM金融Agent评估面临两难困境：直接实盘交易不可复现且存在结果偏差，而现有静态基准仅限于个股选择，忽略更广泛的市场注意力。需要一个可复现的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建了基于中国市场的CN-Buzz2Portfolio基准，将每日热门新闻映射到宏观和行业资产配置；提出Tri-Stage CPA Agent Workflow（Compression压缩、Perception感知、Allocation配置），在ETF而非个股层面评估模型。
AI.result: 对9个LLM的实验表明，模型在将宏观叙事转化为投资组合权重方面存在显著差异，揭示了通用推理与金融决策之间对齐程度的不同。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为通用推理能力与金融决策能力的对齐提供了新见解，所有数据和代码已开源，以推动可持续的金融Agent研究。

title: A Theoretical Framework for Energy-Aware Gradient Pruning in Federated Learning
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Federated Learning (FL) is constrained by the communication and energy limitations of decentralized edge devices. While gradient sparsification via Top-K magnitude pruning effectively reduces the communication payload, it remains inherently energy-agnostic. It assumes all parameter updates incur identical downstream transmission and memory-update costs, ignoring hardware realities. We formalize the pruning process as an energy-constrained projection problem that accounts for the hardware-level disparities between memory-intensive and compute-efficient operations during the post-backpropagation phase. We propose Cost-Weighted Magnitude Pruning (CWMP), a selection rule that prioritizes parameter updates based on their magnitude relative to their physical cost. We demonstrate that CWMP is the optimal greedy solution to this constrained projection and provide a probabilistic analysis of its global energy efficiency. Numerical results on a non-IID CIFAR-10 benchmark show that CWMP consistently establishes a superior performance-energy Pareto frontier compared to the Top-K baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑能量成本的新型梯度稀疏化方法CWMP，用于联邦学习场景。与传统的Top-K剪枝不同，CWMP根据参数更新的幅度与物理能耗的相对关系进行选择，在非IID CIFAR-10数据集上实现了更优的性能-能耗权衡帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习受限于边缘设备的通信和能源约束。现有Top-K幅度剪枝虽能有效压缩通信负载，但本质上是能耗无关的——假设所有参数更新具有相同成本，忽视了硬件层面的现实差异。实际上，不同操作（内存密集型与计算高效型）在后向传播阶段的能耗差异显著。
AI.method: 将剪枝过程形式化为能量约束投影问题，提出Cost-Weighted Magnitude Pruning (CWMP)选择规则。该方法基于参数更新的幅度与其物理能耗的相对比值进行优先级排序。理论上证明了CWMP是该约束投影问题的最优贪心解，并提供了全局能耗效率的概率分析。
AI.result: 在非IID CIFAR-10基准测试中，CWMP相比Top-K基线方法，在性能-能耗权衡上始终建立更优的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: CWMP通过引入硬件感知能量模型到梯度稀疏化中，为资源受限的边缘联邦学习提供了一种高效且实用的解决方案。

title: LLMON: An LLM-native Markup Language to Leverage Structure and Semantics at the LLM Interface
summary:
Textual Large Language Models (LLMs) provide a simple and familiar interface: a string of text is used for both input and output. However, the information conveyed to an LLM often has a richer structure and semantics, which is not conveyed in a string. For example, most prompts contain both instructions ("Summarize this paper into a paragraph") and data (the paper to summarize), but these are usually not distinguished when passed to the model. This can lead to model confusion and security risks, such as prompt injection attacks.
  This work addresses this shortcoming by introducing an LLM-native mark-up language, LLMON (LLM Object Notation, pronounced "Lemon"), that enables the structure and semantic metadata of the text to be communicated in a natural way to an LLM. This information can then be used during model training, model prompting, and inference implementation, leading to improvements in model accuracy, safety, and security. This is analogous to how programming language types can be used for many purposes, such as static checking, code generation, dynamic checking, and IDE highlighting.
  We discuss the general design requirements of an LLM-native markup language, introduce the LLMON markup language and show how it meets these design requirements, describe how the information contained in a LLMON artifact can benefit model training and inference implementation, and provide some preliminary empirical evidence of its value for both of these use cases. We also discuss broader issues and research opportunities that are enabled with an LLM-native approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向LLM的标记语言LLMON（LLM Object Notation），用于在文本中嵌入结构化和语义元数据，从而改善模型训练、提示工程和推理实现，提升准确性、安全性和隐私性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM使用纯文本作为输入输出接口，但实际信息往往具有更丰富的结构和语义（如指令与数据的区分），这些信息在字符串形式中未被传达，导致模型混淆和安全风险（如提示注入攻击）。
AI.method: 设计了LLMON标记语言，明确区分文本中的不同成分（如指令、数据、元数据），使LLM能够以自然方式理解文本结构，并将其用于训练、提示和推理阶段。
AI.result: 提供了初步的实验证据，表明LLMON在模型训练和推理实现两个应用场景中均具有价值，并讨论了该方法在更广泛领域的潜在研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 类比编程语言中的类型系统，LLMON可服务于多种目的（静态检查、代码生成、动态检查、IDE高亮等），为LLM-native方法开辟了新的研究机会，有望提升模型的准确性、安全性和隐私性。

title: STEM Agent: A Self-Adapting, Tool-Enabled, Extensible Architecture for Multi-Protocol AI Agent Systems
summary: Current AI agent frameworks commit early to a single interaction protocol, a fixed tool integration strategy, and static user models, limiting their deployment across diverse interaction paradigms. To address these constraints, we introduce STEM Agent (Self-adapting, Tool-enabled, Extensible, Multi-agent), a modular architecture inspired by biological pluripotency in which an undifferentiated agent core differentiates into specialized protocol handlers, tool bindings, and memory subsystems that compose into a fully functioning AI system. The framework unifies five interoperability protocols (A2A, AG-UI, A2UI, UCP, and AP2) behind a single gateway, introduces a Caller Profiler that continuously learns user preferences across more than twenty behavioral dimensions, externalizes all domain capabilities through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and implements a biologically inspired skills acquisition system in which recurring interaction patterns crystallize into reusable agent skills through a maturation lifecycle analogous to cell differentiation. Complementing these capabilities, the memory system incorporates consolidation mechanisms, including episodic pruning, semantic deduplication, and pattern extraction, designed for sub-linear growth under sustained interaction. A comprehensive 413-test suite validates protocol handler behavior and component integration across all five architectural layers, completing in under three seconds.

AI.tldr: STEM Agent是一种模块化AI智能体架构，灵感来自生物多能性，可根据任务动态分化为专业化的协议处理器、工具绑定和记忆子系统。该框架统一了五种互操作协议，并引入用户偏好学习系统和生物启发的技能获取机制。
AI.motivation: 当前AI智能体框架过早锁定单一交互协议、固定工具集成策略和静态用户模型，限制了其在多样化交互范式中的部署能力。
AI.method: 提出STEM Agent架构：(1) 通过单一网关统一A2A、AG-UI、A2UI、UCP、AP2五种互操作协议；(2) 开发Caller Profiler跨20+行为维度持续学习用户偏好；(3) 通过MCP外部化领域能力；(4) 实现类似细胞分化的技能获取系统；(5) 记忆系统包含情景修剪、语义去重和模式提取等巩固机制。
AI.result: 413项测试用例验证了所有五个架构层的协议处理器行为和组件集成，测试在3秒内完成。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过生物启发的模块化设计实现了智能体的自适应性和可扩展性，为跨多种交互范式的部署提供了可行方案。

title: Full waveform inversion method based on diffusion model
summary:
Seismic full-waveform inversion is a core technology for obtaining high-resolution subsurface model parameters. However, its highly nonlinear characteristics and strong dependence on the initial model often lead to the inversion process getting trapped in local minima. In recent years, generative diffusion models have provided a way to regularize full-waveform inversion by learning implicit prior distributions. However, existing methods mostly use unconditional diffusion processes, ignoring the inherent physical coupling relationship between velocity and density and other physical properties. This paper proposes a full-waveform inversion method based on conditional diffusion model regularization. By improving the backbone network structure of the diffusion model, two-dimensional density information is introduced as a conditional input into the U-Net network. Experimental results show that the full-waveform inversion method based on the conditional diffusion model significantly improves the resolution and structural fidelity of the inversion results, and exhibits stronger stability and robustness when dealing with complex situations. This method effectively utilizes density information to constrain the inversion and has good practical application value.
  Keywords: Deep learning; Diffusion model; Full waveform inversion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于条件扩散模型正则化的地震全波形反演（FWI）方法：通过改造扩散模型U-Net骨干网络，将二维密度信息作为条件输入融入去噪过程，从而在先验约束之外显式引入速度与密度的物理耦合关系，显著提升反演结果的分辨率、结构保真度以及在复杂场景下的稳定性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 全波形反演（FWI）是获取地下高分辨率介质参数的核心技术，但其高度非线性问题以及对初始模型的强依赖使反演过程极易陷入局部极小值。多年来，生成式扩散模型通过学习隐式先验分布为FWI提供了有效的正则化手段。然而现有方法多采用无条件扩散过程，忽略了速度、密度等物理属性之间固有的物理耦合关系，导致反演结果在复杂介质中稳定性不足、结构失真。
AI.method: 提出基于条件扩散模型正则化的FWI框架。核心改进在于扩散模型的骨干网络结构：将U-Net网络的输入由单一的速度（波形/初始模型）扩展为加入二维密度信息，使密度作为条件信号参与迭代去噪过程，与扩散模型学到的隐式先验共同约束反演，从而在数据拟合项之外同时满足速度—密度等物性之间的物理耦合约束。训练阶段学习噪声调度下的去噪映射，反演阶段以观测地震记录为数据项引导、以条件扩散先验为正则项进行迭代更新。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与基于无条件扩散模型的FWI方法相比，本文方法显著提高了反演结果的空间分辨率与结构保真度；在处理复杂构造、噪声干扰或初始模型质量较差等复杂情形时，表现出更强的稳定性与鲁棒性，较好地复原了地下介质的细节特征与物性耦合关系。
AI.conclusion: 条件扩散模型正则化的全波形反演方法能有效利用密度信息对反演过程进行物理约束，抑制局部极小值与伪影，在提升分辨率和结构保真度方面优势明显，具备良好的工程实用性；同时说明将物性耦合关系显式注入扩散先验是提升生成式FWI反演质量的有效途径。

title: On the Economic Implications of Diversity in Software Engineering
summary: This paper investigates how software professionals perceive the economic implications of diversity in software engineering teams. Motivated by a gap in software engineering research, which has largely emphasized socio-technical and process-related outcomes, we adopted a qualitative interview approach to capture practitioners' reasoning about diversity in relation to economic and market-oriented considerations. Based on interviews with ten software professionals, our analysis indicates that diversity is perceived as economically relevant through its associations with cost reduction and containment, revenue generation, time to market, process efficiency, innovation, and market alignment. Participants typically grounded these perceptions in concrete project experiences rather than abstract economic reasoning, framing diversity as a practical resource that supports project delivery, competitiveness, and organizational viability. Our findings provide preliminary empirical insights into how economic aspects of diversity are understood in software engineering practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过访谈10名软件专业人员，探索了软件工程团队中多样性（diversity）的经济影响感知。研究发现从业者从成本、收入、市场速度、流程效率、创新和市场契合六个维度理解多样性的经济价值，且多基于具体项目经验而非抽象经济理论。
AI.motivation: 软件工程研究领域存在明显缺口：现有研究主要关注多样性的社会技术层面和过程相关结果，缺乏对经济影响的深入探讨。
AI.method: 采用定性访谈方法，访谈对象为10名软件专业人员，旨在捕捉从业者对多样性经济价值的实际理解和推理过程。
AI.result: 分析揭示多样性通过六个维度被认为具有经济相关性：成本降低与控制、收入生成、上市时间、流程效率、创新能力、市场契合度。参与者通常基于具体项目经验而非抽象经济推理来支撑这些认知，将多样性视为支持项目交付、竞争力和组织可持续发展的实践资源。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为软件工程实践中多样性经济层面的理解提供了初步实证依据，表明经济视角在团队多样性研究中值得更多关注。

title: From Static Templates to Dynamic Runtime Graphs: A Survey of Workflow Optimization for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based systems are becoming increasingly popular for solving tasks by constructing executable workflows that interleave LLM calls, information retrieval, tool use, code execution, memory updates, and verification. This survey reviews recent methods for designing and optimizing such workflows, which we treat as agentic computation graphs (ACGs). We organize the literature based on when workflow structure is determined, where structure refers to which components or agents are present, how they depend on each other, and how information flows between them. This lens distinguishes static methods, which fix a reusable workflow scaffold before deployment, from dynamic methods, which select, generate, or revise the workflow for a particular run before or during execution. We further organize prior work along three dimensions: when structure is determined, what part of the workflow is optimized, and which evaluation signals guide optimization (e.g., task metrics, verifier signals, preferences, or trace-derived feedback). We also distinguish reusable workflow templates, run-specific realized graphs, and execution traces, separating reusable design choices from the structures actually deployed in a given run and from realized runtime behavior. Finally, we outline a structure-aware evaluation perspective that complements downstream task metrics with graph-level properties, execution cost, robustness, and structural variation across inputs. Our goal is to provide a clear vocabulary, a unified framework for positioning new methods, a more comparable view of existing body of literature, and a more reproducible evaluation standard for future work in workflow optimizations for LLM agents.

AI.tldr:
本文是一篇综述（survey），提出"代理计算图（Agentic Computation Graph, ACG）"作为统一抽象，把LLM智能体的工作流优化研究组织为一套清晰词汇与分类体系：按"结构何时确定"区分静态模板优化与动态运行时图优化，并用图确定时间（GDT）与图可塑性模式（GPM）刻画灰区，同时严格区分可复用模板、单次运行的实现图与执行轨迹三条不同优化对象；进一步从优化目标、证据来源、更新机制三轴交叉综合文献，并提出面向结构的评估/最小报告协议。

主要内容包括：
1. 概念框架：ACG模板 Ḡ=(V,E,Φ,Σ,A)、实现图 G^run、执行轨迹 τ=(s_t,a_t,o_t,c_t) 三个定义；节点可写作 ⟨Instruction, Context, Tools, Model/Decoding⟩；给出统一质量–成本优化形式 max E[R(τ;x) − λC(τ)]，并区分节点级/图级/联合优化。
2. 分类维度：静态（GDT=offline, GPM=none）代表方法 AFlow（MCTS搜索类型化算子图）、ADAS（元搜索可运行代码）、A²Flow（学习算子库+搜索）、MASS（拓扑与提示交替优化）、Maestro（图文反馈交替图/配置更新）、SEW（文本工作流自进化）、VFlow（MCTS+协同进化+硬件多级验证）、MermaidFlow（受约束Mermaid IR）、可微分通信图学习等；节点级代表 DSPy、OPRO、EvoPrompt、CAPO、GEPA、Optima。动态三类：预执行选择/剪枝（Adaptive Graph Pruning、DAGP、AgentDropout、DyLAN、MasRouter、SkillOrchestra）；预执行生成（Assemble Your Crew、G-Designer、图扩散拓扑、MaAS、ScoreFlow、FlowReasoner、Workflow-R1、AutoFlow、WorkflowLLM、RobustFlow、ComfyUI-R1、AutoAgents）；执行中编辑（DyFlow、AgentConductor、Aime、AOrchestra、MetaGen、ProAgent、Flow、EvoFlow、DebFlow、QualityFlow）。
3. 反馈信号分类：标量指标驱动、验证器驱动（硬约束/中间检查点/稠密奖励）、偏好/排序信号、轨迹衍生文本反馈，并总结"信号—算法"匹配规律（搜索需可信评估器+离散结构化动作空间，RL 适合真序列式生成，偏好学习适合噪声奖励，文本反馈需外部验证器兜底）。
4. 评估与报告：整理27项评估资源（工作流生成基准 WorFBench/FlowBench、训练语料与可执行验证器、交互式工具基准 GAIA/τ-bench/τ²-bench/MCP 系列、软件与运维环境 SWE-bench/Terminal-Bench 等），提出十维度最小报告协议（表示形式、结构设置、模型与工具配置、离线优化成本、在线推理成本、轨迹统计、图级指标、鲁棒性测试、随机性与评测协议、失败分析），并区分"结构感知评估"与"下游任务验证"。

证据基础：编译77篇在范围内的工作（39篇core、7篇adjacent、31篇background）与27项评估资源，覆盖arXiv预印本、顶会/研讨会论文、开源框架与基准数据集，并按core/adjacent/background三类打标签。

结论：工作流结构应从实现细节提升为一等设计对象；实际设计中应按负载异质性选择最小必要可塑性——静态模板在算子空间受约束、评估器可信且负载重复时往往更优；异质性主要体现在难度/通信预算差异时选"选择/剪枝"更划算；需真正不同分解结构时用"预执行生成"；环境交互强、需应对工具失败与运行时不确定时用"执行中编辑"；并须配套预算护栏、停止规则与回退机制。论文同时指出节点级提示优化无法替代缺失的结构能力（缺验证器、冗余通信、错误控制流），并列出结构信用分配、表达力与可验证性张力、工具漂移下的持续适应、数据/基准质量、面向工作流优化的理论等开放问题。
AI.motivation: LLM系统已从单轮对话演化为包含LLM调用、检索、工具使用、代码执行、记忆更新与验证的可执行工作流。实践表明，最终效果不仅取决于单次模型调用的质量，更取决于工作流的整体结构——即包含哪些组件/智能体、彼此如何依赖、信息如何流动。而现有研究中，图的构建通常被隐含地写死在代码、通信模式或planner–executor循环中，从未被当作一等优化对象来搜索、生成、编辑或评估；结构改进（如加验证器、剪冗余通信、改层级结构、按运行生成工作流）往往伴随隐藏的结构成本（过深、脆弱控制流、高通信开销）。已有综述分别聚焦agent系统与编排框架、规划、工具学习、多智能体协作、广义智能体优化等相邻切片，均未以工作流结构本身为中心。同时，文献普遍存在概念混乱：可复用模板、单次运行实际结构、真实运行行为被混为一谈；"静态/动态"边界含混；不同方法的表示形式、反馈信号与成本处理各异，难以横向比较与复现。
AI.method: 综述方法论：以"工作流结构"为一等优化对象提出统一抽象ACG（节点为原子动作，图为控制/数据/通信依赖）。核心操作化手段：(1) 三个形式化定义——ACG模板 Ḡ=(V,E,Φ,Σ,A)（节点集、有向边、节点参数、调度/路由策略、可容许激活与编辑动作）、实现图 G^run（给定输入x与运行时状态实际部署的结构）、执行轨迹 τ={(s_t,a_t,o_t,c_t)}；(2) 两个轻量描述符——图确定时间GDT（offline / pre-execution / in-execution）与图可塑性模式GPM（none / select / generate / edit），用于澄清灰区（离线训练但推理时生成新图的工作流生成器归为动态；固定超图上的推理期剪枝亦为动态）；(3) 统一质量–成本目标 max E_x[E_G^run|x[E_τ[R(τ;x)−λC(τ)]]，据此区分节点级（优化Φ）、图级（优化E,Σ,A）与联合优化；(4) 三轴交叉综合：优化目标、证据来源（metric/verifier/preference/trace/proxy/supervision）、更新机制（search/generator/controller/RL/supervised/preference/repair/continuous relaxation/hybrid）；(5) 统一的"分类卡"表格范式记录设置、层级、表示、反馈、更新、成本处理六个字段，并规定多信号时报告主导项以保证表内一致；(6) 证据库构建：按纳入标准编译77篇工作（39 core、7 adjacent、31 background）与27项评估资源（20基准/环境、7数据集/语料/验证器），覆盖arXiv预印本、ML/NLP会议与研讨会、开源框架；(7) 评估框架：区分结构感知评估与下游任务验证，提出十维度最小报告协议与鲁棒性测试（释义不变性、工具故障注入、检索噪声、API漂移、未见工具、严格预算上限）。
AI.result: 1) 综述给出了统一词汇与分类体系：静态（GDT=offline, GPM=none）、动态预执行生成/选择（GDT=pre-execution, GPM=select/generate）、动态执行中编辑（GDT=in-execution, GPM=edit）三档，以及core/adjacent/background三个范围标签，并通过"模板—实现图—轨迹"三元分离厘清了文献差异。2) 归纳出三条核心经验规律：(a) 搜索质量往往受限于表示与评估器而非优化器本身——类型化算子图、代码脚手架、受约束图IR之所以重要在于其为搜索提供有效归纳偏置与廉价校验（可执行性、schema合规、可综合性），算子词汇表质量常与搜索算法同等重要；(b) 节点级提示优化（DSPy、OPRO、EvoPrompt、CAPO、GEPA）虽见效快、成本低，但会掩盖拓扑缺陷，使糟糕脚手架显得有竞争力，同时抬高成本、削弱鲁棒性，是必要基线而非充分解释；(c) 提示与拓扑应相互引导而非争夺credit（MASS、Maestro），缺验证/冗余通信/控制流错误应做图级优化，可靠启发式是"先看trace再优化提示"。3) 动态方法形成"选择→生成→编辑"的可塑性谱系：选择继承超图有效性、易约束调试但表达力受限；生成表达力更强但空间更大、信用分配更难、有效性依赖更强；编辑最灵活但对有效性校验、停止策略、预算控制压力最大，须配套token/工具调用/墙钟时间的硬护栏、置信度停止规则、失败回退与重复状态检测。4) 验证器价值在"便宜且语义有意义"时最大（单测、schema检查、可执行性、可综合性）；置于高成本语义验证器于每个小步骤前会显著增延迟而无实质收益，且弱验证器会奖励脆弱hack。5) 评估侧结论：在多数文献中工作流结构在方法开发时被当作一等对象，却在评估时被当作隐式实现细节；仅报告最终任务成功率无法区分"找到更好结构"与"多花了算力"或"隐性重试在起作用"。最小报告协议（表示形式、结构设置、模型工具配置、离线优化成本、在线推理成本与cost-per-success、轨迹统计、图级指标如节点数/深度/宽度/通信量/编辑次数/结构方差、鲁棒性测试、随机性与规范化规则、失败分析）被提出以提升可比性与复现性。6) 识别出五个开放问题：结构信用分配（增益来自新边、新验证器、角色提示还是更多算力）、表达力与可验证性的张力（约束IR提升可执行性与可复现性但可能排除动态工作流的关键解）、工具与环境漂移下的持续适应（极少论文报告适应效率）、工作流数据与基准质量（泄漏答案、参考工作流不一致、评估器奖励hack会直接被优化利用）、以及缺乏"何时静态足够、何时动态必要、样本复杂度如何随可塑性伸缩"的理论。
AI.conclusion: 工作流结构应从实现细节提升为一等设计对象，其对能力、成本、可靠性与科学可比性有直接影响。核心分类学是静态（部署前固定可复用模板）与动态（推理期按输入或运行时反馈实例化、选择或修改结构），并以GDT与GPM精化以澄清灰区；文献中基于指标搜索、验证器引导、偏好学习与轨迹文本反馈的方法，都可统一理解为在改进局部策略、结构或两者。设计上应按负载所需的最小结构可塑性选择方法：算子空间受约束、评估器可信、负载重复时静态模板往往更优；异质性主要体现为难度/通信预算差异时优先运行时选择或剪枝；需要真正不同的分解与通信模式时用预执行生成；环境交互强、需在工具失败与运行时不确定下存活时才用执行中编辑，且必须配套预算护栏、停止规则与回退机制。评估上应同时报告"用了什么工作流、如何随样本变化、为此付出多少成本"，把结构感知评估与下游任务验证分开进行，从而让工作流优化研究具备可复现、可比较的评价标准。综述同时提供了可定位新方法的统一框架与清晰词汇表，但作为综述本身，其结论属跨论文经验规律而非普适定律，定量结论仍受限于原始文献的基准与评测异质性。

title: UniFluids: Unified Neural Operator Learning with Conditional Flow-matching
summary: Partial differential equation (PDE) simulation holds extensive significance in scientific research. Currently, the integration of deep neural networks to learn solution operators of PDEs has introduced great potential. In this paper, we present UniFluids, a conditional flow-matching framework that harnesses the scalability of diffusion Transformer to unify learning of solution operators across diverse PDEs with varying dimensionality and physical variables. Unlike the autoregressive PDE foundation models, UniFluids adopts flow-matching to achieve parallel sequence generation, making it the first such approach for unified operator learning. Specifically, the introduction of a unified four-dimensional spatiotemporal representation for the heterogeneous PDE datasets enables joint training and conditional encoding. Furthermore, we find the effective dimension of the PDE dataset is much lower than its patch dimension. We thus employ $x$-prediction in the flow-matching operator learning, which is verified to significantly improve prediction accuracy. We conduct a large-scale evaluation of UniFluids on several PDE datasets covering spatial dimensions 1D, 2D and 3D. Experimental results show that UniFluids achieves strong prediction accuracy and demonstrates good scalability and cross-scenario generalization capability. The code will be released later.

AI.tldr: UniFluids是一个条件流匹配框架，利用扩散Transformer的可扩展性，统一学习不同维度和物理变量的偏微分方程(PDE)解算子，是首个用于统一算子学习的流匹配方法。通过统一的四维时空表示和x-prediction策略，实现了并行序列生成，在1D/2D/3D PDE数据集上展现出强预测准确性和跨场景泛化能力。
AI.motivation: PDE模拟在科学研究中具有重要意义。现有深度学习方法在处理不同维度、物理变量的PDE时存在局限性，需要一个统一的框架来学习跨多样PDE的解算子。此外，自回归式PDE基础模型存在生成效率问题。
AI.method: (1) 采用条件流匹配(Conditional Flow Matching)框架实现并行序列生成；(2) 利用扩散Transformer的可扩展性；(3) 引入统一的四维时空表示(3D空间+1D时间)处理异构PDE数据集，实现联合训练和条件编码；(4) 发现PDE数据集的有效维度远低于其patch维度，采用x-prediction策略提升预测精度。
AI.result: 在大规模1D/2D/3D PDE数据集上验证，UniFluids取得了强预测精度，并展现出良好的可扩展性和跨场景泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: UniFluids是首个基于流匹配的统一算子学习方法，通过四维时空表示和x-prediction策略有效解决了异构PDE数据的联合训练问题，在保证精度的同时实现了高效的并行生成。

title: A Study of Scientific Computational Notebook Quality
summary: The quality of scientific code is a critical concern for the research community. Poorly written code can result in irreproducible results, incorrect findings, and slower scientific progress. In this study, we evaluate scientific code quality across three dimensions: reproducibility, readability, and reusability. We curated a corpus of 518 code repositories by analyzing Code Availability statements from all 1239 Nature publications in 2024. To assess code quality, we employed multiple methods, including manual attempts to reproduce Jupyter notebooks, documentation reviews, and analyses of code clones and mutation patterns. Our results reveal major challenges in scientific code quality. Of the 19 notebooks we attempted to execute, only two were reproducible, primarily due to missing data files and dependency issues. Code duplication was also common, with 326 clone classes of at least 10 lines and three instances found among 637 of the 1510 notebooks in our corpus. These duplications frequently involved tasks such as visualization, data processing, and statistical analysis. Moreover, our mutation analysis showed that scientific notebooks often exhibit tangled state changes, complicating comprehension and reasoning. The prevalence of these issues -- unreproducible code, widespread duplication, and tangled state management -- underscores the need for improved tools and abstractions to help science build reproducible, readable and reusable software.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析Nature 2024年发表的1239篇论文中的代码可用性声明，筛选出518个代码仓库，并从可重现性、可读性和可重用性三个维度评估科学代码质量。研究发现科学代码质量存在严重问题：在19个尝试执行的Jupyter笔记本中仅有2个可完全重现，主要障碍为缺失数据文件和依赖问题；代码克隆现象普遍，发现326个至少10行的克隆类；变异分析显示科学笔记本常呈现纠缠的状态变化。
AI.motivation: 科学代码质量是研究社区的关键关切。低质量代码可能导致结果不可重现、错误发现和科学进展减速。然而，目前缺乏对科学代码质量的系统性实证评估。
AI.method: 研究团队：1) 解析2024年1239篇Nature出版物的代码可用性声明，筛选出518个代码仓库；2) 采用多种评估方法：手动执行Jupyter笔记本、文档审查、代码克隆分析和变异模式分析。
AI.result: 核心发现：1) 可重现性极低——19个笔记本中仅2个可重现，主要原因是数据文件缺失和依赖问题；2) 代码重复普遍——发现326个至少10行的克隆类，在637个/1510个笔记本中发现3个实例；3) 状态管理混乱——科学笔记本常呈现纠缠的状态变化，增加理解和推理难度。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了科学代码质量的严峻现状：不可重现的代码、广泛的重复和混乱的状态管理。这表明亟需改进的工具和抽象来帮助科学界构建可重现、可读和可重用的软件。

title: Computational Arbitrage in AI Model Markets
summary: Consider a market of competing model providers selling query access to models with varying costs and capabilities. Customers submit problem instances and are willing to pay up to a budget for a verifiable solution. An arbitrageur efficiently allocates inference budget across providers to undercut the market, thus creating a competitive offering with no model-development risk. In this work, we initiate the study of arbitrage in AI model markets, empirically demonstrating the viability of arbitrage and illustrating its economic consequences. We conduct an in-depth case study of SWE-bench GitHub issue resolution using two representative models, GPT-5 mini and DeepSeek v3.2. In this verifiable domain, simple arbitrage strategies generate net profit margins of up to 40%. Robust arbitrage strategies that generalize across different domains remain profitable. Distillation further creates strong arbitrage opportunities, potentially at the expense of the teacher model's revenue. Multiple competing arbitrageurs drive down consumer prices, reducing the marginal revenue of model providers. At the same time, arbitrage reduces market segmentation and facilitates market entry for smaller model providers by enabling earlier revenue capture. Our results suggest that arbitrage can be a powerful force in AI model markets with implications for model development, distillation, and deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI模型市场中的套利现象。研究者发现，套利者通过跨提供商分配推理预算来获取利润，在SWE-bench验证任务中可实现高达40%的净利润率。竞争性套利会压低消费价格、减少模型提供商的边际收入，但同时也能减少市场分割并帮助小型提供商更早获得收入。蒸馏技术进一步放大了套利机会，可能以牺牲教师模型收入为代价。
AI.motivation: 随着AI模型市场的发展，不同提供商销售不同成本和能力的大模型，用户愿意为可验证的解决方案支付预算。套利者可以通过跨提供商分配推理预算来低于市场价提供解决方案，从而创造无模型开发风险的竞争产品。本文旨在首次系统研究AI模型市场中的套利现象。
AI.method: 研究者进行了深入的案例研究，使用两个代表性模型（GPT-5 mini和DeepSeek v3.2）在SWE-bench GitHub问题解决任务上测试。设计并评估了简单套利策略和鲁棒套利策略，研究了蒸馏对套利机会的影响，分析了多个竞争套利者对市场价格的影响。
AI.result: 简单套利策略可实现高达40%的净利润率；鲁棒套利策略在不同领域均可保持盈利；蒸馏技术创造了更强劲的套利机会；多个竞争套利者会降低消费者价格，减少模型提供商的边际收入。
AI.conclusion: 套利可能是AI模型市场中的一股强大力量，对模型开发、蒸馏和部署都具有重要影响。套利虽然会压缩提供商利润，但也能促进市场效率、减少市场分割并帮助小型提供商进入市场。

title: A Multi-Modal CNN-LSTM Framework with Multi-Head Attention and Focal Loss for Real-Time Elderly Fall Detection
summary: The increasing global aging population has intensified the demand for reliable health monitoring systems, particularly those capable of detecting critical events such as falls among elderly individuals. Traditional fall detection approaches relying on single-modality acceleration data suffer from high false alarm rates, while conventional machine learning methods require extensive hand-crafted feature engineering. This paper proposes a novel multi-modal deep learning framework, MultiModalFallDetector, designed for real-time elderly fall detection using wearable sensors. Our approach integrates multiple innovations: a multi-scale CNN-based feature extractor capturing motion dynamics at varying temporal resolutions; fusion of tri-axial accelerometer, gyroscope, and four-channel physiological signals; incorporation of a multi-head self-attention mechanism for dynamic temporal weighting; adoption of Focal Loss to mitigate severe class imbalance; introduction of an auxiliary activity classification task for regularization; and implementation of transfer learning from UCI HAR to SisFall dataset. Extensive experiments on the SisFall dataset, which includes real-world simulated fall trials from elderly participants (aged 60-85), demonstrate that our framework achieves an F1-score of 98. 7, Recall of 98. 9, and AUC-ROC of 99. 4, significantly outperforming baseline methods including traditional machine learning and standard deep learning approaches. The model maintains sub- 50ms inference latency on edge devices, confirming its suitability for real-time deployment in geriatric care settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MultiModalFallDetector框架，利用可穿戴传感器多模态数据（加速度计、陀螺仪、生理信号）实现老年人跌倒实时检测，通过多尺度CNN特征提取、多头自注意力机制、Focal Loss和迁移学习等技术，在SisFall数据集上达到F1 98.7%、Recall 98.9%、AUC-ROC 99.4%的优异性能，推理延迟低于50ms。
AI.motivation: 全球老龄化加剧，老年人跌倒检测需求迫切。传统单模态加速度检测方法误报率高，传统机器学习方法依赖人工特征工程，泛化能力有限。
AI.method: MultiModalFallDetector框架：多尺度CNN提取不同时间分辨率的运动特征；融合三轴加速度计、陀螺仪和四通道生理信号；多头自注意力机制实现动态时序加权；Focal Loss解决类别不平衡；辅助活动分类任务正则化；UCI HAR到SisFall的迁移学习。
AI.result: 在包含60-85岁老年人真实模拟跌倒试验的SisFall数据集上，F1-score 98.7%、Recall 98.9%、AUC-ROC 99.4%，显著优于传统机器学习和标准深度学习基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 模型在边缘设备上推理延迟低于50ms，具备实时部署能力，适用于老年护理场景。

title: The Evolution of Tool Use in LLM Agents: From Single-Tool Call to Multi-Tool Orchestration
summary: Tool use enables large language models (LLMs) to access external information, invoke software systems, and act in digital environments beyond what can be solved from model parameters alone. Early research mainly studied whether a model could select and execute a correct single tool call. As agent systems evolve, however, the central problem has shifted from isolated invocation to multi-tool orchestration over long trajectories with intermediate state, execution feedback, changing environments, and practical constraints such as safety, cost, and verifiability. We comprehensively review recent progress in multi-tool LLM agents and analyzes the state of the art in this rapidly developing area. First, we unify task formulations and distinguish single-call tool use from long-horizon orchestration. Then, we organize the literature around six core dimensions: inference-time planning and execution, training and trajectory construction, safety and control, efficiency under resource constraints, capability completeness in open environments, and benchmark design and evaluation. We further summarize representative applications in software engineering, enterprise workflows, graphical user interfaces, and mobile systems. Finally, we discuss major challenges and outline future directions for building reliable, scalable, and verifiable multi-tool agents.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于大语言模型智能体「多工具编排」（multi-tool orchestration）研究的系统性综述论文，核心主线是：LLM 工具使用的研究重心已从「单次工具调用是否正确」转移到「长时程、多工具、含中间状态与执行反馈的编排链能否端到端可执行且鲁棒」。论文统一了任务形式化定义，围绕推理期规划与执行、训练与轨迹构造、安全与控制、资源约束下的效率、开放环境下的能力完备性、基准设计与评测六个维度梳理文献，并总结了软件工程、企业工作流、GUI、移动系统四类应用，最后提出面向可靠、可扩展、可验证智能体的研究议程。作者来自哈尔滨工业大学、哈佛大学与华为。
AI.motivation: 工具使用使 LLM 能突破静态参数知识的局限，建立「感知—行动」闭环，早期工作（TALM、MRKL、Toolformer、ReAct）聚焦于单意图识别与 API 格式正确性。但真实任务需要跨长轨迹协调多工具、保持中间状态、从失败中恢复，并受延迟、成本、安全、可验证性约束，单点调用正确性已不足以刻画问题。作者指出两个缺口：概念层面，tool use / tool calling / tool retrieval / workflow execution / orchestration 被混用而对应不同能力层级；结构层面，规划、训练、安全、效率、基准、开放环境适配被割裂研究，而实际部署系统依赖这些维度的相互作用。因此本文以「多工具编排」而非泛化的「工具使用」或「智能体」为分析单元。
AI.method: 综述方法：（1）问题形式化——定义多工具学习实例（任务 q、隐状态 s_t 与观测 o_t 的交互环境、带 schema 的工具集合 D、执行接口 Exec(d,u;s)→(f,s')、策略 π_θ、内部记忆 m_t）、动作空间（含 Finish(y) 终止动作）、交互历史 h_t 与轨迹 τ 的递推定义，以及带成本正则项的目标 max E[R_task − λ·Cost(τ)]，以此区分单次调用与长时程编排。（2）沿六个耦合维度组织文献：推理期范式（拓扑化规划/图结构执行、状态空间搜索与回滚、长时程系统级编排与记忆、反思与自我改进）、训练范式（免训练方法、轨迹数据合成、SFT、RL）、安全（并行执行风险与长链风险）、效率（延迟与成本预算）、完备性（能力边界感知—自主工具扩展—开放环境适应）、基准与评测（拓扑复杂度、时间尺度、环境动态性、状态持久与自纠错）。（3）应用侧提出统一抽象：执行环境、编排拓扑、闭环控制（plan-act-observe-revise）、运行约束（可靠性/安全/成本权衡）。（4）用表 1 汇总风险-失效模式-防御映射，表 2 按四维度与环境类型（静态数据集/交互式模拟器/人类双控/真实 OS-Web）分类 40 余个长时程基准及其工具数与实例数。
AI.result: 1) 形式化层面：给出含隐状态、工具执行接口、记忆更新与成本感知的统一数学框架，明确区分单点调用与长时程多工具编排两类问题。2) 推理期：ReAct 的线性轨迹在嵌套调用、并行 I/O、长程目标上存在结构性错配，研究已转向依赖图/AND-OR 分解、层级委派（HIPLAN、ADaPT、AFlow、D-PoT、DyFlow、ReCAP）、带回滚与分支隔离的搜索（Smurfs、AB-MCTS、ARTIS、Plan-and-Act、MPO、AgentPro），并走向双系统式分工（MARS、CodeTool）、程序性记忆（DeepAgent、MACLA、HiAgent）与语义路由调度（HuggingGPT、Gradientsys、Tool-to-Agent Retrieval）；记忆侧有 COMPASS/Acon 摘要、A-Mem、MIRIX、SEDM。3) 自我改进：Reflexion、Failure Makes the Agent Stronger、SPIRAL、PreFlect、SAGE、Plan2Evolve 等自纠错，MetaAgent、Test-Time Tool Evolution、DRAFT、SWE-Adept 等能力演化与工具自造。4) 训练：免训练侧有 ToolLLM、AnyTool、ToolDreamer、MCP-Zero、Re-Invoke、PLAY2PROMPT、Memento、GenTool；数据合成呈「合成—验证—扩展」范式（Seal-Tools、BUTTON、ASTRA、APIGen、StableToolBench、ToolACE-DEV/R、ToolMind、LoopTool、OrchDAG）；SFT 从语法对齐演进到工具选择、依赖规划与多任务分解（Gorilla、GPT4Tools、ToolLLM DFS、Hammer 的 Function Masking、Chain-of-Abstraction、ToolGen、Granite）；RL 侧覆盖奖励与信用分配（PORTool、Tool-Star、ToolRL、ToolRM、可验证回合级奖励）、策略优化（DeepAgent 的 ToolPO 与细粒度优势归因、GTPO、ARPO、RAGEN 的 StarPO）与端到端框架（ToRL、Agent-R1）。5) 安全：将风险分为并行执行（竞态、部分提交、执行后异常、记忆/计划投毒、长程漂移）与长链（Agent Drift、跨工具状态污染、MINJA 类记忆投毒、Plan Injection、蝴蝶效应），防御沿「执行前静态约束（AARM、AgentSpec、Self-Verification Sampling）—执行中事务管理（SagaLLM、Atomix、Generator-Assistant 局部检查点）—执行后动态验证（CRITIC、VerifiAgent、DVR）」演进，并配合轨迹级验证、LATS 回滚、AgentDoG 根因归因、记忆整合与红队对抗微调。6) 效率：延迟优化三条路线——并行执行（SoT、LLMCompiler、M1-Parallel、规划-执行重叠）、异步解耦（规划与执行解耦、集中式记忆同步、MACI、Incalmo、Temac 的 Planner-Actor）、推测执行（ReWOO、基于前瞻的 LATS/ToT、REST、DSPy 编译级流水线）；成本侧为动态工具检索（ToolLLM 神经 API 检索、AnyTool 层级目录树、ToolkenGPT 词表压缩）、自适应模型路由（FrugalGPT、RouteLLM、SwiftSage）、缓存与记忆（Reflexion 语言化强化、MemGPT 虚拟内存分页、GPTCache 语义缓存）。7) 完备性：边界感知（FAIL-TALMS、ToolHaystack；AskToAct 主动澄清、主动终止对抗「行动强迫」）、自主工具扩展（LATM、CREATOR、RestGPT、ToolMaker、代码解释器作元工具）、开放环境适应（Voyager 技能库、ExpeL 经验学习、ToolkenGPT 即插即用、AppWorld 交互记忆）。8) 评测：从 API-Bank/MetaTool/ToolBench 的单点功能验证演进到拓扑复杂度（NESTFUL、ToolHop、TRAJECT-Bench、ELT-Bench 等）、时间尺度（Tool Decathlon 平均 20 轮、ShortcutsBench、HammerBench 1 万实例、AgentLongBench 达 400 万 token、UltraHorizon 平均 400+ 次调用/200K+ token、TRIP-Bench 150+ 次调用、DeepPlanning）、环境动态性（ToolSandbox、AppWorld、ToolGym、StableToolBench、τ-bench/τ²-bench 双控、OSWorld、Windows Agent Arena、Mobile-Bench、RealWebAssist、VitaBench）、状态持久与自纠错（ToolSandbox、AppWorld、M³-Bench、τ²-bench、T1、WildToolBench、Toolcomp、ComplexFuncBench）。基准证据显示：随轨迹长度与全局约束增加性能急剧退化；τ²-bench 双控设定下先进模型相对单智能体下降超过 40%。9) 应用侧统一抽象与四大领域约束分析：GUI 的视觉 grounding 与界面漂移（UGround 等）、软件工程的高测试验证成本与企业的事务一致性与合规审计、移动端的破坏性误操作需确认点与保守恢复；工程要点包括工具治理与虚拟化回归、标准化协议与可审计语义契约、外置策略层防间接提示注入、对齐 OWASP Top 10 与 NIST 指南的最小权限/环境隔离/全日志、中间检查点与过程级可观测性、接口压缩与预算感知路由的质量-时延-成本联合优化。
AI.conclusion: 结论认为：工具使用的发展反映了从孤立函数调用到与复杂外部系统持续交互的范式转变；一旦需要长时程多工具协调，问题就不再只是提示或 API 格式，而涉及依赖下的规划、可变状态管理、执行控制，以及在不确定性、延迟与安全约束下保持正确性。六个维度紧密耦合——规划与状态管理、可验证性相互影响，安全依赖执行控制与隔离，效率依赖分解、路由与复用。因此进展不仅依赖更强基座模型，也依赖记忆、编排、验证与基准设计。展望方向包括：更完善的有状态编排抽象、面向动态与超长时程的更强评测协议、模型级推理与系统级保证的深度整合；应用侧需可演化的工具治理、可验证闭环执行与自适应编排，以把原型推进为可信赖、可审计、可扩展的生产系统，并解决接口演化导致的行为漂移、长时程过程级可验证性与可重放审计、成本-时延-质量联合优化、以及以可组合、抗对抗的恢复框架取代启发式失败恢复等问题。

title: Maximum Entropy Relaxation of Multi-Way Cardinality Constraints for Synthetic Population Generation
summary: Generating synthetic populations from aggregate statistics is a core component of microsimulation, agent-based modeling, policy analysis, and privacy-preserving data release. Beyond classical census marginals, many applications require matching heterogeneous unary, binary, and ternary constraints derived from surveys, expert knowledge, or automatically extracted descriptions. Constructing populations that satisfy such multi-way constraints simultaneously poses a significant computational challenge. We consider populations where each individual is described by categorical attributes and the target is a collection of global frequency constraints over attribute combinations. Exact formulations scale poorly as the number and arity of constraints increase, especially when the constraints are numerous and overlapping. Grounded in methods from statistical physics, we propose a maximum-entropy relaxation of this problem. Multi-way cardinality constraints are matched in expectation rather than exactly, yielding an exponential-family distribution over complete population assignments and a convex optimization problem over Lagrange multipliers. We evaluate the approach on NPORS-derived scaling benchmarks with 4 to 40 attributes and compare it primarily against generalized raking. The results show that MaxEnt becomes increasingly advantageous as the number of attributes and ternary interactions grows, while raking remains competitive on smaller, lower-arity instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于最大熵松弛的合成人口生成方法，通过在期望意义上匹配多路基数约束，将组合优化问题转化为指数族分布的凸优化问题，在高维高阶约束场景下优于传统raking方法。
AI.motivation: 在微观模拟、基于智能体的建模和政策分析中，从汇总统计生成合成人口是一个核心挑战。当需要同时满足多元（unary、binary、ternary）异构约束时，精确方法在约束数量和元数增加时计算性能急剧下降。
AI.method: 将多路基数约束匹配放松为"在期望意义上匹配"，将原问题转化为指数族分布上的凸优化问题，通过拉格朗日乘子法求解。
AI.result: 在NPORS衍生的基准测试（4-40个属性）上，MaxEnt方法在属性数量和三元交互增长时优势明显；raking方法在低维低阶约束实例上仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 最大熵松弛为合成人口生成中的多路约束匹配问题提供了可扩展的替代方案，尤其适用于高维高阶约束场景。

title: Enhancing AI-Based Tropical Cyclone Track and Intensity Forecasting via Systematic Bias Correction
summary: Tropical cyclones (TCs) pose severe threats to life, infrastructure, and economies in tropical and subtropical regions, underscoring the critical need for accurate and timely forecasts of both track and intensity. Recent advances in AI-based weather forecasting have shown promise in improving TC track forecasts. However, these systems are typically trained on coarse-resolution reanalysis data (e.g., ERA5 at 0.25 degree), which constrains predicted TC positions to a fixed grid and introduces significant discretization errors. Moreover, intensity forecasting remains limited especially for strong TCs by the smoothing effect of coarse meteorological fields and the use of regression losses that bias predictions toward conditional means. To address these limitations, we propose BaguanCyclone, a novel, unified framework that integrates two key innovations: (1) a probabilistic center refinement module that models the continuous spatial distribution of TC centers, enabling finer track precision; and (2) a region-aware intensity forecasting module that leverages high-resolution internal representations within dynamically defined sub-grid zones around the TC core to better capture localized extremes. Evaluated on the global IBTrACS dataset across six major TC basins, our system consistently outperforms both operational numerical weather prediction (NWP) models and most AI-based baselines, delivering a substantial enhancement in forecast accuracy. Remarkably, BaguanCyclone excels in navigating meteorological complexities, consistently delivering accurate forecasts for re-intensification, sweeping arcs, twin cyclones, and meandering events. Our code is available at https://github.com/DAMO-DI-ML/Baguan-cyclone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架 BaguanCyclone，在全球气象基础模型（Baguan）之上做系统性的偏差校正，用于热带气旋（TC）路径与强度预报。其核心洞察是：现有 AI 气象模型因仅在粗分辨率 ERA5（0.25°）上训练，路径预报被"网格锁定"、强度预报被平滑和回归损失拉向条件均值。方法包含两个模块：(1) 概率中心精化模块——先用运动学外推+引导流得到先验位置，再将中心映射为截断高斯概率密度场，以 KL 散度训练深度模型预测密度，最后用期望解码得到任意精度的连续经纬度，从而实现亚网格定位；(2) 区域感知强度预报模块——基于 Swin Transformer 的 patch merging 将输入切分为围绕台风核心的动态子网格分区，对每个分区预测最大风速，推理时用精化后的中心位置索引提取对应强度。实验基于 IBTrACS（2000–2024）覆盖六大洋盆，评估时用 Baguan 预报场模拟业务条件。相对 AI 基线平均路径误差降低 16%、强度误差降低 34%（NI 洋盆路径>30%、强度约 50%），WP 洋盆强度在所有时效上优于 ECMWF HRES 平均 12.23%。系统已在浙江气象局业务化运行，2025 西北太平洋台风季平均路径误差 85.61 km、强度误差 6.20 m/s（较次优模型强度误差下降 50%），并在台风"竹节草"（Co-May）中支撑 9.7 万人转移。
AI.motivation: （1）AI 气象大模型（GFM）在台风路径上已超越业务 NWP，但强度预报是其“阿喀琉斯之踵”：系统性地低估峰值风速，甚至不如简单统计基线（Huang et al., 2025）。（2）作者认为根因是数据中心的：这些模型只使用 0.25° ERA5 再分析训练，台风中心被量化到固定网格（grid-locking），引入相对台风移动尺度不可忽略的离散化误差；ERA5 的网格平均特性抹平了台风核心的强梯度与局地极值。（3）此外 MSE/MAE 回归损失天然使预测偏向条件均值，削弱对快速增强/衰减等极值事件的表现。（4）已有专用深度模型（ConvLSTM、VQLTI、Deep-Hurricane-Tracker）多为孤立系统，无法利用 GFM 的大尺度表征能力。因此需要一种机制感知、可直接作用于粗分辨率 AI 预报输出的“精化/偏差校正层”，把研究级模型提升到业务级精度。
AI.method: 整体架构（Fig.2）由两个模块在推理阶段双流耦合。（A）概率中心精化模块三阶段：①运动学初始化——多步程序化跟踪器结合 ECMWF 引导流做运动学外推得候选位置，在逐步收缩的包围盒内迭代搜索最近气压极小值，得到物理一致的 (x̂_c, ŷ_c)；②概率密度映射——在 H×W 窗口内以截断高斯核 g̃_ij = exp(−d_ij²/2σ²)（d_ij ≤ r，否则 0）把离散中心转为连续密度场并归一化为 w_ij；③神经校正与重建——把密度场作为辅助通道与多层大气状态特征拼接，经网络输出密度 Ŵ 并用 softmax 保持 ΣŴ_ij = 1，以 L_KL = D_KL(W_gt || Ŵ) 优化，最后沿空间轴取期望重建连续经纬度，实现亚网格定位；同时提供可校准的不确定性（高熵与快速转向、登陆等困难场景相关）。（B）区域感知强度预报模块：基于 patch merging 的 Swin Transformer 将输入划分为多个子网格分区并逐区预测最大风速；分区尺度依据 2000–2023 年 IBTrACS 各洋盆台风间最小距离统计（WP/EP 3.37°、NI 16.37°、SI 4.70°、SP 5.92°），设定分区尺寸小于该最小距离的 1/3，输入 V×H×W 经 N 个 patch merging 后变为 H/(2^N·p) × W/(2^N·p)。（C）联合推理：精化模块给出台风眼坐标，作为空间查询索引强度分区图，定位到包含中心的分区并取其强度值作为最终强度预报，使位置与局地结构保持一致。数据与评测：真值用 IBTrACS 最佳路径；训练特征为 ERA5（Z/T/U/V/W/Q @500/700/850 hPa，加 2m 温度/露点、10m 风、MSL、SP、TCW/TCVW），评估时改用 Baguan 预报场以模拟业务条件；NI、SP 训练 2000–2022、评估 2023–2024，其余洋盆训练 2000–2023、评估 2024；路径误差用 Haversine 大圆距离（km），强度误差用最大风速绝对误差（m/s）；基线为 ECMWF HRES、Vanilla Baguan、Pangu-Weather、GraphCast。
AI.result: （1）数据诊断（Tab.1）：0.25° ERA5 与 0.1° EC Analysis 在 6 小时尺度上路径距离差异较小（WP 45.3 vs 56.9 km，NA 32.7 vs 48.1 km），但风速差异达 ~20%（WP 7.74 vs 5.69 m/s，NA 11.53 vs 8.87 m/s），直接说明粗分辨率是强度预报瓶颈。（2）路径：BaguanCyclone 在六洋盆全面优于 AI 基线，平均误差下降 16%；WP 相对 Vanilla Baguan 在 24 h 降 16.14%、72 h 降 11.3%；NI 降幅超 30%；多数时效超过 HRES 基准。（3）强度：相对 AI 基线平均误差下降 34%，NI 洋盆约 50%；WP 洋盆在所有时效优于 HRES，平均优势 12.23%。（4）消融（Tab.3）：概率形式在 WP/NA 各指标上普遍优于直接回归残差形式（如 WP 24 h 53.0 vs 60.7 km，48 h 91.5 vs 101.1 km，72 h 147.9 vs 158.4 km），且提供校准的不确定性。（5）耦合消融（Tab.4）：在 SI 洋盆使用精化路径做强度后验估计，多数时效强度误差改善（+0.89%~+3.74%），气压误差改善幅度较小且 72 h 为 -0.55%，说明耦合定位能减少因路径偏移导致的强度偏差。（6）个例：Beryl（大弧线/急增强/再登陆）、Pulasan（登陆减弱后黄海再增强）、Trami 与 Kong-rey（双台风、Trami 登陆后 180° 转向）、Shanshan（弱引导下蜿蜒停滞及近 90° 偏转）均能刻画相应机制。（7）业务化：2025 西北太平洋台风季在浙江气象局实时运行，平均路径误差 85.61 km（领先多数在役 AI 模型），强度误差 6.20 m/s（较次优模型下降约 50%）；台风 Co-May 预报支撑 97,000 人转移。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是把“AI 台风预报精度不足”归结为数据分辨率与回归损失两个数据中心问题，并以系统性的概率化偏差校正加以解决：把离散网格上的点估计转为连续概率密度场并用 KL 对齐与期望解码，同时把强度估计锚定在风暴中心的局地子网格环境上，从而同时缓解路径离散化误差与核心强度低估，且不依赖更高分辨率输入。相对 GFM 基线取得 16% 路径、34% 强度的整体提升，并实现机制层面的泛化（引导流控制、陆海能量收支转换、弱/相互作用下的非线性竞争），已在浙江气象局实现业务化实时预报，标志深度学习在高风险气象业务中的可落地性。局限在于仍需 0.1° 量级数据才能解析更细结构、模型具备黑箱性质；未来将引入更高分辨率数据并探索可解释的物理驱动因素。代码开源于 GitHub（DAMO-DI-ML/Baguan-cyclone）。

title: AI Mental Models: Learned Intuition and Deliberation in a Bounded Neural Architecture
summary: This paper asks whether a bounded neural architecture can exhibit a meaningful division of labor between intuition and deliberation on a classic 64-item syllogistic reasoning benchmark. More broadly, the benchmark is relevant to ongoing debates about world models and multi-stage reasoning in AI. It provides a controlled setting for testing whether a learned system can develop structured internal computation rather than only one-shot associative prediction. Experiment 1 evaluates a direct neural baseline for predicting full 9-way human response distributions under 5-fold cross-validation. Experiment 2 introduces a bounded dual-path architecture with separate intuition and deliberation pathways, motivated by computational mental-model theory (Khemlani & Johnson-Laird, 2022). Under cross-validation, bounded intuition reaches an aggregate correlation of r = 0.7272, whereas bounded deliberation reaches r = 0.8152, and the deliberation advantage is significant across folds (p = 0.0101). The largest held-out gains occur for NVC, Eca, and Oca, suggesting improved handling of rejection responses and c-a conclusions. A canonical 80:20 interpretability run and a five-seed stability sweep further indicate that the deliberation pathway develops sparse, differentiated internal structure, including an Oac-leaning state, a dominant workhorse state, and several weakly used or unused states whose exact indices vary across runs. These findings are consistent with reasoning-like internal organization under bounded conditions, while stopping short of any claim that the model reproduces full sequential processes of model construction, counterexample search, and conclusion revision.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨有限神经架构能否在64项三段论推理基准上展现直觉与深思的分工。实验1评估直接神经基线预测9类人类反应的分布；实验2引入有限双路径架构（直觉与深思通路）。结果：深思通路相关性（r=0.8152）显著优于直觉通路（r=0.7272），在NVC、Eca、Oca题目类型上提升最大。可解释性分析显示深思通路发展出稀疏、分化的内部结构，包括Oac偏态、主工作态及多个弱使用/未使用态。
AI.motivation: 当前AI领域关于世界模型和多阶段推理的争论中，需要一个受控环境来测试学习系统是否能发展出结构化内部计算，而非仅进行一次性联想预测。研究旨在探索有限条件下神经架构是否能模拟人类认知中的直觉-深思分工机制。
AI.method: 采用5折交叉验证设计。实验1使用直接神经基线预测完整9分类人类响应分布。实验2设计有限双路径架构，分离直觉与深思通路，基于计算心理模型理论（Khemlani & Johnson-Laird, 2022）。通过80:20训练测试分割的典型可解释性运行和五种子稳定性扫描进行验证。
AI.result: 深思通路（r=0.8152）显著优于直觉通路（r=0.7272），差异在各折均显著（p=0.0101）。最大提升出现在NVC、Eca、Oca类型题目，表明对拒绝响应和c-a结论的处理改善。注意力模式分析显示深思通路发展出稀疏、分化的内部结构：包括Oac偏态、主工作态、多个弱使用或未使用态（确切索引在不同运行间有差异）。
AI.conclusion: 在有限条件下，模型发展出与推理一致的内部组织，但作者明确声明不声称该模型复现了模型构建、反例搜索和结论修订的完整顺序过程。该研究为测试神经架构是否超越一次性联想预测提供了受控基准。

title: Emergency Preemption Without Online Exploration: A Decision Transformer Approach
summary: Emergency vehicle (EV) response time is a critical determinant of survival outcomes, yet deployed signal preemption strategies remain reactive and uncontrollable. We propose a return-conditioned framework for emergency corridor optimization based on the Decision Transformer (DT). By casting corridor optimization as offline, return-conditioned sequence modeling, our approach (1) eliminates online environment interaction during policy learning, (2) enables dispatch-level urgency control through a single target-return scalar, and (3) extends to multi-agent settings via a Multi-Agent Decision Transformer (MADT) with graph attention for spatial coordination. On the LightSim simulator, DT reduces average EV travel time by 37.7% relative to fixed-timing preemption on a 4x4 grid (88.6 s vs. 142.3 s), achieving the lowest civilian delay (11.3 s/veh) and fewest EV stops (1.2) among all methods, including online RL baselines that require environment interaction. MADT further improves on larger grids, overtaking DT with 45.2% reduction on 8x8 via graph-attention coordination. Return conditioning produces a smooth dispatch interface: varying the target return from 100 to -400 trades EV travel time (72.4-138.2 s) against civilian delay (16.8-5.4 s/veh), requiring no retraining. A Constrained DT extension adds explicit civilian disruption budgets as a second control knob.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于决策变换器(DT)的紧急车辆走廊优化框架，将信号优先控制建模为离线、回报条件化的序列建模问题，消除了在线环境交互需求。MADT通过图注意力机制扩展至多智能体场景，实现了37.7%的EV旅行时间降低和45.2%的8x8网格改进。
AI.motivation: 应急车辆(EV)响应时间是生存结果的关键决定因素，但现有部署的信号优先策略仍为被动的、不可控的。需要一种能消除在线环境交互、支持调度级紧急程度控制、并可扩展至多智能体场景的新型框架。
AI.method: 将走廊优化问题建模为离线、回报条件化的序列建模问题。采用决策变换器(DT)架构，通过单一目标回报标量实现调度级紧急程度控制；MADT扩展版本通过图注意力机制实现空间协调的跨智能体策略。
AI.result: 在LightSim模拟器上：DT相比固定时序优先策略使EV平均旅行时间降低37.7%（88.6s vs 142.3s）；MADT在8x8网格上通过图注意力协调实现45.2%的改进；回报条件化提供了平滑的调度接口（目标回报100至-400可实现EV旅行时间72.4-138.2s与民用延误16.8-5.4s/veh的权衡）。
AI.conclusion: 回报条件化框架成功消除了在线环境交互需求，提供了可解释的调度控制接口，MADT通过图注意力协调机制在更大规模场景中表现优于DT。Constrained DT扩展进一步增加了民用干扰预算作为第二控制旋钮。

title: Machine Learning Models for the Early Detection of Burnout in Software Engineering: a Systematic Literature Review
summary:
Burnout is an occupational syndrome that, like many other professions, affects the majority of software engineers. Past research studies showed important trends, including an increasing use of machine learning techniques to allow for an early detection of burnout.
  This paper is a systematic literature review (SLR) of the research papers that proposed machine learning (ML) approaches, and focused on detecting burnout in software developers and IT professionals. Our objective is to review the accuracy and precision of the proposed ML techniques, and to formulate recommendations for future researchers interested to replicate or extend those studies.
  From our SLR we observed that a majority of primary studies focuses on detecting emotions or utilise emotional dimensions to detect or predict the presence of burnout. We also performed a cross-sectional study to detect which ML approach shows a better performance at detecting emotions; and which dataset has more potential and expressivity to capture emotions.
  We believe that, by identifying which ML tools and datasets show a better performance at detecting emotions, and indirectly at identifying burnout, our paper can be a valuable asset to progress in this important research direction.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于使用机器学习技术检测软件工程师和IT专业人员职业倦怠的系统文献综述（SLR）。研究主要关注情绪检测与情绪维度分析，并比较了不同ML方法在情绪检测任务上的表现，以识别最具潜力的工具和数据集。
AI.motivation: 职业倦怠影响大多数软件工程师，现有研究趋势表明机器学习技术可用于早期检测倦怠，但缺乏对现有ML方法准确性和精度的系统评估，需要为后续研究者提供可复现的推荐方案。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，收集并分析提出ML方法检测软件开发者倦怠的原始研究；同时进行横断面研究，比较不同ML方法在情绪检测任务上的性能表现，以及各数据集的表达潜力。
AI.result: 多数原始研究聚焦于情绪检测或利用情绪维度来识别倦怠；横断面研究揭示了不同ML方法的性能差异及最具表现力的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别表现最佳的ML工具和数据集，可为倦怠检测（尤其是情绪间接识别）领域的后续研究提供有价值的参考，推动该重要研究方向的发展。

title: Understanding LLM Performance Degradation in Multi-Instance Processing: The Roles of Instance Count and Context Length
summary: Users often rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) for processing multiple documents or performing analysis over a number of instances. For example, analysing the overall sentiment of a number of movie reviews requires an LLM to process the sentiment of each review individually in order to provide a final aggregated answer. While LLM performance on such individual tasks is generally high, there has been little research on how LLMs perform when dealing with multi-instance inputs. In this paper, we perform a comprehensive evaluation of the multi-instance processing (MIP) ability of LLMs for tasks in which they excel individually. The results show that all LLMs follow a pattern of slight performance degradation for small numbers of instances (approximately 20-100), followed by a performance collapse on larger instance counts. Crucially, our analysis shows that while context length is associated with this degradation, the number of instances has a stronger effect on the final results. This finding suggests that when optimising LLM performance for MIP, attention should be paid to both context length and, in particular, instance count.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在处理多实例输入（Multi-Instance Processing, MIP）时的性能表现。研究发现，所有LLM在处理少量实例（约20-100个）时会出现轻微性能下降，而在处理更大数量实例时会出现性能崩溃。
AI.motivation: 用户经常依赖LLM处理多个文档或对多个实例进行分析（如分析多部电影评论的整体情感），但目前对LLM在多实例输入场景下的表现研究不足。
AI.method: 对LLM处理多实例任务的能力进行全面评估，测试了LLM在各自擅长任务上的表现，并分析了实例数量和上下文长度对性能的影响。
AI.result: 所有LLM均表现出相似的性能退化模式：先在少量实例（约20-100个）时出现轻微性能下降，随后在实例数量进一步增加时发生性能崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 虽然上下文长度与性能退化相关，但实例数量对最终结果的影响更强。优化LLM的多实例处理能力需同时关注上下文长度和实例数量。

title: ST-GDance++: A Scalable Spatial-Temporal Diffusion for Long-Duration Group Choreography
summary: Group dance generation from music requires synchronizing multiple dancers while maintaining spatial coordination, making it highly relevant to applications such as film production, gaming, and animation. Recent group dance generation models have achieved promising generation quality, but they remain difficult to deploy in interactive scenarios due to bidirectional attention dependencies. As the number of dancers and the sequence length increase, the attention computation required for aligning music conditions with motion sequences grows quadratically, leading to reduced efficiency and increased risk of motion collisions. Effectively modeling dense spatial-temporal interactions is therefore essential, yet existing methods often struggle to capture such complexity, resulting in limited scalability and unstable multi-dancer coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ST-GDance++, a scalable framework that decouples spatial and temporal dependencies to enable efficient and collision-aware group choreography generation. For spatial modeling, we introduce lightweight distance-aware graph convolutions to capture inter-dancer relationships while reducing computational overhead. For temporal modeling, we design a diffusion noise scheduling strategy together with an efficient temporal-aligned attention mask, enabling stream-based generation for long motion sequences and improving scalability in long-duration scenarios. Experiments on the AIOZ-GDance dataset show that ST-GDance++ achieves competitive generation quality with significantly reduced latency compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: ST-GDance++是一种可扩展的音乐驱动群舞生成框架，通过解耦空间和时间依赖关系，实现高效且避免碰撞的群舞编排生成。采用距离感知的图卷积建模舞者间空间关系，扩散噪声调度策略结合时序对齐注意力掩码实现流式长序列生成，在AIOZ-GDance数据集上达到竞争力的生成质量，显著降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有群舞生成模型存在双向注意力依赖问题，随舞者数量和序列长度增加，注意力计算复杂度呈二次增长，导致效率降低和运动碰撞风险增加。现有方法难以有效建模密集的时空交互，扩展性有限，多舞者协调不稳定。
AI.method: 提出ST-GDance++框架：(1)空间建模：引入轻量级距离感知图卷积，捕捉舞者间关系同时降低计算开销；(2)时序建模：设计扩散噪声调度策略结合高效时序对齐注意力掩码，支持流式生成和长序列扩展。
AI.result: 在AIOZ-GDance数据集上的实验表明，ST-GDance++实现了具有竞争力的生成质量，同时相比现有方法显著降低了延迟。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦空间和时间依赖，ST-GDance++成功实现了可扩展的群舞生成框架，有效解决了传统方法中注意力计算复杂度高和运动碰撞的问题，为交互式场景中的群舞生成提供了更实用的解决方案。

title: Can an LLM Detect Instances of Microservice Infrastructure Patterns?
comment: Accepted at ICSA 2026 - International Conference on Software Architecture - Research Track
summary: Architectural patterns are frequently found in various software artifacts. The wide variety of patterns and their implementations makes detection challenging with current tools, especially since they often only support detecting patterns in artifacts written in a single language. Large Language Models (LLMs), trained on a diverse range of software artifacts and knowledge, might overcome the limitations of existing approaches. However, their true effectiveness and the factors influencing their performance have not yet been thoroughly examined. To better understand this, we developed MicroPAD. This tool utilizes GPT 5 nano to identify architectural patterns in software artifacts written in any language, based on natural-language pattern descriptions. We used MicroPAD to evaluate an LLM's ability to detect instances of architectural patterns, particularly infrastructure-related microservice patterns. To accomplish this, we selected a set of GitHub repositories and contacted their top contributors to create a new, human-annotated dataset of 190 repositories containing microservice architectural patterns. The results show that MicroPAD was capable of detecting pattern instances across multiple languages and artifact types. The detection performance varied across patterns (F1 scores ranging from 0.09 to 0.70), specifically in relation to their prevalence and the distinctiveness of the artifacts through which they manifest. We also found that patterns associated with recognizable, dominant artifacts were detected more reliably. Whether these findings generalize to other LLMs and tools is a promising direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MicroPAD工具，利用GPT-5 nano基于自然语言描述检测多语言软件制品中的架构模式，在包含190个仓库的人类标注数据集上进行评估。实验表明该工具可跨语言检测模式，但性能因模式而异（F1得分0.09至0.70），与模式流行度和制品特征显著相关。
AI.motivation: 当前架构模式检测工具存在明显局限：工具种类繁多，且通常仅支持检测单一编程语言编写的制品中的模式。这种局限性促使研究者探索能否利用在大规模软件制品和知识上训练的LLM来克服现有方法的不足。
AI.method: 研究团队开发了MicroPAD工具，使用GPT-5 nano根据自然语言模式描述来识别任意语言编写的软件制品中的架构模式。具体方法包括：选取GitHub仓库并联系其核心贡献者，创建了包含190个仓库的新型人类标注数据集，重点关注基础设施相关的微服务架构模式。评估涵盖了多种语言和制品类型的模式实例检测。
AI.result: MicroPAD能够跨多种语言和制品类型检测模式实例。检测性能因模式不同而存在差异（F1得分从0.09到0.70不等），具体与模式的流行度以及模式所通过制品的独特性相关。研究发现，与可识别的主导性制品相关联的模式能够被更可靠地检测出来。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了LLM在多语言架构模式检测方面的可行性，但发现检测效果受到模式特征和制品类型的显著影响。未来研究方向包括：验证这些发现能否推广至其他LLM和工具，以及进一步提升模式检测的准确性和通用性。

title: Bridging the Know-Act Gap via Task-Level Autoregressive Reasoning
summary: LLMs often generate seemingly valid answers to flawed or ill-posed inputs. This is not due to missing knowledge: under discriminative prompting, the same models can mostly identify such issues, yet fail to reflect this in standard generative responses. This reveals a fundamental know-act gap between discriminative recognition and generative behavior. Prior work largely characterizes this issue in narrow settings, such as math word problems or question answering, with limited focus on how to integrate these two modes. In this work, we present a comprehensive analysis using FaultyScience, a newly constructed large-scale, cross-disciplinary benchmark of faulty scientific questions. We show that the gap is pervasive and stems from token-level autoregression, which entangles task selection (validate vs. answer) with content generation, preventing discriminative knowledge from being utilized. To address this, we propose DeIllusionLLM, a task-level autoregressive framework that explicitly models this decision. Through self-distillation, the model unifies discriminative judgment and generative reasoning within a single backbone. Empirically, DeIllusionLLM substantially reduces answer-despite-error failures under natural prompting while maintaining general reasoning performance, demonstrating that self-distillation is an effective and scalable solution for bridging the discriminative-generative know-act gap

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在面对错误问题时仍生成看似合理的答案，揭示了判别能力与生成行为之间的"知行差距"。该问题源于token级自回归机制。通过DeIllusionLLM框架和自蒸馏方法，在FaultyScience基准上有效缩小了这一差距。
AI.motivation: LLMs能够通过判别性提示识别输入问题中的错误，但在标准生成模式下却忽略这些错误产生答案。这表明模型存在"知行差距"——判别认知与生成行为之间存在根本性脱节。现有研究多局限于狭窄场景（如数学应用题），缺乏跨学科分析和系统性解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建FaultyScience基准：大规模、跨学科的错误科学问题数据集；2) 提出DeIllusionLLM框架：任务级自回归，显式建模"验证 vs. 回答"的决策过程；3) 采用自蒸馏：将判别判断与生成推理统一到单一模型 backbone 中。
AI.result: 该差距广泛存在且源于token级自回归（将任务选择与内容生成纠缠）；DeIllusionLLM显著降低了"错误前提下的回答失败"，同时保持通用推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏是弥合判别-生成"知行差距"的有效且可扩展方案。

title: Geometric Mixture-of-Experts with Curvature-Guided Adaptive Routing for Graph Representation Learning
summary: Graph-structured data typically exhibits complex topological heterogeneity, making it difficult to model accurately within a single Riemannian manifold. While emerging mixed-curvature methods attempt to capture such diversity, they often rely on implicit, task-driven routing that lacks fundamental geometric grounding. To address this challenge, we propose a Geometric Mixture-of-Experts framework (GeoMoE) that adaptively fuses node representations across diverse Riemannian spaces to better accommodate multi-scale topological structures. At its core, GeoMoE leverages Ollivier-Ricci Curvature (ORC) as an intrinsic geometric prior to orchestrate the collaboration of specialized experts. Specifically, we design a graph-aware gating network that assigns node-specific fusion weights, regularized by a curvature-guided alignment loss to ensure interpretable and geometry-consistent routing. Additionally, we introduce a curvature-aware contrastive objective that promotes geometric discriminability by constructing positive and negative pairs according to curvature consistency. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that GeoMoE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse graph types.

AI.tldr: GeoMoE 将 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率(ORC)作为显式几何先验注入混合专家的节点级路由:三个专家(欧氏/双曲/球面)并行编码,图感知门控网络为每个节点生成融合权重,并通过曲率引导的门控对齐损失(KL)与曲率感知对比损失联合优化,使路由决策与内在几何一致;在六个基准数据集上全面超越欧氏与黎曼基线。
AI.motivation: 真实图数据存在显著的拓扑异质性:同一张图中同时存在类网格(欧氏)、层次(双曲)与环状(球面)子结构,单一几何先验(如 GCN/GAT 的欧氏假设或全局固定曲率模型)无法忠实表达,会扭曲结构信息并限制表达能力。已有的混合曲率方法(Cao et al., 2025; Sun et al., 2022 等)仍以全局方式混合几何,对所有节点使用同一几何配置,缺乏细粒度节点级适配;GraphMoRE 虽引入黎曼专家与拓扑感知门控,但其门控依赖隐式的畸变最小化,缺少基本几何监督,导致路由"几何不透明",容易出现专家坍缩。因此需要一个有明确几何基础、可解释、几何一致的节点级路由机制。
AI.method: 1) 几何专家库:三个并行 GNN 专家分别在欧氏空间 ℝ^d、Poincaré 球 (κ<0)、球面 (κ>0) 上编码节点,得到 h^E、h^H、h^S;非欧嵌入通过原点处对数映射 log_o 投影到统一欧氏切空间,按门控权重加权求和得到 h_fused。2) 曲率引导的门控对齐:图感知门控先经 GCN_gate 融合邻域结构,再由 MLP + 温度为 τ_g 的 Softmax 生成归一化权重 ω;由 ORC 构造软标签目标权重(式7):|κ| 越小越偏欧氏、κ<0 偏双曲、κ>0 偏球面,归一化后用 L_align = KL(ω*‖ω) 约束路由。3) 曲率感知对比学习:正样本按 ORC 阈值选取匹配曲率域的专家表示;负样本采用双重策略——节点内非最优专家表示 + 按余弦相似度挖掘的节点间硬负样本;用 InfoNCE 形式的 L_contr。4) 总损失 L_total = αL_task + βL_align + γL_contr;ORC 离线预计算。5) 三个定理:定理4.1(专家融合协同界:在优势区域与门控误差足够小时,融合表示的期望损失严格低于任一单专家)、定理4.2(门控权重与 ORC 的区域单调一致性)、定理4.3(对比学习给出 I(h_fused; h*) ≥ log(K+1) − L_contr 的互信息下界)。复杂度:离线精确求解 O(|E|Δ³logΔ),可借 Sinkhorn、聚类系数界或邻域重叠近似降至 O(|E|Δ);在线训练 O(|E|d + |V|d²),与标准 GCN 同阶。
AI.result: 节点分类(10 次运行平均):Cora 84.75%(+0.51% vs 最优基线 DGMAE 84.24)、CiteSeer 74.72%(+1.12% vs RNCGLN 73.60)、PubMed 80.13%(+0.88% vs SGFormer 79.25)、Photo 95.18%(+0.60% vs LRN 94.58)、WikiCS 79.65%(+0.84% vs DGMAE 78.81)、Airport F1 93.56%(+0.80% vs GraphMoRE 92.76),较 GraphMoRE 平均领先约 1.28%。消融显示三专家优于任意单/双专家组合(如仅双曲专家在 Airport 达 89.25%,仅欧氏在 Cora 达 82.02%);L_align 单独使 CiteSeer 提升 2.0% 至 72.90%,L_contr 单独使 PubMed 达 78.81%、Airport F1 达 92.19%,两者结合最优。分析显示门控权重随 ORC 呈清晰单调变化(κ≈0 处欧氏权重峰值,κ>0 时球面主导,κ<0 时双曲主导),θ 在 [10⁻⁵,10⁻²] 内性能稳定,最佳约 10⁻⁴;负样本数 K 在 3~4 最优,超过 10 后因"假负样本"略有衰减。
AI.conclusion: GeoMoE 通过将离散 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率显式作为路由监督信号,使混合专家从"任务驱动的隐式路由"转为"几何一致、可解释的节点级自适应路由",并通过曲率感知对比目标提升表示的几何可辨识度;理论上给出协同界、单调一致性与互信息下界三重保证,实验上在六个数据集上取得 SOTA,复杂度与 GCN 同阶,具备可扩展性。局限与展望:ORC 精确计算在大规模图上代价高(依赖近似),实验仅限静态图与节点分类,未来可扩展到动态/时变网络的曲率感知路由,并探索更丰富的曲率类型与跨几何预训练。

title: Fault-Tolerant Design and Multi-Objective Model Checking for Real-Time Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems
comment: To appear in ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM), 2026
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving complex decision-making problems. However, DRL-based systems still face significant dependability challenges particularly in real-time environments due to the simulation-to-reality gap, out-of-distribution observations, and the critical impact of latency. Latency-induced faults, in particular, can lead to unsafe or unstable behaviour, yet existing fault-tolerance approaches to DRL systems lack formal methods to rigorously analyse and optimise performance and safety simultaneously in real-time settings. To address this, we propose a formal framework for designing and analysing real-time switching mechanisms between DRL agents and alternative controllers. Our approach leverages Timed Automata (TAs) for explicit switch logic design, which is then syntactically converted to a Markov Decision Process (MDP) for formal analysis. We develop a novel convex query technique for multi-objective model checking, enabling the optimisation of soft performance objectives while ensuring hard safety constraints for MDPs. Furthermore, we present MOPMC, a GPU-accelerated software tool implementing this technique, demonstrating superior scalability in both model size and objective numbers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于在实时环境中设计和管理DRL系统的形式化框架，通过将时序自动机转换为MDP进行多目标模型检验，实现安全约束下的性能优化，并开发了GPU加速工具MOPMC。
AI.motivation: DRL系统在实时环境中面临可靠性挑战，包括仿真-现实差距、分布外观测和延迟关键影响。现有容错方法缺乏形式化方法来严格分析和同时优化实时环境中的性能与安全性。
AI.method: 提出一种形式化框架，利用时序自动机（TA）设计显式切换逻辑，然后句法转换为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）进行形式化分析。开发了新型凸查询技术用于多目标模型检验，可在确保硬安全约束的同时优化软性能目标。
AI.result: 开发了MOPMC工具，采用GPU加速实现，在模型规模和目标数量两方面均表现出卓越的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够为实时DRL系统提供形式化验证能力，同时兼顾安全性和性能优化，为构建高可靠性智能系统提供了新途径。

title: Graph-Aware Late Chunking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Biomedical Literature
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for biomedical literature are typically evaluated using ranking metrics like Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), which measure how well the system identifies the single most relevant chunk. We argue that for full-text scientific documents, this paradigm is incomplete: it rewards retrieval precision while ignoring retrieval breadth -- the ability to surface evidence from across a document's structural sections. We propose GraLC-RAG, a framework that unifies late chunking with graph-aware structural intelligence, introducing structure-aware chunk boundary detection, UMLS knowledge graph infusion, and graph-guided hybrid retrieval. We evaluate six strategies on 2,359 IMRaD-filtered PubMed Central articles using 2,033 cross-section questions and two metric families: standard ranking metrics (MRR, Recall@k) and structural coverage metrics (SecCov@k, CS Recall). Our results expose a sharp divergence: content-similarity methods achieve the highest MRR (0.517) but always retrieve from a single section, while structure-aware methods retrieve from up to 15.6x more sections. Generation experiments show that KG-infused retrieval narrows the answer-quality gap to delta-F1 = 0.009 while maintaining 4.6x section diversity. These findings demonstrate that standard metrics systematically undervalue structural retrieval and that closing the multi-section synthesis gap is a key open problem for biomedical RAG.

AI.tldr: 论文指出当前RAG系统评估指标（MRR等）仅关注单段落检索精度，忽略跨段落结构检索能力。提出GraLC-RAG框架，统一晚分块与图感知结构智能，在2,359篇PubMed Central文章上验证表明：内容相似性方法MRR最高(0.517)但仅来自单一章节，而结构感知方法检索范围扩大15.6倍，KG融合使答案质量差距缩小至delta-F1=0.009。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG系统评估范式不完整：标准排名指标（MRR）仅奖励单段落检索精度，忽视科学文档结构化信息的跨节检索广度（retrieval breadth）。全文科学文档需要从多个结构章节综合证据，单段落评估无法反映真实需求。
AI.method: 提出GraLC-RAG框架，核心模块包括：1）结构感知分块边界检测；2）UMLS知识图谱注入；3）图引导的混合检索。在2,359篇IMRaD格式PubMed Central文章上，使用2,033条跨节问题测试，采用两类评估指标：标准排名指标（MRR、Recall@k）和结构覆盖率指标（SecCov@k、CS Recall）。
AI.result: 内容相似性方法MRR最高（0.517），但始终仅从单一章节检索；结构感知方法检索范围扩大至15.6倍章节。生成实验显示：知识图谱融合检索将答案质量差距缩小至delta-F1=0.009，同时维持4.6倍章节多样性。
AI.conclusion: 标准评估指标系统性低估结构检索价值；多章节综合（multi-section synthesis）是生物医学RAG的关键开放问题。

title: A graph neural network based chemical mechanism reduction method for combustion applications
summary: Direct numerical simulations of turbulent reacting flows involving millions of grid points and detailed chemical mechanisms with hundreds of species and thousands of reactions are computationally prohibitive. To address this challenge, we present two data-driven chemical mechanism reduction formulations based on graph neural networks (GNNs) with message-passing transformer layers that learn nonlinear dependencies among species and reactions. The first formulation, GNN-SM, employs a pre-trained surrogate model to guide reduction across a broad range of reactor conditions. The second formulation, GNN-AE, uses an autoencoder formulation to obtain highly compact mechanisms that remain accurate within the thermochemical regimes used during training. The approaches are demonstrated on detailed mechanisms for methane (53 species, 325 reactions), ethylene (96 species, 1054 reactions), and iso-octane (1034 species, 8453 reactions). GNN-SM achieves reductions comparable to the established graph-based method DRGEP while maintaining accuracy across a wide range of thermochemical states. In contrast, GNN-AE achieves up to 95% reduction in species and reactions and outperforms DRGEP within its target conditions. Overall, the proposed framework provides an automated, machine-learning-based pathway for chemical mechanism reduction that can complement traditional expert-guided analytical approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于图神经网络（带消息传递的图Transformer层）的数据驱动化学机理约简方法：GNN-SM借助预训练代理模型（MLP）引导约简，适用于宽范围热化学工况；GNN-AE采用图自编码器重构瞬态热化学状态，可在训练工况内实现极紧凑机理。
AI.motivation: 高保真燃烧DNS/LES需百万级网格点与数百物种、数千反应的详细机理，计算代价在现有HPC上不可承受。图方法（DRG/DRGEP/DRGEP-SA）系统性强但DRGEP-SA需大量重复灵敏度分析、计算昂贵，且传统图方法局限于局部近邻相互作用，难以捕捉长程/全局关联；标准反应器求解器不可微，无法直接反向传播。GNN能以图结构自然表达物种–反应网络并学习非线性依赖，从而实现自动化、免专家经验的机理约简。
AI.method: 将化学机理表示为有向图：节点=物种（特征含摩尔分数、生成/消耗速率），边=参与同一基元反应的物种对（特征含化学计量系数与动力学参数，且不直接编码热化学状态）。GNN输出保持相同连接关系但附0–1标量重要性分数（S_X、S_{X,Y,r}），据此剪枝。消息传递采用图Transformer层，注意力系数α_{u,v}=softmax((W3 h_u)^T (W4 h_v + W5 e_{u,v})/√d)，含边特征。GNN-SM：两阶段——先离线训练MLP代理模型（初态→点火延迟等目标量）提供可微通路；再训练GNN（2层图Transformer，隐藏维128，三个MLP头分别预测节点/边重要性、top-k剪枝后全局池化反推初始T、P），损失为L_total=|τ̂_ig−τ_ig|+λ_sparsity·(节点/边重要性分数均值)，代理权重冻结，用top-k按保留比例迭代约简。GNN-AE：编码器–解码器（图自编码器）学习恒等映射，隐空间直接对应重要性分数，解码器用128维MLP重构原始节点/边特征，损失L_total=λ_rec(L_n+L_e)+λ_sparsity·L_sparsity（L_n、L_e为输入层与输出层特征的L2范数）；按阈值迭代剪枝后，再用贪心搜索逐一尝试删除物种，若IDT或峰值放热率误差超容差则保留。在GRI-Mech 3.0（甲烷）、FFCM-2（乙烯）、Curran等（异辛烷）上以DRGEP为基线评估。
AI.result: 甲烷：DRGEP 23物种/123反应（IDT误差1.53%）；GNN-SM经3次迭代至27物种/157反应，误差1.45%；GNN-AE 35物种误差1.77%，贪心精炼后19物种/82反应但平均误差升至6.83%。乙烯：DRGEP 38/288（11.56%）；GNN-SM 6次迭代至36/292，误差8.15%（优于DRGEP）；GNN-AE 35/288误差8.99%；AE-G(1500K) 25/175误差19.71%，AE-G(1200K) 28/181误差13.92%。异辛烷：详细机理1034/8453；DRGEP 63/637误差8.81%；GNN-SM 7次迭代247/2817误差9.19%；GNN-AE-G 55/553误差16.69%。分析显示GNN-SM保留H2O2、CH3OH等含氧中间体及C2/C3桥接物种，故在低温（1000–1200 K）区间仍稳健；AE-G过度剪枝这些路径，在低温下严重偏差、HRR受抑。GNN-SM总体约简可达70%，GNN-AE配合贪心精炼可达约95%物种与反应削减。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了GNN驱动的燃烧化学机理约简框架，形成两种互补范式：GNN-SM（代理模型引导、宽工况鲁棒，约简最高70%，性能与DRGEP相当或更优）与GNN-AE（自编码器恒等映射、面向训练状态空间的高度紧凑约简，配合贪心搜索最高削减95%）。结果表明可在保持点火延迟等关键反应器指标的前提下大幅缩减机理与计算成本，为多燃料动力学、湍流燃烧建模及数据驱动机理精修提供自动化前置步骤，可作为专家引导分析的补充，缩小搜索空间、加速约简开发；但AE系列机理泛化性有限，偏离训练温区即失效。

title: Q-GARS: Quantum-inspired Robust Microservice Chaining Scheduling
summary: Microservice-based applications are characterized by stochastic latencies arising from long-tail execution patterns and heterogeneous resource constraints across computational nodes. To address this challenge, we first formulate the problem using Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO), which aligns the problem with emerging quantum-optimization paradigms. Building upon this, we propose Q-GARS (Quantum-Guided Adaptive Robust Scheduling), a hybrid framework that integrates the QUBO model with Simulated Quantum Annealing (SQA) based combinatorial search and online rescheduling mechanisms, enabling global microservice rank generation and real-time robust adjustment. We treat the SQA-produced rank as a soft prior, and update a closed-loop trust weight to adaptively switch and mix between this prior and a robust proportional-fairness allocator, maintaining robustness under prediction failures and runtime disturbances. Simulation results demonstrate that Q-GARS achieves an average weighted completion time improvement of 2.1\% relative to a greedy baseline of the remaining shortest processing-time (SRPT), with performance gains reaching up to 16.8\% in heavy-tailed latency. The adaptive mechanism reduces tail latency under high-variance conditions. In addition, Q-GARS achieves a mean node resource utilization rate of 0.817, which is 1.1 percentage points above the robust baseline (0.806).

AI.tldr: Q-GARS是一种混合微服务调度框架，将QUBO问题公式化与模拟量子退火相结合，通过自适应闭环信任权重机制在SQA先验与鲁棒比例公平分配器之间动态切换，实现全局微服务排序生成与实时鲁棒调整。
AI.motivation: 微服务应用具有随机延迟特性，源于长尾执行模式和跨计算节点异构资源约束，现有调度方法难以有效应对预测失败和运行时扰动。
AI.method: 1) 将调度问题表述为QUBO形式，与量子优化范式对齐；2) 基于模拟量子退火(SQA)进行组合搜索生成微服务排序；3) 设计自适应信任权重闭环机制，在SQA先验与鲁棒比例公平分配器之间动态切换与混合。
AI.result: 相比贪婪SRPT基线，Q-GARS加权完成时间平均提升2.1%，重尾延迟场景下提升达16.8%；高方差条件下尾部延迟降低；节点资源平均利用率达0.817，较鲁棒基线提升1.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 混合量子启发式方法与自适应机制可有效平衡全局优化与运行时鲁棒性，为微服务调度提供了一种可行的量子计算过渡期解决方案。

title: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Architectures for Financial Document Processing: A Comparative Study of Orchestration Patterns, Cost-Accuracy Tradeoffs and Production Scaling Strategies
summary: The adoption of large language models (LLMs) for structured information extraction from financial documents has accelerated rapidly, yet production deployments face fundamental architectural decisions with limited empirical guidance. We present a systematic benchmark comparing four multi-agent orchestration architectures: sequential pipeline, parallel fan-out with merge, hierarchical supervisor-worker and reflexive self-correcting loop. These are evaluated across five frontier and open-weight LLMs on a corpus of 10,000 SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q and 8-K forms). Our evaluation spans 25 extraction field types covering governance structures, executive compensation and financial metrics, measured along five axes: field-level F1, document-level accuracy, end-to-end latency, cost per document and token efficiency. We find that reflexive architectures achieve the highest field-level F1 (0.943) but at 2.3x the cost of sequential baselines, while hierarchical architectures occupy the most favorable position on the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier (F1 0.921 at 1.4x cost). We further present ablation studies on semantic caching, model routing and adaptive retry strategies, demonstrating that hybrid configurations can recover 89\% of the reflexive architecture's accuracy gains at only 1.15x baseline cost. Our scaling analysis from 1K to 100K documents per day reveals non-obvious throughput-accuracy degradation curves that inform capacity planning. These findings provide actionable guidance for practitioners deploying multi-agent LLM systems in regulated financial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文系统对比了四种多智能体编排架构（顺序管道、并行扇出合并、分层监督者-工作者、自反自我纠错循环）在10,000份SEC文件上的信息提取性能，发现自反架构F1最高（0.943）但成本达基准的2.3倍，分层架构在成本-准确率帕累托前沿上最具优势，且混合配置可兼顾性能与成本效益。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在金融文档结构化信息提取领域的生产部署面临架构选择缺乏实证指导的问题，需要系统性的基准测试来指导从业者在受监管金融环境中的决策。
AI.method: 采用5种前沿及开源LLM，在10,000份SEC文件（10-K、10-Q、8-K）语料上对比四种多智能体编排架构，评估25种提取字段类型，从字段级F1、文档级准确率、端到端延迟、成本和令牌效率五个维度进行测量，并开展消融实验验证语义缓存、模型路由和自适应重试策略的效果。
AI.result: 自反架构达到最高字段级F1（0.943）但成本为顺序基准的2.3倍；分层架构在成本-准确率帕累托前沿上占据最有利位置（F1 0.921，成本1.4倍）；混合配置可恢复自反架构89%的准确率提升，成本仅为基准的1.15倍。
AI.conclusion: 分层监督者-工作者架构在成本效益上最为均衡；混合配置策略可有效平衡性能与成本；扩展性分析揭示了从日处理1K到100K文档时吞吐量与准确率的非平凡退化曲线，为容量规划提供量化依据。

title: Sparsely-Supervised Data Assimilation via Physics-Informed Schrödinger Bridge
summary: Data assimilation (DA) for systems governed by partial differential equations (PDE) aims to reconstruct full spatiotemporal fields from sparse high-fidelity (HF) observations while respecting physical constraints. While full-grid low-fidelity (LF) simulations provide informative priors in multi-fidelity settings, recovering an HF field consistent with both sparse observations and the governing PDE typically requires per-instance test-time optimization, which becomes a major bottleneck in time-critical applications. To alleviate this, amortized reconstruction using generative models has recently been proposed; however, such approaches rely on full-field HF supervision during training, which is often impractical in real-world settings. From a more realistic perspective, we propose the Physics-Informed Conditional Schrödinger Bridge (PICSB), which transports an informative LF prior toward an observation-conditioned HF posterior without any additional inference-time guidance. To enable learning without HF endpoints, PICSB employs an iterative surrogate-endpoint refresh scheme, and directly incorporates PDE residuals into the training objective while enforcing observations via hard conditioning throughout sampling. Experiments on fluid PDE benchmarks demonstrate that PICSB enables extremely fast spatiotemporal field reconstruction while maintaining competitive accuracy under sparse HF supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「物理信息条件薛定谔桥」(PICSB)，在只有稀疏高保真(10%)观测、全网格低保真(LF)先验的条件下，无需推理期引导、也无需全场HF监督，即可实现 PDE 系统的摊销式全场重建。方法用硬条件投影保证观测可行性，用 PDE 残差作训练能量塑造终端分布，并以「代理终端端点迭代刷新」机制在没有真实HF端点时学习桥接。三个流体基准(1D Burgers、2D Darcy、2D Kolmogorov)上，Darcy 与 Kolmogorov 精度最优、Burgers 具竞争力，推理为亚秒级，比 PINN 优化快 3~4 个数量级、比引导式扩散快约 3 个数量级。
AI.motivation: 数据同化(DA)需在稀疏高保真(HF)观测下重建完整时空场并满足 PDE 约束。现有路线的痛点有两点：(1) 经典物理 DA 需为每个新实例求解带约束的反问题，推理开销大，难以用于数值天气预报、海洋预报、实时水文等时间敏感场景；(2) 基于扩散模型的摊销式重建虽可零样本推理，但训练依赖全场 HF 标签，且推理时还需残差引导(guidance)，采样步数多、成本高。现实数据中 HF 标签往往只在部分时空位置可得，因此需要一种同时满足「零样本推理、可同化稀疏观测、标签高效(无全场HF监督)、免引导」四个条件的方法，而此前文献中无方法同时满足。
AI.method: 问题设定：固定网格上 LF 全场 X0∈R^n、稀疏 HF 观测 Y=H(X1)∈R^m(m≪n)，H 为坐标选择算子。核心是条件薛定谔桥：把 LF 场视为信息丰富的源分布 π0(·|y)，把观测条件化的 HF 后验 π1(·|y) 作为终端分布，构造路径测度 P 最小化 KL(P‖Q)(Q 为布朗桥参考)。由于真实 HF 端点不可得，引入代理终端参考 π̃1：用缓慢更新的静态速度网络 v_θ̃ 在硬条件下诱导的终端律。训练时：(1) 由 v_θ̃ 从 x0 采样代理终端 x̃1；(2) 用布朗桥闭式解在 (x0, x̃1) 间采样 x̃τ 并投影到观测可行集 C_y={x:H(x)=y}；(3) 由可训练采样器 Sample_θ 从 x̃τ 生成 x̂1；(4) 仅以物理残差 L(θ)=E‖R_h(x̂1)‖ 为损失更新 θ。观测通过每步坐标投影 Π_Cy(x)=M⊙y+(1−M)⊙x 硬性强制，保证 H(x̂1)=y。采样器为前向 Euler + 硬投影 + 噪声注入（末步不加噪），速度网络为 AdaIN 条件化 U-Net（基于 Bortoli 等），条件向量由时间嵌入 MLP 生成。代理端点每 C=100 次迭代刷新一次（共 100k 迭代，10 步桥时间离散，ε=1e-2），类似目标网络稳定化。理论方面：命题 4.1 给出可辨识性下残差与状态误差的稳定性界 ‖x̂1−x*‖≤c(δ−δ*(y;h))+η(h)，并附 1D Burgers 的误差上界 ε(δ″,PDE 保真度,h)；命题 4.2 证明刷新映射在不动点处的自洽性（观测可行性与期望残差达到内层最优）。
AI.result: 三个基准(各 32 训练/4 测试对、10% 稀疏观测，三种观测制度 R1 重采样/R2 每样本固定/R3 全局固定)上的相对 L2 误差(%): Burgers R1 PINNs 8.29 / Guidance 0.99 / PICSB 2.59，R2 13.48/19.04/14.05，R3 11.79/10.66/14.25；Darcy R1 5.69/12.02/0.29，R3 5.64/27.39/0.28；Kolmogorov R1 64.47/8.99/7.32，R2 65.20/10.62/8.66，R3 65.06/10.61/8.37。推理墙钟时间(s): Burgers 1733/174/0.023，Darcy 2682/173/0.023，Kolmogorov 10680/801/0.134——PICSB 为亚秒级，比 PINN 快约 5 个数量级、比引导式扩散快约 3~4 个数量级。附录还表明：PICSB 在观测噪声(1%~15%)下误差增长更平缓，尤其 Burgers 与 Darcy 明显优于引导基线；推理时观测降至 5%/1% 时性能显著退化，Darcy/Kolmogorov 几乎失效；采用跨稀疏度「集成式微调」(同时在 10%/5%/1% 嵌套子集上微调)可在 1% 稀疏下部分恢复性能，但误差仍不可忽略。
AI.conclusion: PICSB 是一种免引导的条件 Schrödinger 桥框架，在稀疏 HF 监督下把 LF 先验输运为物理一致的 HF 场分布，兼顾零样本推理、稀疏观测同化与标签高效，并实现亚秒级重建，可嵌入每个物理更新周期内的实时同化流程。其代理端点迭代刷新机制使「无 HF 端点」的桥接学习成为可能，理论上残差最小化在可辨识条件下可逼近观测条件化的 HF 解。局限与未来方向：已知算子假设、观测噪声建模不足、对更低信息量 LF 输入与极稀疏观测的鲁棒性有限；后续可扩展到未知/部分已知/可学习算子、噪声感知条件化，以及更弱 LF 先验的情形。

title: Can Language Models Pass Software Testing Certification Exams? a case study
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) play a pivotal role in both academic research and broader societal applications. LLMs are increasingly used in software testing activities such as test case generation, selection, and repair. However, several important questions remain: (1) do LLMs possess enough information about software testing principles to perform software testing tasks effectively? (2) do LLMs possess sufficient conceptual understanding of software testing to answer software testing questions under metamorphic transformations? and (3) do certain properties of software testing questions influence the performance of LLMs? To answer these questions, this study evaluates 60 multimodal language models from both commercial vendors and the open-source community. The evaluation is performed using 30 sample exams of different types (core foundation, core advanced, specialist, and expert) from the International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB), which are used to assess the competence of human testers. In total, each model is evaluated on 1,171 questions. Furthermore, to ensure sufficient conceptual understanding, the models are also tested on exam questions transformed using context-preserving metamorphic techniques. Two models passed all the certifications by scoring at least 65% in all of the 30 certification exams, with commercial models generally outperforming open-source ones. We analyze the reasons behind incorrect answers and provide recommendations for improving the design of software testing certification exams.

AI.tldr: This study evaluates 60 multimodal LLMs on their ability to pass software testing certification exams (ISTQB), testing both foundational knowledge and robustness under metamorphic transformations. Commercial models outperformed open-source ones, with only two models achieving passing scores (≥65%) across all 30 certification exams.
AI.motivation: Despite the growing use of LLMs in software testing activities (test generation, selection, repair), it remains unclear whether LLMs truly understand software testing principles or can reliably answer software testing questions, especially under conceptual transformations. This study addresses this critical gap by systematically evaluating LLM capabilities on standardized software testing certifications.
AI.method: 60 multimodal LLMs (commercial and open-source) were evaluated on 1,171 questions from 30 ISTQB certification exams spanning four difficulty levels (core foundation, core advanced, specialist, expert).
