Additionally, exam questions were transformed using context-preserving metamorphic techniques to assess conceptual understanding robustness. Each model answered the full question set under standardized conditions.
AI.result: Two models passed all certifications by scoring ≥65% on all 30 exams. Commercial models generally outperformed open-source models. Analysis of incorrect answers revealed specific conceptual weaknesses and patterns influenced by question properties.
AI.conclusion: LLMs show promise in software testing certification but struggle with certain conceptual transformations and question types. The findings provide actionable recommendations for improving both LLM design and the design of software testing certification exams. The benchmark dataset and metamorphic transformations offer a robust evaluation framework for future LLM assessment in software testing domains.

title: MuQ-Eval: An Open-Source Per-Sample Quality Metric for AI Music Generation Evaluation
summary: Distributional metrics such as Fréchet Audio Distance cannot score individual music clips and correlate poorly with human judgments, while the only per-sample learned metric achieving high human correlation is closed-source. We introduce MUQ-EVAL, an open-source per-sample quality metric for AIgenerated music built by training lightweight prediction heads on frozen MuQ-310M features using MusicEval, a dataset of generated clips from 31 text-to-music systems with expert quality ratings. Our simplest model, frozen features with attention pooling and a two-layer MLP, achieves system-level SRCC = 0.957 and utterance-level SRCC = 0.838 with human mean opinion scores. A systematic ablation over training objectives and adaptation strategies shows that no addition meaningfully improves the frozen baseline, indicating that frozen MuQ representations already capture quality-relevant information. Encoder choice is the dominant design factor, outweighing all architectural and training decisions. LoRA-adapted models trained on as few as 150 clips already achieve usable correlation, enabling personalized quality evaluators from individual listener annotations. A controlled degradation analysis reveals selective sensitivity to signal-level artifacts but insensitivity to musical-structural distortions. Our metric, MUQ-EVAL, is fully open-source, outperforms existing open per-sample metrics, and runs in real time on a single consumer GPU. Code, model weights, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/dgtql/MuQ-Eval.

AI.tldr: MUQ-EVAL是一个用于AI生成音乐的开源逐样本质量评估指标，基于冻结的MuQ-310M特征构建，在MusicEval数据集（包含31个文生音乐系统的生成样本及专家评分）上训练。简单模型（注意力池化+两层MLP）即可达到系统级SRCC 0.957和语句级SRCC 0.838。消融实验表明冻结基线已捕获质量相关信息，编码器选择是最关键的设计因素。
AI.motivation: 现有分布度量（如Fréchet Audio Distance）无法对单个音乐片段评分且与人类判断相关性差；唯一具有高人类相关性的样本级学习指标是闭源的。迫切需要一个开源的逐样本质量评估指标。
AI.method: 基于冻结的MuQ-310M特征构建轻量级预测头，使用MusicEval数据集（31个文本到音乐系统的生成样本及专家质量评分）训练。对训练目标和适配策略进行系统消融，并测试少样本LoRA适应。
AI.result: 系统级SRCC达0.957，语句级SRCC达0.838。冻结基线已是最优配置，编码器选择是最主要的设计因素。150个样本即可训练出可用的LoRA适应模型。存在对信号级伪影的选择性敏感，但对音乐结构扭曲不敏感。
AI.conclusion: MUQ-EVAL是完全开源的，逐样本评估性能优于现有开源指标，可在单消费级GPU上实时运行。代码、模型权重和评估脚本已公开。

title: Bridging the Gap Between Climate Science and Machine Learning in Climate Model Emulation
summary: While climate models provide insights for climate decision-making, their use is constrained by significant computational and technical demands. Although machine learning (ML) emulators offer a way to bypass the high computational costs, their effective use remains challenging. The hurdles are diverse, ranging from limited accessibility and a lack of specialized knowledge to a general mistrust of ML methods that are perceived as insufficiently physical. Here, we introduce a framework to overcome these barriers by integrating both climate science and machine learning perspectives. We find that designing easy-to-adopt emulators that address a clearly defined task and demonstrating their reliability offers a promising path for bridging the gap between our two fields.

AI.tldr: 本文针对气候模型计算成本高、ML emulator应用困难的问题，提出一个整合气候科学与机器学习视角的框架，通过设计易用、任务明确且可靠性可验证的emulator来弥合两领域之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 气候模型虽能为气候决策提供参考，但存在计算成本高、技术门槛高等局限性；ML emulator虽可降低计算成本，但其应用面临诸多障碍，包括可访问性差、专业知识缺乏以及对ML方法物理可解释性的不信任。
AI.method: 提出了一个整合气候科学与机器学习两个视角的框架，旨在突破上述应用障碍。
AI.result: 发现设计易采用、针对明确任务且能展示其可靠性的emulator，是弥合两领域差距的有效途径。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为跨学科合作提供了可行路径，强调了结合领域知识与ML技术优势的重要性。

title: Rethinking Self-Sovereign Identity Principles: An Actor-Oriented Categorization of Requirements
summary: Centralized identity management systems continuously experience security and privacy challenges, motivating the exploration of Decentralized Identity (DI) and Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) as user-focused alternatives. Although prior research has consolidated SSI principles and derived quality requirements for DI/SSI systems, it is significantly limited in integrating the user viewpoint. This work addresses this gap by embedding a user perspective into the requirements engineering process for DI/SSI systems. Building on existing SSI principles, composite requirements were decomposed into 24 simple quality or non-functional requirements (NFR). The resulting NFR are systematically mapped to the key actors, namely data owner, issuer, verifier, and system, based on varying degrees of responsibility and ownership. A dependency model is introduced to formalize relationships between actors. Inspired by trust modeling concepts, the model explicitly describes how actors interact and rely on each other for requirements fulfillment. By integrating user-centered requirements, responsibility allocation, ownership specification, and dependency modeling, this work provides the first structured model for DI/SSI system architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文针对去中心化身份(DI)和自主权身份(SSI)系统，将 SSI 原则分解为 24 个非功能需求(NFR)，并系统性地映射到数据所有者、发行者、验证者和系统四类关键角色，引入了依赖模型来形式化角色间的关系，为 DI/SSI 系统架构提供了首个结构化模型。
AI.motivation: 当前集中式身份管理系统面临安全与隐私挑战，DI/SSI 作为用户导向的替代方案应运而生。现有研究虽已整合 SSI 原则并推导出质量需求，但在整合用户视角方面存在显著不足。
AI.method: 1. 基于现有 SSI 原则；2. 将复合需求分解为 24 个简单质量/NFR；3. 基于责任与所有权程度，系统性映射 NFR 到四类关键角色（数据所有者、发行者、验证者、系统）；4. 引入依赖模型形式化角色间交互关系，借鉴信任建模概念描述角色间如何相互作用以满足需求。
AI.result: 将用户中心需求、责任分配、所有权规范和依赖建模整合，形成 DI/SSI 系统架构的首个结构化模型。
AI.conclusion: 本研究填补了 DI/SSI 需求工程中用户视角缺失的空白，通过依赖模型明确描述了角色交互与需求满足机制，为后续系统设计与实现提供了理论基础。

title: HyFI: Hyperbolic Feature Interpolation for Brain-Vision Alignment
summary: Recent progress in artificial intelligence has encouraged numerous attempts to understand and decode human visual system from brain signals. These prior works typically align neural activity independently with semantic and perceptual features extracted from images using pre-trained vision models. However, they fail to account for two key challenges: (1) the modality gap arising from the natural difference in the information level of representation between brain signals and images, and (2) the fact that semantic and perceptual features are highly entangled within neural activity. To address these issues, we utilize hyperbolic space, which is well-suited for considering differences in the amount of information and has the geometric property that geodesics between two points naturally bend toward the origin, where the representational capacity is lower. Leveraging these properties, we propose a novel framework, Hyperbolic Feature Interpolation (HyFI), which interpolates between semantic and perceptual visual features along hyperbolic geodesics. This enables both the fusion and compression of perceptual and semantic information, effectively reflecting the limited expressiveness of brain signals and the entangled nature of these features. As a result, it facilitates better alignment between brain and visual features. We demonstrate that HyFI achieves state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval, outperforming prior methods with Top-1 accuracy improvements of up to +17.3% on THINGS-EEG and +9.1% on THINGS-MEG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyperbolic Feature Interpolation (HyFI)框架，利用双曲空间的几何特性（测地线自然朝向原点弯曲）来解决脑信号与图像特征对齐中的两个关键问题：模态差距和语义-感知特征的纠缠。通过沿双曲测地线插值融合两类特征，实现压缩与对齐。实验在THINGS-EEG和THINGS-MEG数据集上取得最优性能，Top-1准确率分别提升+17.3%和+9.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法独立对齐脑神经活动与语义特征或感知特征，忽视了关键挑战：(1) 脑信号与图像之间存在模态差距，信息表征层级不同；(2) 语义特征与感知特征在神经活动中高度纠缠，难以分离处理。这些问题导致现有方法无法有效捕捉人脑视觉系统的完整表征。
AI.method: 利用双曲空间的几何特性——其测地线自然弯曲朝向原点（表征容量较低处），非常适合建模信息量的差异。提出Hyperbolic Feature Interpolation (HyFI)框架，沿双曲测地线在语义与感知视觉特征之间进行插值，实现两类特征的融合与压缩，从而反映脑信号的有限表达能力和特征的纠缠特性。
AI.result: 在零样本脑到图像检索任务中达到最优性能。在THINGS-EEG数据集上Top-1准确率提升+17.3%，在THINGS-MEG数据集上提升+9.1%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 双曲空间为建模脑-视觉特征对齐提供了有效的几何框架。HyFI通过沿双曲测地线的特征插值，成功融合并压缩了语义与感知信息，有效解决了模态差距和特征纠缠问题，为理解人类视觉系统的神经表征提供了新思路。

title: AEGIS: An Operational Infrastructure for Post-Market Governance of Adaptive Medical AI Under US and EU Regulations
summary:
Machine learning systems deployed in medical devices require governance frameworks that ensure safety while enabling continuous improvement. Regulatory bodies including the FDA and European Union have introduced mechanisms such as the Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) and Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) to manage iterative model updates without repeated submissions. This paper presents AI/ML Evaluation and Governance Infrastructure for Safety (AEGIS), a governance framework applicable to any healthcare AI system. AEGIS comprises three modules, i.e., dataset assimilation and retraining, model monitoring, and conditional decision, that operationalize FDA PCCP and EU AI Act Article 43(4) provisions. We implement a four-category deployment decision taxonomy (APPROVE, CONDITIONAL APPROVAL, CLINICAL REVIEW, REJECT) with an independent PMS ALARM signal, enabling detection of the critical state in which no deployable model exists while the released model is simultaneously at risk.
  To illustrate how AEGIS can be instantiated across heterogeneous clinical contexts, we provide two examples: sepsis prediction from electronic health records and brain tumor segmentation from medical imaging. Both cases use identical governance architecture, differing only in configuration. Across 11 simulated iterations on the sepsis example, AEGIS yielded 8 APPROVE, 1 CONDITIONAL APPROVAL, 1 CLINICAL REVIEW, and 1 REJECT decision, exercising all four categories. ALARM signals were co-issued at iterations 8 and 10, including the critical state where no deployable model exists and the released model is simultaneously failing. AEGIS detected drift before observable performance degradation. These results demonstrate that AEGIS translates regulatory change-control concepts into executable governance procedures, supporting safe continuous learning for adaptive medical AI across diverse clinical applications.

AI.tldr: AEGIS是一个用于医疗AI系统的治理框架，将FDA PCCP和欧盟AI法案Article 43(4)规定转化为可执行的管理程序。该框架包含三个模块（数据集整合与再训练、模型监控、条件决策）和四类部署决策（APPROVE/CONDITIONAL APPROVAL/CLINICAL REVIEW/REJECT），另设独立的PMS ALARM信号。在11次模拟迭代中成功检测到模型漂移，并识别出关键危险状态（无可部署模型且已发布模型同时失效）。
AI.motivation: 医疗AI设备中的机器学习系统需要在保障安全与实现持续改进之间取得平衡。FDA和欧盟等监管机构虽已推出PCCP和PMS机制，但缺乏将这些监管概念转化为可执行治理程序的系统性框架。
AI.method: 提出AEGIS治理框架，包含三个核心模块：(1)数据集整合与再训练模块；(2)模型监控模块；(3)条件决策模块。采用四类部署决策分类法（APPROVE/CONDITIONAL APPROVAL/CLINICAL REVIEW/REJECT）以及独立的PMS ALARM信号机制，用于检测"无可部署模型且已发布模型同时失效"的关键危险状态。通过两个临床场景验证框架通用性：脓毒症预测（EHR数据）和脑肿瘤分割（医学影像）。
AI.result: 在脓毒症预测场景的11次模拟迭代中，决策分布为：8次APPROVE、1次CONDITIONAL APPROVAL、1次CLINICAL REVIEW、1次REJECT，覆盖全部四类决策。ALARM信号在第8轮和第10轮触发，成功检测到性能明显下降前的漂移现象，并识别出关键危险状态。
AI.conclusion: AEGIS能够将监管机构的变化控制概念转化为可执行的治理程序，支持自适应医疗AI在多样化临床应用中的安全持续学习。该框架通过配置调整即可适应不同临床场景，具有良好的通用性和实用价值。

title: MuSe: a Mutation Testing Plugin for the Remix IDE
summary: Mutation testing is a technique to assess the effectiveness of test suites by introducing artificial faults into programs. Although mutation testing plugins are available for many platforms and languages, none is currently available for Remix-IDE, the most widely used Integrated Development Environment for the entire contract development journey, used by users of all knowledge levels, and serves as a learning lab for teaching and experimenting with Ethereum. The quality and security of smart contracts are crucial in blockchain systems, as even minor issues can result in substantial financial losses. This paper proposes MuSe, a mutation testing plugin for the Remix-IDE. MuSe includes traditional, Solidity-specific, and security-oriented mutation operators. Its integration into the Remix-IDE eliminates the need for additional setup and lowers the entry barrier. As a result, developers and researchers can immediately leverage mutation testing to assess the effectiveness of their test suites and identify potential issues in smart contracts. We provide a demo video showing MuSe: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MIFk9exTDu0 and its repository: https://github.com/GerardoIuliano/MuSe-Remix-Plugin.

AI.tldr: MuSe是一个面向Remix-IDE的智能合约变异测试插件，集成了传统、Solidity特定和安全导向三类变异算子，旨在帮助开发者评估测试套件有效性、识别智能合约潜在安全缺陷。
AI.motivation: 变异测试是评估测试套件有效性的重要手段，但Remix-IDE（最广泛使用的以太坊智能合约开发环境）尚无此类工具。智能合约安全至关重要，小缺陷即可导致重大经济损失。
AI.method: 提出MuSe插件，集成三类变异算子：传统变异算子、Solidity特定变异算子、安全导向变异算子。基于Remix-IDE集成开发，无需额外配置，降低使用门槛。
AI.result: 开发者可立即利用MuSe进行变异测试，评估测试套件有效性并识别智能合约中的潜在问题。
AI.conclusion: MuSe填补了Remix-IDE变异测试工具空白，为智能合约质量保障提供了便捷手段。提供了演示视频和开源仓库。

title: Beyond Binary Correctness: Scaling Evaluation of Long-Horizon Agents on Subjective Enterprise Tasks
summary:
Large language models excel on objectively verifiable tasks such as math and programming, where evaluation reduces to unit tests or a single correct answer. In contrast, real-world enterprise work is often subjective and context-dependent: success hinges on organizational goals, user intent, and the quality of intermediate artifacts produced across long, multi-tool workflows.
  We introduce LH-Bench, a three-pillar evaluation design that moves beyond binary correctness to score autonomous, long-horizon execution on subjective enterprise tasks. The pillars are: (i) expert-grounded rubrics that give LLM judges the domain context needed to score subjective work, (ii) curated ground-truth artifacts that enable stepwise reward signals (e.g., chapter-level annotation for content tasks), and (iii) pairwise human preference evaluation for convergent validation. We show that domain-authored rubrics provide substantially more reliable evaluation signals than LLM-authored rubrics (kappa = 0.60 vs. 0.46), and that human preference judgments confirm the same top-tier separation (p < 0.05), evidence that expert-grounded evaluation can scale without sacrificing reliability. We release public datasets and report results on two environments: Figma-to-code (33 real .fig tasks against the Figma API via MCP) and Programmatic content (41 courses comprising 183 individually-evaluated chapters on a course platform serving 30+ daily users).

AI.tldr: LH-Bench提出三支柱评估设计，用于评价LLM在主观性企业任务中的自主长时执行能力，包括专家接地评分规则、分层真实标注和成对人类偏好评估。研究表明专家编写的评分规则比LLM编写的更可靠（kappa 0.60 vs 0.46），并在Figma转代码和编程内容两个环境中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估局限于客观可验证任务（数学、编程），但真实企业工作具有主观性和上下文依赖性，需要新的评估范式来评价LLM在复杂多工具工作流中的表现。
AI.method: 提出三支柱评估设计：(i)专家接地评分规则，为LLM评判者提供领域上下文；(ii)分层真实标注artifact，支持逐步奖励信号（如内容任务的章节级标注）；(iii)成对人类偏好评估用于收敛验证。
AI.result: 专家编写的评分规则提供比LLM编写规则更可靠的评估信号（kappa=0.60 vs 0.46），人类偏好判断确认同一顶级分层（p<0.05），证明专家接地评估可规模化且不牺牲可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 专家接地评估设计能够可靠地评价LLM在主观企业任务上的表现，为长时自主执行提供可扩展的评估框架。

title: A Multi-Task Targeted Learning Framework for Lithium-Ion Battery State-of-Health and Remaining Useful Life
summary: Accurately predicting the state-of-health (SOH) and remaining useful life (RUL) of lithium-ion batteries is crucial for ensuring the safe and efficient operation of electric vehicles while minimizing associated risks. However, current deep learning methods are limited in their ability to selectively extract features and model time dependencies for these two parameters. Moreover, most existing methods rely on traditional recurrent neural networks, which have inherent shortcomings in long-term time-series modeling. To address these issues, this paper proposes a multi-task targeted learning framework for SOH and RUL prediction, which integrates multiple neural networks, including a multi-scale feature extraction module, an improved extended LSTM, and a dual-stream attention module. First, a feature extraction module with multi-scale CNNs is designed to capture detailed local battery decline patterns. Secondly, an improved extended LSTM network is employed to enhance the model's ability to retain long-term temporal information, thus improving temporal relationship modeling. Building on this, the dual-stream attention module-comprising polarized attention and sparse attention to selectively focus on key information relevant to SOH and RUL, respectively, by assigning higher weights to important features. Finally, a many-to-two mapping is achieved through the dual-task layer. To optimize the model's performance and reduce the need for manual hyperparameter tuning, the Hyperopt optimization algorithm is used. Extensive comparative experiments on battery aging datasets demonstrate that the proposed method reduces the average RMSE for SOH and RUL predictions by 111.3\% and 33.0\%, respectively, compared to traditional and state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向锂离子电池 SOH 与 RUL 的多任务定向学习框架（FEM + 改进扩展 LSTM + 双流注意力 + 双任务层 + Hyperopt 调参），在 NASA、CALCE、XJTU、Oxford、MIT 五个公开老化数据集上联合端到端预测两参数，相对传统与 SOTA 方法平均 RMSE 分别降低约 111.3%（SOH）与 33.0%（RUL）。
AI.motivation: 锂电池 SOH 与 RUL 是电池管理系统（BMS）中最关键的性能指标，直接关系到电动汽车的安全与高效运行。现有研究存在三方面不足：(1) 基于模型的方法（等效电路模型 ECM、电化学模型 EM）依赖大量物理参数、对外部因素敏感，泛化性差，难以适应多样电池类型与老化阶段；(2) 数据驱动方法中，传统 ML（SVM、RF、XGBoost、GP）可扩展性有限，CNN 缺乏时序依赖建模能力，RNN/LSTM/GRU 存在记忆容量小、长期时序建模不足的固有缺陷，难以准确刻画长周期电池退化；(3) 大多数联合预测工作采用"两步式"框架——先用 NN 预测 SOH，再将预测 SOH 作为输入估计 RUL，该方式存在三处问题：仅由 SOH 推断 RUL 会因二次利用/梯次利用等场景下退化轨迹差异而产生错配；SOH 误差会级联传播放大至 RUL；且未降低计算复杂度。此外，现有深度方法普遍缺少针对 SOH 与 RUL 两个差异性输出目标的"选择性特征提取与定向学习"机制，难以同时精准刻画"容量退化的局部形态"与"剩余寿命的长期趋势"。
AI.method:
框架整体由四部分串联构成：特征提取模块（FEM）、改进扩展 LSTM（IE-LSTM）、双流注意力模块（DSAM）、双任务层。

（1）多尺度 FEM：输入为原始充电/放电电压序列 X_i∈R^{L×1}，由 4 条不同尺度的一维 CNN 分支（Conv1–Conv5 + 激活函数 + MaxPool）并行提取局部退化形态后 concat 得到 X_i^FEM∈R^{L×C}；在分支 2/3/4 中引入 kernel=1 的降维卷积以降低计算量、扩大感受野；采用稀疏矩阵分解加速稠密矩阵运算。

（2）IE-LSTM（扩展 LSTM，源自 mLSTM 思路）：输入先经 Norm+Conv 得 x̃ 用于门控以稳定数值；输入门 i_t=exp(ĩ_t−m_t)、遗忘门 f_t=exp(f̃_t+m_{t−1}−m_t) 采用指数型门控以替代固定 sigmoid，提升对特征突变与噪声的自适应响应；引入新状态变量 m_t（max 归一化基准）与 n_t（累积状态），实现"混合数据存储"与对存储信息的定向修改，输出 h_t=o_t·c_t/n_t。

（3）DSAM 双流注意力：两支路均采用 Transformer 编码器架构（残差连接 + 层归一化）。SOH 支路采用极化注意力（Polarized Attention）：通道极化用全局平均池化 + 门控生成近二值通道权重，空间极化用动态阈值二值化定位关键电压片段（如恒压末端压降点），两分支串联；RUL 支路采用稀疏注意力（Sparse Attention）：仅保留每个时间步与最相关位置的连接，U=c·ln L、S=L·ln L，以稀疏矩阵 Q̄ 计算注意力后 Pad 回 L×C，降低计算复杂度并强化长时依赖。

（4）双任务层：两个独立 MLP（两层全连接 + 激活）分别由 DSAM-SOH 与 DSAM-RUL 输出，实现"多对一→二"的 many-to-two 联合映射。

训练：Adam 优化器 + MSE 损失，Hyperopt 搜索超参（FFN 神经元 64、任务层 128、稀疏注意力头数 4、扩展 LSTM 神经元 128；epoch=50，batch=32，初始 lr=1e-4/8，7 轮后 warm-up 至 1e-4，随后每轮衰减至 75%）。

数据：NASA/CALCE/XJTU/Oxford/MIT 五个数据集各取 4 个电池（共 20 个电芯），按 3 训练/1 测试划分，观测循环数分别为 20/50/20/10/40；NASA 插值至 4000 点、CALCE 插值至 1200 点；NASA B0007 与 MIT 50_CH32 未达 EOL 故仅做 SOH 预测。指标为 MAE/RMSE/MAPE（SOH）与 MAE/RMSE/MedAE（RUL）。另设非完整充电数据实验：用 4 个电压相关特征因子（恒流充电起始到峰值时间、3.9–4.1V 平台持续时间、3.6–4.0V 段电压上升斜率、CC 段电压-时间积分）替代完整曲线。
AI.result:
消融实验（5 个数据集）表明完整模型（FEM+IE-LSTM+DSAM）一致最优：移除 FEM、IE-LSTM、DSAM 后，NASA 上 SOH 平均 MAE 分别上升 111.0%、164.9%、53.7%，RUL 平均 RMSE 分别上升 24.6%、17.1%、26.6%；XJTU 上 RUL RMSE 最多上升 204.6%；Oxford 上 SOH MAE 最高上升 253.6%。

与通用网络（CNN、LSTM、TCN、Transformer）相比，SOH 的 MAE/RMSE/MAPE 平均提升 161.0%、123.4%、158.7%，RUL 的 MAE/RMSE/MedAE 平均提升 36.1%、32.4%、34.2%；与文献 SOTA 方法对比，在 B0005/B0006/CS2_35/CS2_36 上多数指标最优（如 B0005 SOH MAE 0.46%、RMSE 0.72%，RUL MAE 2.97、RMSE 3.71）。摘要给出平均 RMSE 相对传统与 SOTA 方法分别降低 111.3%（SOH）与 33.0%（RUL）。

最终 20 个电芯结果：SOH 平均 MAE 在 NASA/CALCE/XJTU/Oxford/MIT 上分别为 0.53%、0.68%、0.47%、0.38%、0.78%；RUL 平均 MAE 分别为 4.01、40.27、16.94、0.68、19.22。总体精度达到 SOH 平均 MAE/RMSE/MAPE 低于 0.60%/0.76%/0.72%，RUL 低于 16.74/21.83/13.37。非完整充电数据实验下，SOH 平均 MAE/RMSE/MAPE 为 1.00%/1.23%/1.37%，RUL 平均 MAE/RMSE/MedAE 为 4.54/6.25/2.55，仍保持较好精度。

作者指出：不同观测循环起点下性能稳定（如 NASA 观测循环实验 SOH 平均 MAE 0.65%、RMSE 0.92%、MAPE 0.90%）；但临近 EOL 的长静置会放大容量再生现象，导致中期 RUL/SOH 预测偏差偏大；电池到达 EOL 后 RUL 恒为 0，映射关系简化反而使精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的多任务定向学习框架通过"多尺度 CNN 特征提取 + 指数门控扩展 LSTM 长期记忆 + 极化/稀疏双流注意力定向学习 + 双任务层联合映射"的组合，实现 SOH 与 RUL 的端到端联合预测，摆脱了传统两步式框架的误差级联与退化轨迹错配问题；结合 Hyperopt 自动调参显著降低人工调参成本。在五个公开数据集、20 个电芯上的对比与消融实验验证了各模块（尤其 DSAM 的任务特异性权重分配与 IE-LSTM 的长期记忆增强）的有效性，精度优于 CNN/LSTM/TCN/Transformer 及多项文献 SOTA 方法。局限与未来工作：需采集大容量电池的长期循环充放电数据、利用五年以上大规模 EV 运行数据验证工程价值，并针对梯次利用/退役转售等不同退化轨迹扩展寿命后段预测能力；同时 EOL 附近静置导致的容量再生引起的误差增大问题仍待解决。

title: Evaluating LLM-Based Test Generation Under Software Evolution
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated unit test generation. However, it remains unclear whether these tests reflect genuine reasoning about program behavior or simply reproduce superficial patterns learned during training. If the latter dominates, LLM-generated tests may exhibit weaknesses such as reduced coverage, missed regressions, and undetected faults. Understanding how LLMs generate tests and how those tests respond to code evolution is therefore essential. We present a large-scale empirical study of LLM-based test generation under program changes. Using an automated mutation-driven framework, we analyze how generated tests react to semantic-altering changes (SAC) and semantic-preserving changes (SPC) across eight LLMs and 22,374 program variants.
  LLMs achieve strong baseline results, reaching 79% line coverage and 76% branch coverage with fully passing test suites on the original programs. However, performance degrades as programs evolve. Under SACs, the pass rate of newly generated tests drops to 66%, and branch coverage declines to 60%. More than 99% of failing SAC tests pass on the original program while executing the modified region, indicating residual alignment with the original behavior rather than adaptation to updated semantics. Performance also declines under SPCs despite unchanged functionality: pass rates fall to 79% and branch coverage to 69%. Although SPC edits preserve semantics, they often introduce larger syntactic changes, leading to instability in generated test suites. Models generate more new tests while discarding many baseline tests, suggesting sensitivity to lexical changes rather than true semantic impact. Overall, our results indicate that current LLM-based test generation relies heavily on surface-level cues and struggles to maintain regression awareness as programs evolve.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实证研究，分析了大语言模型(LLM)在程序变化下的单元测试生成能力。研究发现LLM在原始程序上表现良好(79%行覆盖率、76%分支覆盖率)，但在程序演进时性能显著下降：语义变更下通过率降至66%、分支覆盖率降至60%；语义保持变更下通过率降至79%、分支覆盖率降至69%。研究表明当前LLM测试生成主要依赖表层线索而非深层语义理解。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在自动化单元测试生成中的广泛应用，其生成的测试是否真正反映程序行为的推理，还是仅复制训练中习得的表面模式，这一问题尚不明确。理解LLM如何生成测试以及测试如何响应代码演进至关重要。
AI.method: 使用自动化突变驱动框架，对8个LLM和22,374个程序变体进行大规模实证研究，分析生成的测试对语义变更(SAC)和语义保持变更(SPC)的反应。
AI.result: LLM在原始程序上达到79%行覆盖率和76%分支覆盖率的良好基线。SAC下新生成测试通过率降至66%，分支覆盖率降至60%，超过99%的失败测试在原程序上通过但执行修改区域，表明测试与原行为对齐而非适应新语义。SPC下尽管功能不变，但通过率降至79%、分支覆盖率降至69%，因语义保持变更常引入较大语法变化，导致测试套件不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 当前基于LLM的测试生成严重依赖表层线索，对词汇变化敏感而非真正的语义影响，在程序演进时难以保持回归感知能力。

title: CLiGNet: Clinical Label-Interaction Graph Network for Medical Specialty Classification from Clinical Transcriptions
summary:
Automated classification of clinical transcriptions into medical specialties is essential for routing, coding, and clinical decision support, yet prior work on the widely used MTSamples benchmark suffers from severe data leakage caused by applying SMOTE oversampling before train test splitting. We first document this methodological flaw and establish a leakage free benchmark across 40 medical specialties (4966 records), revealing that the true task difficulty is substantially higher than previously reported.
  We then introduce CLiGNet (Clinical Label Interaction Graph Network), a neural architecture that combines a Bio ClinicalBERT text encoder with a two layer Graph Convolutional Network operating on a specialty label graph constructed from semantic similarity and ICD 10 chapter priors. Per label attention gates fuse document and label graph representations, trained with focal binary cross entropy loss to handle extreme class imbalance (181 to 1 ratio).
  Across seven baselines ranging from TF IDF classifiers to Clinical Longformer, CLiGNet without calibration achieves the highest macro F1 of 0.279, with an ablation study confirming that the GCN label graph provides the single largest component gain (increase of 0.066 macro F1). Adding per label Platt scaling calibration yields an expected calibration error of 0.007, demonstrating a principled trade off between ranking performance and probability reliability.
  We provide comprehensive failure analysis covering pairwise specialty confusions, rare class behaviour, document length effects, and token level Integrated Gradients attribution, offering actionable insights for clinical NLP system deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文指出广泛使用的 MTSamples 基准存在严重数据泄漏（在划分训练/测试集之前先做 SMOTE 过采样），纠正后建立无泄漏的 40 类（4,966 条记录）临床专科分类基准，发现真实任务难度远高于以往报告（最高准确率仅 0.362，macro-F1 仅 0.279，此前文献报告准确率 >0.90）。作者提出 CLiGNet：以 Bio_ClinicalBERT（滑窗编码）为文本编码器，在由语义相似度 + ICD-10 章节先验构建的 40 节点专科标签图上执行两层 GCN，再用逐标签注意力门控融合文档表示与图增强标签表示，配合带逆频率权重的 focal BCE 损失应对 181:1 的极端类别不平衡。消融显示 GCN 标签图贡献最大（macro-F1 +0.066），逐标签 Platt 校准使 ECE 降至 0.007 但牺牲 0.039 macro-F1，形成"排序性能 vs 概率可靠性"的有原则权衡；并提供混淆对、稀有类、文档长度与 Integrated Gradients 归因的系统性失效分析。
AI.motivation: 临床转录文本的自动专科分类对医疗编码、患者分流与临床决策支持至关重要，MTSamples（4,999 条、40 个专科）是该任务最常用的公开基准。然而既有工作（Almazaydeh et al., 2023；Guleria, 2025）在划分训练/测试集之前就执行 SMOTE 过采样，使合成少数类样本携带了本应属于留出集的信息，造成严重数据泄漏，报告出 >0.90 的虚高准确率。此外，既有方法把 40 个专科视为相互独立的类别，忽略了专科间的语义与医学本体结构（如 Cardiovascular/Pulmonary 与 Consult-H&P 词汇高度重叠，Surgery 文本常跨多器官系统）。本文动机为：(1) 记录并纠正基准层面的泄漏问题，建立干净可复现的无泄漏基准与显著性检验；(2) 首次将基于 GCN 的标签图推理引入临床专科分类，显式建模标签间的结构关系。
AI.method: 数据与划分：MTSamples 清洗掉 33 条空转录后剩 4,966 条、40 类单标签；分层划分 70/15/15（3,476/745/745），最大类 Surgery 1,088 条、最小类 Hospice 6 条（181:1），11 类训练样本 <20，中位长度 398 词，34.9% 文档超 512 token。方法四组件：(1) Bio_ClinicalBERT 文本编码，512 窗口/128 步长/最多 4 chunk，[CLS] 均值池化为 h_doc∈R^768，冻结前 6/12 层；(2) 标签图 G：40 节点，节点特征由每专科至多 30 篇训练文档的 Bio_ClinicalBERT 嵌入均值池化；边由余弦相似度 s_ij 加同 ICD-10 章节奖励 b_ij=0.20，超过阈值 τ=0.30 即连边，邻接矩阵对称归一化 Â=D^{-1/2}(A+I)D^{-1/2}；(3) 两层 GCN（768→512→256，ReLU，dropout 0.3）产出图增强标签表示 h_k^(2)；(4) 逐标签注意力门控 α_k=σ(W_k[h_proj‖h_k^(2)])，融合 z_k=α_k·h_proj+(1−α_k)·h_k^(2)，逐标签线性头 + sigmoid 预测；训练用 focal BCE（γ=2.0，逆频率权重 α_k）替代 SMOTE；再对验证集 logits 做逐标签 Platt 缩放（L-BFGS 拟合 sigmoid），并网格搜索（步长 0.01）逐标签阈值。优化：AdamW，分离学习率（BERT 2e-5 / 分类头 1e-3），weight decay 0.01，cosine annealing + 10% warmup，梯度裁剪 1.0，batch 16 + 梯度累积 2 步，patience=5 早停，最多 30 epoch，seed 42。基线：B1 TF-IDF+LR、B2 TF-IDF+OvR-SVC、B3 Bio_ClinicalBERT+OvR、B4 BioBERT+OvR、B7 Clinical-Longformer+BR、B6 CLiGNet 无校准、B8 完整版；消融 A1 去 GCN、A2 去 focal、A4 去滑窗、A5 去逐标签阈值；评估 macro/micro-F1、准确率、Hamming loss、ECE，McNemar 检验 + Bonferroni 校正（α=0.0083）；解释性用 per-label Integrated Gradients。
AI.result: 主结果（测试集）：B6 CLiGNet 无校准最佳，macro-F1 0.279 / micro-F1 0.362 / Acc 0.362 / Hamming 0.032；B8 完整版 macro-F1 0.240、ECE 0.007；B7 Clinical-Longformer macro-F1 0.262、Acc 0.336（未显著优于 B3 的 0.344 准确率，说明更长上下文本身不足）；B3 ClinicalBERT 0.211、B4 BioBERT 0.172、B1 TF-IDF+LR 0.173、B2 TF-IDF+SVC 0.099——没有任何方法 macro-F1 超过 0.30。显著性：B8 显著优于两个 TF-IDF 基线（p<0.001），但与 B3/B4/B6/B7 的差异在 Bonferroni 校正下均不显著（p=0.845/0.340/0.274/0.949），说明 745 条测试集统计功效有限。消融（相对 B6）：去 GCN 降幅最大 −0.066，去 focal −0.013，去滑窗 −0.008，去逐标签阈值 −0.009；GCN 贡献约占相对 B3 提升的 75%；A2/A4 的 micro-F1（0.366/0.379）反高于 B6（0.362），体现 macro–micro 权衡，focal 与多 chunk 池化主要改善稀有类。失效分析：General Medicine→Consult-H&P 混淆率 66.7%，Urology→Surgery 69.6%，Surgery→Gastro/Ortho/Cardio-Pulm 各 12.9–14.7%；按训练规模分箱 mean F1 单调递增（0–20:0.271、20–50:0.316、50–100:0.447、100–500:0.410、500+:0.596），9 个 <15 样本专科 F1=0，但 Autopsy（6 样本）F1=1.0、Sleep Medicine（14 样本）0.80；准确率随文档长度呈倒 U 型（400–600 词最高 0.371，>1000 词降至 0.286）。Integrated Gradients 显示 Autopsy 高分词为 clothing(+0.132)、pupils(+0.076)、rigor，Allergy/Immunology 仅归因于 subjective(−0.224)、objective(−0.166) 等通用 SOAP 模板词。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是对 MTSamples 基准的方法学纠偏（揭示真实 macro-F1 仅约 0.28，而非此前报告的 0.98 准确率），并提出结合领域预训练编码器与标签图 GCN、focal loss 与逐标签校准的 CLiGNet 架构；消融证明 GCN 标签图是最大的单组件增益来源，验证了结构化标签建模在临床文本分类中的价值，同时 Platt 校准在 macro-F1 与概率可靠性（ECE 0.007）之间提供有原则的权衡，二者对临床分诊/决策支持场景意义不同。局限包括：数据规模小、11 类样本 <20 导致显著性检验功效低与稀有类 F1 估计不稳；标签图为静态一次性构建，未随训练自适应；仅在 MTSamples 上评测，需在 MIMIC-III 等更大语料上验证泛化性；未与 LLM 的少样本/零样本方案对比。作者提出的未来方向为：更大规模临床语料验证、训练期动态标签图构建、以及与 LLM 的少样本对比。

title: DAQ: Delta-Aware Quantization for Post-Training LLM Weight Compression
summary: We introduce Delta-Aware Quantization (DAQ), a data-free post-training quantization framework that preserves the knowledge acquired during post-training. Standard quantization objectives minimize reconstruction error but are agnostic to the base model, allowing quantization noise to disproportionately corrupt the small-magnitude parameter deltas ($ΔW$) that encode post-training behavior -- an effect we analyze through the lens of quantization as implicit regularization. DAQ replaces reconstruction-based objectives with two delta-aware metrics -- Sign Preservation Rate and Cosine Similarity -- that directly optimize for directional fidelity of $ΔW$, requiring only the base and post-trained weight matrices. In a pilot FP8 study, DAQ recovers style-specific capabilities lost under standard quantization while maintaining general performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Delta-Aware Quantization (DAQ)，一种数据无关的后训练量化框架，通过量化即隐式正则化的视角分析发现标准重建目标会不成比例地破坏编码后训练行为的微小幅度参数增量ΔW。DAQ用Sign Preservation Rate和Cosine Similarity两个指标替代重建目标，直接优化ΔW的方向保真度，仅需基础模型和后训练权重矩阵。在FP8实验中，DAQ在保持通用性能的同时恢复了标准量化丢失的特定风格能力。
AI.motivation: 标准后训练量化方法最小化重建误差，但对基础模型无感知。量化噪声会不成比例地破坏编码后训练知识的微小幅度参数增量ΔW，导致模型在基础能力保持的情况下丢失后训练获得的能力（如风格迁移）。现有重建目标缺乏对ΔW的保护机制。
AI.method: 提出量化即隐式正则化的理论分析框架，将量化过程理解为对参数空间的正则化约束。在此基础上，用两个delta-aware指标替代重建目标：(1) Sign Preservation Rate衡量ΔW符号一致性；(2) Cosine Similarity衡量ΔW方向保真度。该方法数据无关，仅需预训练和后训练权重矩阵即可。
AI.result: FP8量化实验表明，DAQ在维持通用性能的同时，成功恢复了标准量化丢失的风格特定能力，验证了delta-aware优化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接优化后训练增量的方向保真度而非重建误差，DAQ能有效保护模型的后训练知识，为数据受限场景下的后训练量化提供了新思路。

title: Code Review Agent Benchmark
summary:
Software engineering agents have shown significant promise in writing code. As AI agents permeate code writing, and generate huge volumes of code automatically -- the matter of code quality comes front and centre. As the automatically generated code gets integrated into huge code-bases -- the issue of code review and broadly quality assurance becomes important. In this paper, we take a fresh look at the problem and curate a code review dataset for AI agents to work with. Our dataset called c-CRAB (pronounced see-crab) can evaluate agents for code review tasks. Specifically given a pull-request (which could be coming from code generation agents or humans), if a code review agent produces a review, our evaluation framework can asses the reviewing capability of the code review agents. Our evaluation framework is used to evaluate the state of the art today -- the open-source PR-agent, as well as commercial code review agents from Devin, Claude Code, and Codex.
  Our c-CRAB dataset is systematically constructed from human reviews -- given a human review of a pull request instance we generate corresponding tests to evaluate the code review agent generated reviews. Such a benchmark construction gives us several insights. Firstly, the existing review agents taken together can solve only around 40% of the c-CRAB tasks, indicating the potential to close this gap by future research. Secondly, we observe that the agent reviews often consider different aspects from the human reviews -- indicating the potential for human-agent collaboration for code review that could be deployed in future software teams. Last but not the least, the agent generated tests from our data-set act as a held out test-suite and hence quality gate for agent generated reviews. What this will mean for future collaboration of code generation agents, test generation agents and code review agents -- remains to be investigated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 c-CRAB（“see-crab”）——首个以“可执行测试”作为评价预言机（oracle）的自动化代码评审（automated code review）基准数据集。该基准基于 SWE-CARE 的真实开源 PR，通过四阶段流水线将人类评审评论转换为「在原始 patch 上失败、在修复后版本上通过」的可执行测试，用以客观衡量评审智能体是否发现了与人类评审相同的问题。实验评估了开源 PR-Agent 与商业工具 Devin Review、Claude Code、Codex：自动化工具的整体通过率为 20.1%–32.1%，四者并集仅覆盖 41.5%（97/234）的测试，而人类评审通过率为 100%。但人工核查显示自动化评审评论中 84% 仍然有用，说明低通过率源自人类与 AI 关注点不同（AI 偏向 robustness/testing，较少覆盖 design/documentation/maintainability），二者互补而非替代。
AI.motivation: 随着软件工程智能体大规模自动生成代码并提交 PR，人类评审的产能未能同步扩张，成为开发流程瓶颈；因此需要自动化代码评审工具。但如何客观评估这些工具是否真正「发现了与人类评审相同的问题」仍无定论。现有评测方式存在明显缺陷：(1) BLEU/ROUGE/chrF 等 n-gram 重叠与嵌入相似度只衡量措辞相似，而人类评审评论本身含澄清提问、主观风格建议等噪声，同一问题用不同表述表述会被低判；(2) 定位（localization）类指标只看问题是否出现在相同代码位置，忽略问题实质；(3) LLM-as-a-judge 对提示敏感、随机性大、可复现性差，且无法区分「指出同一问题但修复方案不同」的评论（如把 CharField 换成 TextField vs 仅调大 max_length）。因此需要一种以行为验证为准绳、客观、可复现、可规模化的评测框架。
AI.method:
核心思想：把「评审评论的价值」定义为「它能否引导编码智能体做出行为正确的修复」，因此将人类评审评论转换为可执行测试作为评价预言机。

基准构建（基于 SWE-CARE 提供的带 commit 元数据的 PR 实例，管线与数据集无关，可迁移到任何满足元数据要求的 PR）：
1) 评审过滤：人工标注 100 条评论构建小规模金标准集 D（两名作者独立标注高质量/低质量并讨论消解分歧），迭代精炼 LLM 提示直至在金标准集上达到预设精度阈值，再用其过滤其余评论（剔除对话式、致谢、不可验证类评论）。
2) 可执行环境构建：为每个 PR 构建独立 Docker 镜像（克隆仓库并检出目标 commit，启发式脚本构建器根据 setup.py / pyproject.toml 推断依赖与版本生成安装脚本与 Dockerfile）；对历史 PR 依赖约束过松导致构建失败的情况，用隔离环境中的自动化编码智能体审计依赖版本并覆写安装脚本；构建后校验可编辑安装与依赖完整性。
3) NL 评论转测试：对每条评论 c 及文件 f，输入为（评论与对应 diff hunk、PR head 的 before 版本仓库状态、问题修复后的 after 版本仓库状态），先用 diff 元数据将评论对齐到代码区域并检索 before/after 两版完整文件内容，再提示 LLM 生成候选测试；执行结果须满足「before 失败、after 通过」，否则把执行轨迹与报错回传给编码智能体进行执行引导的迭代修正（最多三次尝试）。由此每个实例对应一条可执行预言机。
4) 编码智能体验证：对每个实例，用人类评论（不暴露测试）指导编码智能体修改 patch，若在固定尝试次数内仍无法让测试通过，则丢弃该实例，以确保评测失败可归因于评审质量而非智能体能力。

评测流程：先让评审工具对 184 个 PR 实例生成评论，再由同一编码智能体依据这些评论修订 patch，执行修订后的 patch 与对应测试集；实例级得分 s_i 为通过测试占比，整体为跨实例的测试通过率（等价于以人类评审为基准的真实正率，不评估人类未提及的额外评论）。
实现：GPT-5.2 负责评审过滤与评论转测试（最多三次带执行反馈的尝试）；编码智能体统一使用 Claude Code + Sonnet-4.6 后端；实验环境为 Ubuntu 20.04 服务器。构建于 SWE-CARE 之上。

人工质量保障：随机抽 50 个实例，两名作者独立判断生成测试是否忠实体现原评论，分歧讨论消解，一致率 84%，剩余分歧主要来自评论覆盖不完整与测试对特定实现的过拟合。
AI.result:
数据规模：初始 671 个 PR / 1313 条评论 → 过滤后 410 / 595 → 环境构建后仍 410 / 595 → 转为测试后 339 / 481 → 最终验证通过 184 个 PR 实例、234 条测试，覆盖 67（正文另处称 56）个仓库；平均修改 418.1 行，平均每实例 1.27 个测试，测试平均 31.8 行；测试中行为型 42 条（17.9%）、结构型 192 条（82.1%）。

RQ1 性能（通过率 %）：Claude Code 32.1（行为 38.1 / 结构 30.7，共 1336 条评论、7.3 条/PR）；Codex 20.1（38.1 / 16.1，324 条、1.8 条/PR）；Devin 24.8（31.0 / 23.4，1344 条、7.3 条/PR）；PR-Agent 23.1（38.1 / 19.8，524 条、2.8 条/PR）；人类 100。四工具并集仅 97/234（41.5%）测试被至少一个工具通过，人机之间仍存在显著差距。

人工标注的评论有用性（6 个 PR、92 条评论）：Claude Code 31/40（78%）、Codex 7/8（88%）、Devin 22/26（85%）、PR-Agent 17/18（94%），整体 77/92 = 84% 有用——说明低通过率并非因评审质量差，而是关注点错位。

RQ2 类别分析（人工两阶段标注 10 类）：AI 工具在 security、efficiency、compatibility、error handling 上的占比与人类相当，但在 design、documentation、maintainability 上明显偏低（这些类别高度依赖仓库特定惯例，工具难以从 patch 推断）；AI 则更频繁提出 robustness 与 testing 类意见（可能带来更多误报、维护者负担）。按人类评论类别统计通过率：robustness 与 functional correctness 较高，documentation 与 design 很低，maintainability 仅 7.9%–27.0%。
AI.conclusion: 主要结论与启示：(1) 现有 SOTA 代码评审智能体仅能识别 c-CRAB 中约 40% 的人类已发现问题，未来研究仍有较大提升空间；(2) 自动化评审与人类评审关注面不同，人类与 AI 更适合做互补式协作（自动化工具更擅长局部化的健壮性/正确性问题，人类更擅长依赖仓库上下文的设计、文档、可维护性问题）；(3) 可执行测试不仅是评测预言机，也可作为代码评审智能体的训练信号与质量门控（held-out test suite）；(4) 仓库特定上下文（如架构文档、风格指南、AGENTS.md 等面向智能体的说明、历史评审记录）是提升工具效果的关键缺失要素，建议工具接地更丰富的项目上下文。(5) 对实践者与工具开发者分别给出落地建议。作者亦讨论了内外部效度与构念效度威胁：评测依赖编码智能体能力（通过统一智能体与人类评论预验证缓解）、源自 SWE-CARE 带来的代表性限制（管线可扩展）、LLM 过滤器的边界样本问题（以严格 fail-then-pass 与双标注缓解）。复现包已开源于 https://github.com/c-CRAB-Benchmark。

title: Can LLM Agents Generate Real-World Evidence? Evaluating Observational Studies in Medical Databases
summary: Observational studies can yield clinically actionable evidence at scale, but executing them on real-world databases is open-ended and requires coherent decisions across cohort construction, analysis, and reporting. Prior evaluations of LLM agents emphasize isolated steps or single answers, missing the integrity and internal structure of the resulting evidence bundle. To address this gap, we introduce RWE-bench, a benchmark grounded in MIMIC-IV and derived from peer-reviewed observational studies. Each task provides the corresponding study protocol as the reference standard, requiring agents to execute experiments in a real database and iteratively generate tree-structured evidence bundles. We evaluate six LLMs (three open-source, three closed-source) under three agent scaffolds using both question-level correctness and end-to-end task metrics. Across 162 tasks, task success is low: the best agent reaches 39.9%, and the best open-source model reaches 30.4%. Agent scaffolds also matter substantially, causing over 30% variation in performance metrics. Furthermore, we implement an automated cohort evaluation method to rapidly localize errors and identify agent failure modes. Overall, the results highlight persistent limitations in agents' ability to produce end-to-end evidence bundles, and efficient validation remains an important direction for future work. Code and data are available at https://github.com/somewordstoolate/RWE-bench.

AI.tldr: RWE-bench是一个基于MIMIC-IV数据库的基准测试框架，用于评估LLM智能体在真实世界观察性研究中的端到端证据生成能力。研究发现当前最佳智能体的任务成功率仅为39.9%，且智能体框架选择对性能影响超过30%，表明现有模型在生成完整证据链方面仍存在显著局限。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体评估存在碎片化问题，仅关注孤立步骤或单一答案，忽视了生成证据的完整性和内部结构。观察性研究虽能产生可扩展的临床证据，但在真实数据库上执行需要跨队列构建、分析和报告的连贯决策，目前缺乏系统性评估框架。
AI.method: 提出RWE-bench基准，基于MIMIC-IV数据库并参照同行评审的观察性研究设计任务，每个任务提供对应研究方案作为参考标准。评估6种LLM（3种开源+3种闭源）在3种智能体框架下的表现，采用问题级正确性和端到端任务指标双重评估，并实现自动化队列评估方法以定位错误和识别失败模式。
AI.result: 162个任务结果显示任务成功率普遍较低：最佳智能体达39.9%，最佳开源模型仅30.4%。智能体框架对性能影响显著，造成超过30%的性能差异。自动化队列评估方法有效识别了智能体的多种失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM智能体在生成端到端证据链方面存在持续性局限。智能体框架设计对性能有实质性影响。开发高效验证方法是该领域未来研究的重要方向。

title: Hybrid Associative Memories
summary: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and self-attention are both widely used sequence-mixing layers that maintain an internal memory. However, this memory is constructed using two orthogonal mechanisms: RNNs compress the entire past into a fixed-size state, whereas self-attention's state stores every past time step growing its state (the KV cache) linearly with the sequence length. This results in orthogonal strengths and weaknesses. Self-attention layers excel at retrieving information in the context but have large memory and computational costs, while RNNs are more efficient but degrade over longer contexts and underperform for precise recall tasks. Prior work combining these mechanisms has focused primarily on naively interleaving them to reduce computational cost without regard to their complementary mechanisms. We propose the Hybrid Associative Memory (HAM) layer, which combines self-attention and RNNs while leveraging their individual strengths: the RNN compresses the entire sequence, while attention supplements it *only* with information that is difficult for the RNN to predict, which is hence the most valuable information to explicitly store. HAM layers enable data-dependent growth of the KV cache, which can be precisely controlled by the user with a single, continuous threshold. We find that this fine-grained control of the KV cache growth rate has a smooth trade-off with loss and performance. Empirically, we show that our hybrid architecture offers strong, competitive performance relative to RNNs and Transformers even at substantially lower KV-cache usage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合关联记忆（HAM）层，融合RNN和自注意力机制，利用RNN压缩序列的能力和注意力补充难以预测信息的能力，实现KV缓存的数据依赖性增长，并通过单一连续阈值精确控制缓存增长速率，在降低计算成本的同时保持竞争力性能。
AI.motivation: RNN和自注意力具有互补的优缺点：RNN将全部历史压缩为固定大小状态，计算高效但在长上下文下性能下降；自注意力保存所有历史时间步，检索能力强但内存和计算成本随序列长度线性增长。现有工作简单交错这两种机制，仅关注降低计算成本，未利用其互补特性。
AI.method: HAM层核心设计：(1) RNN压缩整个序列；(2) 自注意力仅补充RNN难以预测的信息（高价值显式存储信息）；(3) 实现KV缓存的数据依赖性增长；(4) 提供单一连续阈值供用户精确控制缓存增长速率，实现缓存大小与性能之间的细粒度权衡。
AI.result: 实验表明，HAM架构在显著降低KV缓存使用量的同时，仍能保持与RNN和Transformer相当甚至更强的竞争力性能。KV缓存增长率与损失/性能之间存在平滑的权衡曲线。
AI.conclusion: HAM通过数据依赖的方式动态分配存储资源，将注意力计算集中在RNN难以建模的高价值信息上，为长序列处理提供了一种高效且可调控的解决方案。

title: ConceptCoder: Improve Code Reasoning via Concept Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promising results for software engineering applications, but still struggle with code reasoning tasks such as vulnerability detection (VD). We introduce ConceptCoder, a fine-tuning method that simulates human code inspection: models are trained to first recognize code concepts and then perform reasoning on top of these concepts. In prior work, concepts are extracted by multimodal models or LLMs to explain vision and natural language models. Our work is the first to formulate concepts for code. We define code concepts as human-understandable semantic properties of code and train models to learn such concepts. Our evaluation shows that this approach significantly improves VD accuracy, from 66.32 to 72.15 F1 on average over 9 open-source LLMs. ConceptCoder achieves the best VD performance compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines, including fine-tuned SOTA open-source LLMs and prompted proprietary models such as GPT-5.2 and Claude-Opus-4.5. Our approach also scales: concepts defined from four types of vulnerabilities benefit general vulnerability datasets with 134 CWEs. We further demonstrate that concept-based fine-tuning generalizes beyond VD and improves branch prediction. We release our code and datasets at https://figshare.com/s/1decab8232c653b44f71.

AI.tldr: ConceptCoder是一种新颖的微调方法，通过模拟人类代码审查过程——先识别代码概念，再基于概念进行推理——来提升代码漏洞检测（VD）性能。该方法将代码概念定义为人类可理解的代码语义属性，在9个开源LLM上平均将F1从66.32提升至72.15，并超越GPT-5.2和Claude-Opus-4.5等专有模型。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型在软件工程应用中表现出色，但在代码推理任务（如漏洞检测）上仍存在不足。现有方法缺乏对代码深层语义的理解能力，无法像人类工程师那样先识别代码概念再进行推理分析。
AI.method: 提出ConceptCoder微调方法：1）将代码概念定义为人类可理解的代码语义属性；2）训练模型识别代码概念；3）在概念基础上执行推理任务。实验涵盖9个开源LLM，并在134个CWE漏洞类型的数据集上验证泛化能力。
AI.result: 漏洞检测F1从66.32提升至72.15（平均）；超越SOTA基线包括微调开源LLM和GPT-5.2、Claude-Opus-4.5等提示式专有模型；4种漏洞类型的概念定义可泛化至134个CWE；概念微调可迁移至分支预测任务。
AI.conclusion: ConceptCoder通过概念驱动的微调范式有效提升代码推理能力，证明代码概念作为语义桥梁的可行性。该方法具有良好的可扩展性和任务迁移性，为代码智能分析提供了新思路。

title: AgriPestDatabase-v1.0: A Structured Insect Dataset for Training Agricultural Large Language Model
comment: Accepted in Artificial Super Intelligence Conference 2026 (Sponsored by KSU PLOT & IEEE CIS)
summary: Agricultural pest management increasingly relies on timely and accurate access to expert knowledge, yet high quality labeled data and continuous expert support remain limited, particularly for farmers operating in rural regions with unstable/no internet connectivity. At the same time, the rapid growth of AI and LLMs has created new opportunities to deliver practical decision support tools directly to end users in agriculture through compact and deployable systems. This work addresses (i) generating a structured insect information dataset, and (ii) adapting a lightweight LLM model ($\leq$ 7B) by fine tuning it for edge device uses in agricultural pest management. The textual data collection was done by reviewing and collecting information from available pest databases and published manuscripts on nine selected pest species. These structured reports were then reviewed and validated by a domain expert. From these reports, we constructed Q/A pairs to support model training and evaluation. A LoRA-based fine-tuning approach was applied to multiple lightweight LLMs and evaluated. Initial evaluation shows that Mistral 7B achieves an 88.9\% pass rate on the domain-specific Q/A task, substantially outperforming Qwen 2.5 7B (63.9\%), and LLaMA 3.1 8B (58.7\%). Notably, Mistral demonstrates higher semantic alignment (embedding similarity: 0.865) despite lower lexical overlap (BLEU: 0.097), indicating that semantic understanding and robust reasoning are more predictive of task success than surface-level conformity in specialized domains. By combining expert organized data, well-structured Q/A pairs, semantic quality control, and efficient model adaptation, this work contributes towards providing support for farmer facing agricultural decision support tools and demonstrates the feasibility of deploying compact, high-performing language models for practical field-level pest management guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了 AgriPestDatabase-v1.0：一个由专家审核、覆盖美国9种重要入侵害虫的分类结构化文本数据库（含生物学鉴定、地理分布、寄主、生活史、危害症状与IPM防治策略），并基于其自动生成多类型 Q/A 对，用 LoRA 对多个 ≤8B 开源轻量 LLM 进行监督微调。实验显示 Mistral-7B 在领域 Q/A 任务上综合得分 88.9%，显著优于 Qwen2.5-7B（63.9%）和 LLaMA-3.1-8B（58.7%）；尽管其 BLEU/ROUGE 词面重叠较低（0.0966），但嵌入语义相似度最高（0.865），说明语义理解与推理能力比表层措辞一致性更能决定任务成功率，验证了离线/边缘部署小型农业决策支持模型的可行性。
AI.motivation: 农业害虫管理依赖及时准确的专家知识，但高质量标注数据与持续专家支持不足，尤其在网络不稳定或无网络的农村地区；虽然 RAG（如 AgriRegion）、推理蒸馏（如 IPM-AgriGPT）等农业 LLM 方案有效，却带来外部知识库、索引管线、持久化存储和多阶段蒸馏等架构开销，与农村受限算力、间歇性连接和离线运行场景不兼容。开源与闭源模型性能差距到 2025 年初已缩小至 1.7%，使开源轻量模型成为领域适配的可行基础。作者因此转向"不依赖实时连接与外部数据库"的轻量本地可部署路线：参数 ≤8B 的开源模型在高质量领域语料上微调，兼顾可及性、韧性与公平性，使关键害虫情报在无可靠网络时仍能到达一线农民。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：从 USDA 网站、已发表文献与田间技术指南收集 9 种 2024 年全国调查优先入侵害虫资料（亚洲木虱、柑橘长蠹蛾、棉地老虎、白蜡窄吉丁、六齿小蠹、大松象甲、红棕榈甲、红环线虫、红头松锯蝇），按统一模板结构化为报告，覆盖生物学与鉴定（生活史、外部形态、寄主、分布）、IPM 管理（监测预警、化学/生物/栽培防治、检疫），并列入图像、基因组、种群监测等可用数据集；由田间专家与数据聚合者迭代交叉审核校验，并做主题建模（主题网络与频率分布）刻画语料结构。2) Q/A 构建：.docx 文本经正则清洗（保留标点与句界）→ 约 1000 token、滑动窗口 200 token 重叠的语义分块（向后回溯最多 100 字符对齐句末标点，避免断句）→ 用 TinyLlama 或 Mistral-7B 在结构化提示模板下按 factual/definition/reasoning/comparison/list/procedural 六类各生成 2 条、严格 JSON 输出的 12 条 Q/A，并附加来源文档与片段索引元数据；随后做语义质量控制、去重、数据增强与训练/测试划分（评测 n=2,510）。3) 模型适配：采用 LoRA/PEFT（权重低秩分解 W_new=W_base+BA，r∈{8,16,32}）对 Mistral-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 做 SFT，仅在响应 token 上计算交叉熵损失（响应掩码）；AdamW、学习率 5e-5、100 步 warm-up、梯度累积 8 步、每 200 步验证并早停（patience=3）；在单卡 NVIDIA H100（双路 Intel Xeon Gold 6548Y+、256GB 内存）GPU 集群上训练。4) 评测：BLEU、ROUGE-1/2/L 词面重叠，嵌入模型余弦相似度（归一化至 [0,1]），Token-F1 作为事实完整性的精确性护栏，以及综合通过率。
AI.result: 综合得分（n=2,510）：Mistral 7B 88.9% > Qwen2.5 7B 63.9% > LLaMA 3.1 8B 58.7%。词面指标却反向：LLaMA 3.1 8B BLEU 0.2049、ROUGE-1/2/L = 0.3680/0.2577/0.3338、Token-F1 0.4060 均最高；Qwen2.5 BLEU 0.1823、ROUGE 0.2968/0.2216/0.2741、F1 0.3736；Mistral 各项词面指标最低（BLEU 0.0966，ROUGE 0.1742/0.1618/0.1710，F1 0.3462），但嵌入相似度最高（0.865 对 0.8205、0.8164）。作者据此指出语义对齐与推理稳健性比表层措辞贴合更能预测任务成功，LLaMA 可能只是学会了参考文本的表述风格与格式惯例，掩盖了知识或推理缺口；Qwen 2.5 在语义与词面之间属性接近 Mistral，属均衡模型。Mistral 近零的精确匹配率提示评测数据格式敏感、短答案轻微偏差即判失败。案例分析显示成功回答在完整推理（棕榈科去虫需专业树艺师、兼顾安全与生物安全）与条件推理（红棕榈甲借灌溉与城市园艺可在非热带定殖）上表现良好；失败案例集中于生成长度截断与过度冗长、以及系统提示词泄漏（模型主动输出"我已确保每个回答格式规范"等训练语料中的说明性文字）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了"专家策展的结构化知识 + 监督微调"能在农业害虫管理 Q/A 任务上取得强领域表现，且不依赖实时网络与外部检索，便于离线/边缘设备部署，对小农户等资源受限用户具有现实意义；模型对语义连贯、领域内的中等歧义查询具备一定稳健性。作者指出后续方向包括：扩展到支持工具调用、决策支持工作流与运营方案设计的指令微调模型，并配套防止系统提示泄漏等网络风险的护栏机制；将文本文档与图像配对以支持害虫检测；继续按有害生物名录扩充物种以增强覆盖度与领域泛化；同时需通过进一步微调与生成温度/长度控制抑制冗长与截断问题，提高 Mistral 的总体准确率。数据集已开源（GitHub: SHAFNehal/AgriPestDatabase_USDA_TextDataBase_for_LLM_Training/），由 USDA APHIS《植物保护法》第7721条资助。

title: A Direct Classification Approach for Reliable Wind Ramp Event Forecasting under Severe Class Imbalance
summary: Decision support systems are essential for maintaining grid stability in low-carbon power systems, such as wind power plants, by providing real-time alerts to control room operators regarding potential events, including Wind Power Ramp Events (WPREs). These early warnings enable the timely initiation of more detailed system stability assessments and preventive actions. However, forecasting these events is challenging due to the inherent class imbalance in WPRE datasets, where ramp events are less frequent (typically less than 15\% of observed events) compared to normal conditions. Ignoring this characteristic undermines the performance of conventional machine learning models, which often favor the majority class. This paper introduces a novel methodology for WPRE forecasting as a multivariate time series classification task and proposes a data preprocessing strategy that extracts features from recent power observations and masks unavailable ramp information, making it integrable with traditional real-time ramp identification tools. Particularly, the proposed methodology combines majority-class undersampling and ensemble learning to enhance wind ramp event forecasting under class imbalance. Numerical simulations conducted on a real-world dataset demonstrate the superiority of our approach, achieving over 85% accuracy and 88% weighted F1 score, outperforming benchmark classifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文针对风电爬坡事件（WPRE）预测中的类别不平衡问题，提出了一种结合多数类欠采样和集成学习的多变量时间序列分类方法，在真实数据集上实现了超过85%的准确率和88%的加权F1分数，显著优于基准分类器。
AI.motivation: 在低碳电力系统中，风电爬坡事件（WPRE）对电网稳定性构成威胁。传统机器学习模型在处理WPRE数据集时存在严重的类别不平衡问题（爬坡事件通常仅占观测事件的不足15%），导致模型性能下降。现有方法往往忽略这一特性，难以提供可靠的实时预警。
AI.method: 1) 将WPRE预测重新定义为多变量时间序列分类任务；2) 设计数据预处理策略，从近期功率观测中提取特征并屏蔽不可用的爬坡信息；3) 结合多数类欠采样（majority-class undersampling）与集成学习（ensemble learning）应对类别不平衡；4) 可与传统实时爬坡识别工具集成。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的数值仿真表明，该方法达到超过85%的准确率和88%以上的加权F1分数，性能优于多个基准分类器。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于欠采样和集成学习的WPRE预测方法能有效解决类别不平衡问题，显著提升爬坡事件预测性能，为低碳电力系统的决策支持系统提供更可靠的实时预警能力。

title: ReqFusion: A Multi-Provider Framework for Automated PEGS Analysis Across Software Domains
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at VerifAI-2026 Workshop, co-located with ETAPS 2026
summary: Requirements engineering is a vital, yet labor-intensive, stage in the software development process. This article introduces ReqFusion: an AI-enhanced system that automates the extraction, classification, and analysis of software requirements utilizing multiple Large Language Model (LLM) providers. The architecture of ReqFusion integrates OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, and Groq models to extract functional and non-functional requirements from various documentation formats (PDF, DOCX, and PPTX) in academic, industrial, and tender proposal contexts. The system uses a domain-independent extraction method and generates requirements following the Project, Environment, Goal, and System (PEGS) approach introduced by Bertrand Meyer. The main idea is that, because the PEGS format is detailed, LLMs have more information and cues about the requirements, producing better results than a simple generic request. An ablation study confirms this hypothesis: PEGS-guided prompting achieves an F1 score of 0.88, compared to 0.71 for generic prompting under the same multi-provider configuration. The evaluation used 18 real-world documents to generate 226 requirements through automated classification, with 54.9% functional and 45.1% nonfunctional across academic, business, and technical domains. An extended evaluation on five projects with 1,050 requirements demonstrated significant improvements in extraction accuracy and a 78% reduction in analysis time compared to manual methods. The multi-provider architecture enhances reliability through model consensus and fallback mechanisms, while the PEGS-based approach ensures comprehensive coverage of all requirement categories.

AI.tldr: ReqFusion是一个利用多个LLM提供商（GPT、Claude、Groq）自动提取和分析软件需求的AI系统，采用PEGS框架引导生成，在226条需求测试中F1达0.88，较通用提示提升24%，并实现78%的时间节省。
AI.motivation: 需求工程是软件开发的关重阶段，但人工处理效率低下，需要自动化工具提升效率。
AI.method: 集成多LLM提供商架构，使用PEGS格式引导提示词，从多格式文档中提取功能和非功能需求，采用模型共识和回退机制确保可靠性。
AI.result: PEGS引导F1=0.88 vs 通用提示F1=0.71；226条需求（54.9%功能/45.1%非功能）；扩展评估1,050条需求；分析时间减少78%。
AI.conclusion: PEGS引导策略显著优于通用提示；多提供商架构增强系统可靠性；系统实现显著效率提升和全面的需求覆盖。

title: ABSTRAL: Automatic Design of Multi-Agent Systems Through Iterative Refinement and Topology Optimization
summary: How should multi-agent systems be designed, and can that design knowledge be captured in a form that is inspectable, revisable, and transferable? We introduce ABSTRAL, a framework that treats MAS architecture as an evolving natural-language document, an artifact refined through contrastive trace analysis. Three findings emerge. First, we provide a precise measurement of the multi-agent coordination tax: under fixed turn budgets, ensembles achieve only 26% turn efficiency, with 66% of tasks exhausting the limit, yet still improve over single-agent baselines by discovering parallelizable task decompositions. Second, design knowledge encoded in documents transfers: topology reasoning and role templates learned on one domain provide a head start on new domains, with transferred seeds matching coldstart iteration 3 performance in a single iteration. Third, contrastive trace analysis discovers specialist roles absent from any initial design, a capability no prior system demonstrates. On SOPBench (134 bank tasks, deterministic oracle), ABSTRAL reaches 70% validation / 65.96% test pass rate with a GPT-4o backbone. We release the converged documents as inspectable design rationale.

AI.tldr: ABSTRAL框架将多智能体系统架构视为不断演化的自然语言文档，通过对比轨迹分析进行优化。在SOPBench基准上（134个银行任务），ABSTRAL达到70%验证率/65.96%测试通过率。
AI.motivation: 核心问题：如何设计多智能体系统，以及如何将以可检查、可修订、可迁移的形式捕获设计知识。
AI.method: ABSTRAL框架将MAS架构视为通过对比轨迹分析（contrastive trace analysis）不断优化的自然语言文档，学习拓扑推理和角色模板实现跨领域知识迁移。
AI.result: 三个关键发现：1）多智能体协调税精确测量：固定回合预算下，集成仅达26%回合效率，66%任务耗尽限制，但仍通过发现可并行任务分解超越单智能体基线；2）设计知识可迁移：迁移种子一步即匹配冷启动第3轮迭代性能；3）对比轨迹分析能发现初始设计中没有的专家角色。SOPBench上GPT-4o主链达70%验证/65.96%测试通过率。
AI.conclusion: ABSTRAL成功实现了可检查的设计知识捕获与跨领域迁移，证明对比轨迹分析能自发发现隐含的角色专业化，为多智能体系统设计提供可解释、可迭代的文档化方案。

title: Beyond the Mean: Distribution-Aware Loss Functions for Bimodal Regression
summary: Despite the strong predictive performance achieved by machine learning models across many application domains, assessing their trustworthiness through reliable estimates of predictive confidence remains a critical challenge. This issue arises in scenarios where the likelihood of error inferred from learned representations follows a bimodal distribution, resulting from the coexistence of confident and ambiguous predictions. Standard regression approaches often struggle to adequately express this predictive uncertainty, as they implicitly assume unimodal Gaussian noise, leading to mean-collapse behavior in such settings. Although Mixture Density Networks (MDNs) can represent different distributions, they suffer from severe optimization instability. We propose a family of distribution-aware loss functions integrating normalized RMSE with Wasserstein and Cramér distances. When applied to standard deep regression models, our approach recovers bimodal distributions without the volatility of mixture models. Validated across four experimental stages, our results show that the proposed Wasserstein loss establishes a new Pareto efficiency frontier: matching the stability of standard regression losses like MSE in unimodal tasks while reducing Jensen-Shannon Divergence by 45% on complex bimodal datasets. Our framework strictly dominates MDNs in both fidelity and robustness, offering a reliable tool for aleatoric uncertainty estimation in trustworthy AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一族"分布感知"回归损失函数，将归一化 RMSE 与 Wasserstein 距离、Cramér 距离以及值域对齐项结合，用于恢复双峰误差分布，避免 MSE 的"均值坍塌"和 MDN 的训练不稳定。在 17 个数据集、四个阶段的实验协议下，Wasserstein 损失（默认 α=1）建立新的帕累托前沿：在双峰图像复杂度任务上较 MSE 降低 Jensen-Shannon 散度约 45%，并在分布保真度与优化稳定性两方面同时优于混合密度网络（MDN）。
AI.motivation: 可信 AI 需要可靠预测置信度，但标准回归隐含"误差服从单峰高斯"的假设。作者在 CIFAR-100 与 Food-101 上训练 EfficientNet-V2-M 后发现，预测误差 y=1-p̂(c|x) 的经验分布呈明显双峰结构（"易样本"与"困难/混淆样本"并存），而非高斯。用 MSE 训练的回归模型会坍塌到两峰之间稀疏区域的"平均难度"，语义上几乎不存在的取值上。MDN 虽能表示多峰，却存在严重的模式坍塌与优化不稳定。因此需要一种既保留确定性回归的稳定性、又能恢复双峰分布形状的损失函数，且无需集成或多次前向传播的额外开销。
AI.method: 框架由三个可组合组件构成：(1) 点态保真项 D_RMSE=sqrt(mean((y-ŷ)²)+ε)，ε≈1e-8 保证梯度有界；(2) 分布保真项，用一维经验 CDF 的统计距离度量——Cramér 距离 ∫(F_ŷ-F_y)²dx（对高阶矩差异敏感，利于分离模式）与 Wasserstein 距离 ∫|F_ŷ-F_y|dx（L1 传输代价，梯度线性恒定），避免 KL 在支撑不重叠时的无穷与 KDE/直方图超参敏感问题；(3) 值域对齐项 D_Range=|ŷ_max-ŷ_min-(y_max-y_min)|，防止预测区间收缩。所有原始距离经非线性归一化 N(D)=1-1/(1+D) 映射到 [0,1]，最终损失 L=N(D_RMSE)+α·N(D_Distribution)+β·N(D_Range)。由于 N 与 sqrt(·) 均严格单调，最小化 N(D_RMSE) 与最小化 MSE 的全局最优解一致。变体：Cramér/Wasser × Simple(β=0)/Range(β=α/2)，另有默认配置 α=1。基线包括 MDN(NLL, K=5)、异方差 HMLP(GaussianNLL)、分位数 MLP(Pinball, τ∈{0.1,0.5,0.9})、标准 MLP(MSE)；统一 MLP 骨干（512/256/128/64 隐层、GELU+BN+Dropout）、Adam lr=1e-3、batch 64、50 epoch。数据集分四阶段：合成双峰（Inverse Square、Two Path）、可控分离注入（S∈[0,1]，K-Means K=2 中点分割）、真实双峰表格（Houses、Protein Structure、Energy Efficiency 等）、图像复杂度评估（EfficientNet-V2-M 生成误差标签 + 冻结 EfficientNet-B0 提取 1280 维嵌入）。评估指标：RMSE、MAE、JS 散度、精确 Wasserstein 距离、结构保真度 Δ_BC=|BC_target-BC_pred|（Bimodality Coefficient >0.555 判为双峰）。
AI.result: 阶段 I（合成）：Wasser-Simple 的 RMSE 2.62 与 HMLP 持平、优于 MSE(2.70)，而 MDN 恶化至 3.82；Wasser-Simple 把 JS 从 0.73（HMLP）降至 0.63，Cramer-Range 降至 0.54（与 MDN 相当）但 RMSE 仅 2.94；默认 Wasser-Simple(Def) 取得最优结构保真 Δ_BC=0.03、Wasserstein 0.30、JS 0.37，显著优于 MDN(Δ_BC=0.15)。阶段 II（可控分离）：在 S=0→0.1 出现"奇异性现象"，MDN 在 S=0 单峰下也无法收敛到均值；Cramer 行为更接近 MSE，Δ_BC 0.129/0.156 与坍塌的 HMLP(0.143) 相当，说明 Cramer 难以驱动显式模式分离；默认 Wasserstein 全谱段 JS 最低（0.284→0.339），Δ_BC=0.052。阶段 III（真实双峰）：Wasser-Simple RMSE 0.330 与 MSE 相当，MDN 最差 0.525；默认配置 Wasserstein 0.081、JS 0.291 优于最强基线 MLPQ(0.084/0.301)，Δ_BC 0.018 较 MDN(0.033) 低约 45%。阶段 IV（图像）：双峰组中 MSE 最稳（RMSE 1.114）但 JS 最差（0.552）、Δ_BC 0.167；MDN 结构最佳（Δ_BC 0.035）但优化最差（RMSE 1.254、JS 0.320）；默认 Wasserstein 严格帕累托支配 MDN（JS 0.301 vs 0.320，RMSE 1.208 vs 1.254），且取得最低 Wasserstein 0.170，JS 较 MSE 降低约 45%。三模态案例（Bike Sharing Day）中 MDN 全面最佳，但 Wasser-Range 取得全场最低 Δ_BC=0.032，Wasser-Simple 的 Wasserstein 距离较 HMLP 降 48%。此外发现"调参陷阱"：自动调优常降低 α 以优先 RMSE，反而使结果回落至均值，默认 α=1 反而得到最佳分布保真。
AI.conclusion: 三点主要结论：(1) 从单峰到双峰的过渡会引发"奇异性现象"，标准模型在该处突变失效；MDN 虽能恢复双峰但优化极不稳定，甚至在单峰基线 S=0 上都无法收敛。(2) 否证了"必须有显式值域约束才能分离模式"的假设：仅最小化 Wasserstein 距离即足以驱动梯度走向正确分布形状，去掉硬约束（β=0）在真实重尾噪声表格任务上反而更稳健，说明"软分布压力"优于"硬几何约束"。(3) 在高维图像复杂度评估这一目标场景中，默认 Wasserstein 损失（α=1）建立了新的帕累托效率前沿，成功恢复"自信 vs 混淆"的双峰误差结构，较 MSE 降低 45% 的 JS 散度，同时避免 MDN 的训练波动。结论性观点：把回归目标视为连续概率测度而非单点，是获得更可靠、语义更丰富的 aleatoric 不确定性估计的可行路径。局限与未来方向：代码待发表公开；默认配置与调优配置在 RMSE 上略有折衷；框架未显式建模分布形状数量，在三模态场景下仍不及混合模型。

title: Reliable Classroom AI via Neuro-Symbolic Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Classroom AI is rapidly expanding from low-level perception toward higher-level judgments about engagement, confusion, collaboration, and instructional quality. Yet classrooms are among the hardest real-world settings for multimodal vision: they are multi-party, noisy, privacy-sensitive, pedagogically diverse, and often multilingual. In this paper, we argue that classroom AI should be treated as a critical domain, where raw predictive accuracy is insufficient unless predictions are accompanied by verifiable evidence, calibrated uncertainty, and explicit deployment guardrails. We introduce NSCR, a neuro-symbolic framework that decomposes classroom analytics into four layers: perceptual grounding, symbolic abstraction, executable reasoning, and governance. NSCR adapts recent ideas from symbolic fact extraction and verifiable code generation to multimodal educational settings, enabling classroom observations from video, audio, ASR, and contextual metadata to be converted into typed facts and then composed by executable rules, programs, and policy constraints. Beyond the system design, we contribute a benchmark and evaluation protocol organized around five tasks: classroom state inference, discourse-grounded event linking, temporal early warning, collaboration analysis, and multilingual classroom reasoning. We further specify reliability metrics centered on abstention, calibration, robustness, construct alignment, and human usefulness. The paper does not report new empirical results; its contribution is a concrete framework and evaluation agenda intended to support more interpretable, privacy-aware, and pedagogically grounded multimodal AI for classrooms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NSCR框架，一个用于课堂AI分析的神 经符号方法，将多模态课堂数据转换为可验证的符号事实和可执行规则，同时提出包含5项任务的基准测试与可靠性评估协议。
AI.motivation: 课堂是极具挑战性的多模态场景（多方交互、噪声、隐私敏感、教学多样化、多语言），现有课堂AI仅关注预测准确率，缺乏可验证证据、不确定性校准和部署保障机制，因此需要将课堂AI视为关键领域。
AI.method: NSCR采用神经符号架构，分为四层：感知 grounding层、符号抽象层、可执行推理层和治理层。该框架将视频、音频、ASR和上下文元数据转换为类型化事实，再由可执行规则、程序和策略约束进行组合推理。
AI.result: 本文为位置论文（position paper），未报告新的实证结果。主要贡献包括：1）提出NSCR框架设计；2）构建包含5项任务的基准测试（课堂状态推理、话语事件链接、时序预警、合作分析、多语言推理）；3）定义可靠性评估指标（弃权、不确定性校准、鲁棒性、构念对齐、人类有用性）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作旨在推动更可解释、隐私感知且符合教育学原理的多模态课堂AI系统，为该领域提供系统性框架与评估议程。

title: Trained Persistent Memory for Frozen Decoder-Only LLMs
summary: Decoder-only language models are stateless: hidden representations are discarded after every forward pass and nothing persists across sessions. Jeong (2026a) showed that trained memory adapters give a frozen encoder-decoder backbone persistent latent-space memory, building on the lateral-memory framework of Jeong (2026b,c). Here we ask whether the same principle transfers to the decoder-only setting, where no cross-attention pathway exists and memory must enter through self-attention alone. We adapt six methods -- prefix, parallel cross-attention, KV extension, Hebbian memory, context-gated branch, and slot-based sparse write -- to a frozen GPT-2, training only a small adapter $θ_{mem}$. The write rule is shared; only the read injection changes from decoder cross-attention to self-attention KV prefix or parallel branch. On LoCoMo we find a striking inductive-bias dichotomy: at $1\times$ capacity, three methods with strong architectural priors -- cross-attention (M.2), Hebbian (M.4), and slot write (M.6) -- achieve retained-memory scores of $7-18\%$ and knowledge gains $ΔK$ of $7-10$, while the other three fail ($< 0.4\%$). At $10\times$ capacity all six converge, showing the gap is architectural, not fundamental. Together with the encoder-decoder results of Jeong (2026a) and the brain-inspired modules of Jeong (2026b,c), these findings establish persistent latent-space memory as a general paradigm spanning major transformer families.

AI.tldr: 本文将编码器-解码器模型中的持久记忆适配器迁移至纯解码器GPT-2，发现具有强架构先验的三种方法（交叉注意力、Hebbian、槽写入）在标准容量下显著优于其他方法，但10×容量下所有方法收敛，证明差距是架构性的而非基础性的。
AI.motivation: 纯解码器语言模型本质无状态，无法跨会话保持记忆。本文探索将编码器-解码器模型中的持久潜在空间记忆框架迁移至纯解码器设置，研究在缺少交叉注意力通路时记忆如何通过自注意力注入。
AI.method: 将六种记忆方法（前缀、并行交叉注意力、KV扩展、Hebbian记忆、上下文门控分支、槽稀疏写入）适配到冻结的GPT-2，仅训练小型记忆适配器θ_mem，通过改变读取注入方式（从解码器交叉注意力改为自注意力KV前缀或并行分支）。在LoCoMo基准上评估记忆保留率和知识增益。
AI.result: 1×容量下存在显著 inductive-bias dichotomy：三种具有强架构先验的方法（交叉注意力M.2、Hebbian M.4、槽写入M.6）记忆保留率7-18%、ΔK达7-10，其余三种完全失败(<0.4%)。10×容量下所有六种方法收敛。
AI.conclusion: 持久潜在空间记忆是跨越主要Transformer家族的通用范式。在有限容量下，记忆方法的表现高度依赖其架构设计是否与解码器自注意力机制兼容；充足容量可弥补架构差异。

title: Learning What Matters Now: Dynamic Preference Inference under Contextual Shifts
summary: Humans often juggle multiple, sometimes conflicting objectives and shift their priorities as circumstances change, rather than following a fixed objective function. In contrast, most computational decision-making and multi-objective RL methods assume static preference weights or a known scalar reward. In this work, we study sequential decision-making problem when these preference weights are unobserved latent variables that drift with context. Specifically, we propose Dynamic Preference Inference (DPI), a cognitively inspired framework in which an agent maintains a probabilistic belief over preference weights, updates this belief from recent interaction, and conditions its policy on inferred preferences. We instantiate DPI as a variational preference inference module trained jointly with a preference-conditioned actor-critic, using vector-valued returns as evidence about latent trade-offs. In queueing, maze, and multi-objective continuous-control environments with event-driven changes in objectives, DPI adapts its inferred preferences to new regimes and achieves higher post-shift performance than fixed-weight and heuristic envelope baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「动态偏好推断（DPI）」框架：在多目标强化学习中不把偏好权重当作给定常数，而视为随情境漂移的隐变量；智能体用循环编码器维护偏好权重的概率后验（变分贝叶斯），以向量回报为证据在线更新，再以采样偏好条件化 actor–critic 策略。附录给出 ELBO 推导、Queue/Maze 环境设计、基于 PPO 的实现、HalfCheetah 连续控制扩展、消融与超参敏感性分析。结果显示 DPI 在事件驱动的非平稳环境下优于固定权重与包络启发式基线，但相对"特权信息"Dense Oracle 仍有差距，且实验均为受控仿真环境。
AI.motivation: 人类在多重且冲突的目标间动态权衡优先级（自我调节、多目标追求、constructed preference 等认知理论），而多数决策与 MORL 方法假设固定偏好权重或已知标量奖励。现实多目标环境（效率 vs 安全、能耗 vs 伦理）中约束会随资源、时间、风险变化，若不能在线重估价值权衡，智能体会追逐不可行目标或忽视新出现的优先级。已有的偏好条件化策略仍要求偏好向量已知，缺少"从不完整、含噪、演化的感知数据中在线推断当前优先级"的机制；本文试图把认知心理学的"价值评估（value appraisal）"与"动作选择"两个耦合过程，落实为可部署于高维、部分可观测、非平稳控制问题的算法。
AI.method: 问题形式化：在部分可观测、非平稳环境下仅获得向量奖励，偏好权重 ω_t ∈ Δ^{d−1} 为隐变量。方法：DPI = （1）价值评估模块：用 GRU 编码最近 H 步状态历史 e_t = s_{t−H+1:t}，输出对角高斯 q_φ(z_t|e_t)=N(μ_t, diag(σ_t²))，经 softmax 映射为偏好 ω_t = f_θ(z_t)；（2）证据模型采用量化响应/自由能形式 log p(e_t|z_t)=β·⟨softmax(z_t), G_t(e_t)⟩+C(e_t)，目标后验 p*(z_t|e_t) ∝ N(0,I)·exp(β U_t)，推导 ELBO：L_t(φ)=β·E_q[⟨f_θ(z_t), G_t(e_t)⟩] − KL(q_φ ‖ N(0,I))，用重参数化 + 1–K 蒙特卡洛采样近似期望（β=1）；（3）动作选择模块：偏好条件化 actor–critic（on-policy Envelope PPO），采样 K=8 个候选 z，对每个候选计算向量值 V_θ(s,ω)，以 ⟨ω, V_θ⟩ 取包络最优 ω̂_t 选优，标量优势 A_t=⟨ω̂_t, A_t⟩，损失为 PPO+critic；（4）偏好损失 L_prefer = L_ELBO + λ·L_dir + γ·L_stab，其中方向对齐项 L_dir = 1 − λ·cos(ω^pred_t, G_t) 鼓励偏好变化与观测回报方向一致，自洽项 L_stab = ‖ω^pred_t − ω̂_t‖² 稳定更新。环境：Queue（符号状态，动作 WAIT/CUT，5 维奖励 progress/time/fairness/energy/deadline，事件：到达突发、服务减速、能量冲击）、Maze（像素观测 observation/time/energy 图像 + 四向动作，5 维奖励 progress/time/hazard/energy/deadline，事件：截止期骤减 30%、危险区激增、能量消耗翻倍）、改造的 mo-halfcheetah-v5 连续控制（3 维奖励 speed/ctrl/energy，堆叠历史 H=8，事件：截止期压缩、速度激增、能量干旱；含不可观测的截止期与能量预算）。实现：PyTorch，共享编码器、GRU、双层 MLP 输出 μ/logσ；超参见 Table 3，1.5×10^5 步、10 个随机种子、报告 95% CI。
AI.result: （1）Queue/Maze 上 DPI 相比固定偏好与静态推断基线在适应性、鲁棒性与累积性能上一致更优，并呈现可解释、与事件对齐的偏好轨迹（如先重道德/公平，临近截止期转向 energy/progress）；（2）Pareto 分析显示 Queue 事件前后 Pareto 前沿结构性不同，近似最优的固定标量化在前后期互不适用，印证不存在稳健的单一固定 ω；（3）附录基线对比（Table 4）：Maze 上 DPI-PPO SR 59.04%，高于 MER-PPO 0.98%、SR-PPO 46.91%、Dense Oracle 62.92% 之下；Queue 上 DPI SR 39.95%，优于 MER-PPO 0.98%、SR-PPO −5.64%，低于 Dense Oracle 49.27%；（4）连续控制（Table 5）：DPI-PPO MER 42.10、SR 81.00%，优于 ENVELOPE-PPO（13.52 / 53.28%），但明显低于拥有特权事件信号与手写规则的 Dense Oracle（66.95 / 99.98%）；（5）超参敏感性（Table 6）显示对 γ、λ 的中等幅度变化较稳健，仅极端取值轻微降低 SR；（6）学习曲线显示 MER/SR 平滑单调改善并饱和，无发散或坍缩，偏好熵随 critic 变准而逐渐下降。
AI.conclusion: DPI 用变分推断把"偏好何时重要"变成可学习的隐状态机制，提供了连接认知目标调节理论与多目标 RL 的计算桥梁；相比固定权重或包络启发式，它在事件驱动的分布漂移下更有效且更具可解释性。主要局限：环境均为受控仿真（队列、迷宫、改造 HalfCheetah）而非真实/开放环境；相比拥有特权信息与手写规则的 Dense Oracle 上界仍有差距，说明无模型、仅靠观测推断偏好仍有提升空间；推理机制相对简单（对角高斯 + softmax + 余弦方向对齐），对长时程、社会耦合的偏好动态表达力不足。未来工作：扩展到 3D 具身与多智能体场景、构建更具表达力的推断机制，并探索免变更点与评估视野假设的 PS@K 类目标。

title: Conformal Risk Control for Safety-Critical Wildfire Evacuation Mapping: A Comparative Study of Tabular, Spatial, and Graph-Based Models
summary: Every wildfire prediction model deployed today shares a dangerous property: none of these methods provides formal guarantees on how much fire spread is missed. Despite extensive work on wildfire spread prediction using deep learning, no prior study has applied distribution-free safety guarantees to this domain, leaving evacuation planners reliant on probability thresholds with no formal assurance. We address this gap by presenting, to our knowledge, the first application of conformal risk control (CRC) to wildfire spread prediction, providing finite-sample guarantees on false negative rate (FNR <= 0.05). We expose a stark failure: across three model families of increasing complexity (tabular: LightGBM, AUROC 0.854; convolutional: Tiny U-Net, AUROC 0.969; and graph-based: Hybrid ResGNN-UNet, AUROC 0.964), standard thresholds capture only 7-72% of true fire spread. CRC eliminates this failure uniformly. Our central finding is that model architecture determines evacuation efficiency, while CRC determines safety: both spatial models with CRC achieve approximately 95% fire coverage while flagging only approximately 15% of total pixels, making them 4.2x more efficient than LightGBM, while the graph model's additional complexity over a simple U-Net yields no meaningful efficiency gain. We propose a shift-aware three-way CRC framework that assigns SAFE/MONITOR/EVACUATE zones for operational triage, and characterize a fundamental limitation of prevalence-weighted bounds under extreme class imbalance (approximately 5% fire prevalence). All models, calibration code, and evaluation pipelines are released for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将保形风险控制（Conformal Risk Control, CRC）应用于野火蔓延像素级预测，在 Next Day Wildfire Spread (NDWS) 数据集上为假阴性率给出有限样本保证（FNR ≤ 0.05，即火情覆盖率 ≥ 95%）。作者比较三类模型：表格基线 LightGBM（AUROC 0.854）、轻量 U-Net（470K 参数，AUROC 0.969）与图卷积混合 Hybrid ResGNN-UNet（229K 参数，AUROC 0.964）。核心结论是：标准 0.5 阈值极不安全（仅捕获 7.2%–71.5% 的火像素），CRC 将三者覆盖率统一提升至 ≥94%；而"架构决定疏散效率、CRC 决定安全"——两个空间模型在同等安全保证下仅标记约 15% 像素，比 LightGBM 的 62.6% 小 4.2 倍；图模型相对简单 U-Net 无实质增益。
AI.motivation: 野火疏散决策中漏报火像素（假阴性）直接威胁生命，而误报会导致"影子疏散"、拥堵道路，因此准确率、F1、IoU、AUROC 等对称指标不适配该任务的不对称代价结构。现有野火机器学习研究全部基于准确率类指标评估，缺少对漏报率的任何形式化保证；共形预测方法虽已在医学影像、自动驾驶等领域应用，但尚未有人将 CRC 引入野火蔓延预测，导致疏散决策者只能依赖无形式保证的概率阈值。作者因此提出核心研究问题：一个足够强的模型能否免去事后安全校准的必要？并进一步关注 CRC 在极端类别不平衡（约 5% 火像素占比）下的实际行为与理论局限。
AI.method: 数据：NDWS 数据集 18,545 个 64×64×12 通道 patch，固定种子 42 划分 train/calibration/test = 70/15/15（12,981/2,781/2,783），校准集绝不参与训练；对标签为 -1 的无数据像素构造有效掩码，全程使用掩码损失与评估。模型均从零训练：LightGBM（逐像素独立建模，5% 像素下采样）；Tiny U-Net（12→32→64 编码、64→128 瓶颈、两级解码，~470K 参数，AdamW lr=1e-3、wd=1e-4、50 epoch 余弦退火、掩码 BCE）；Hybrid ResGNN-UNet（CNN 编码器下采样至 8×8、3 层 GATConv（4 头、8 邻接像素图）残差瓶颈、U-Net 解码器，~229K 参数，AdamW lr=3e-4、pos_weight=8、梯度裁剪、早停 patience=7）。CRC：仅使用正类（火）校准像素的预测概率排序，取 λ̂ = p_(⌈α(m+1)⌉)，α=0.05，由有限样本修正保证 E[FNR] ≤ α，仅需校准集与测试集可交换，不依赖模型质量。评价三种决策框架：标准阈值 p≥0.5、CRC、三路 CRC。指标：主指标为覆盖率 1−FNR 与标记集合大小（set size），辅以 AUROC/precision/F1/IoU/AUPRC 及三路分区统计，采用 10K 次图像级 bootstrap 95% CI。三路 CRC 扩展：SAFE（p̂<λ_min）、MONITOR（λ_min≤p̂<λ_max）、EVACUATE（p̂≥λ_max），采用成本加权 CRC（c_fn=5, c_fp=1, α_cw=0.50）与基于重要性权重失配的偏移感知校准，ε_max = B_pw·max(‖δ_ρlo‖₁,‖δ_ρhi‖₁)+B_pw/(N+1)，α_safe = α_cw − ε_max，并给出 decided 集上的条件风险界 E[ℓ|decided] ≤ α_cw/(1−d)。
AI.result: 1) 标准阈值失效：LightGBM 仅捕获 7.2% 火像素（FNR 0.928）、U-Net 39.0%（FNR 0.610）、ResGNN-UNet 71.5%（FNR 0.285）；最优模型在 0.5 阈值下仍漏掉近三分之一火情。2) CRC 统一保证安全：覆盖率分别升至 94.1%、94.7%、94.8%（FNR 0.059/0.053/0.052），λ̂ 分别为 0.003/0.002/0.022。3) 效率差异显著：LightGBM 需标记 62.6% 像素，而两个空间模型仅 ~15%（14.9% vs 15.1%），相差 4.2 倍；差异根源为 AUROC 差异（0.854 vs 0.964/0.969）——判别力越强，CRC 可设定越高阈值，疏散区越小。4) 架构复杂度边际收益递减：ResGNN-UNet（229K 参数）AUROC 0.964 略低于 U-Net（470K）的 0.969，CRC 效率几乎相同，因 64×64 patch 上 U-Net 感受野已覆盖全空间，GNN 消息传递无额外信息。5) 三路 CRC 实现 100% 覆盖与紧凑 EVACUATE 区（4.04%–14.85%），但 SAFE 区完全塌缩（λ_min=0）：因 B_pw = max(5×0.05, 1×0.95) = 0.95 被多数类项主导，偏移修正量（~0.02）超过基础阈值（~0.02–0.003），使 λ_min 被压至 0，85%–96% 像素被推入 MONITOR 交由人工复核；作者将此视为 prevalence-weighted bound 在稀有事件（π₀≫π₁）下的根本局限。6) 训练细节：U-Net 收敛平滑、过拟合最小（val loss 0.048）；ResGNN-UNet 早停于 epoch 23（最佳 epoch 16，val loss 0.131）。
AI.conclusion: CRC 将野火蔓延预测从准确率优化问题转变为具备形式化保证的决策系统：标准阈值下无论模型多好都不安全（覆盖率 7%–72%），CRC 独立于模型质量提供 ≥94%（目标 ≥95%）覆盖的有限样本保证，而模型判别力仅决定疏散区大小。实践启示是：一个训练良好的简单模型叠加 CRC，可同时获得比复杂模型（仅以 F1 评估）更强的安全保证与更紧凑的疏散区；共形校准仅需数行代码即可提供"≥95% 火情必被检出"的数学保证。作者也坦承局限：像素池化违反可交换性（同一 patch 内像素空间相关），未来应比较图像级 CRC（n=2,781，逐图 FNR 损失）；三路框架的 SAFE 区塌缩需用类条件独立校准（λ_max 用 FNR-CRC、λ_min 用 FPR-CRC）或区域化校准修复；AUROC–疏散成本的闭式关系（双正态假设下 S(α)=π₁(1−α)+π₀(1−F₀(F₁⁻¹(α)))) 有待形式化与实证验证；气候变化与地理/时间迁移带来的分布漂移可能破坏可交换性，需用时间分层划分与多区域数据检验 CRC 的稳健性；模型架构考察范围有限（未含 transformer）。所有代码、模型与评估流水线已开源。

title: Empirical Comparison of Agent Communication Protocols for Task Orchestration
summary: Context. Nowadays, artificial intelligence agent systems are transforming from single-tool interactions to complex multi-agent orchestrations. As a result, two competing communication protocols have emerged: a tool integration protocol that standardizes how agents invoke external tools, and an inter-agent delegation protocol that enables autonomous agents to discover and delegate tasks to one another. Despite widespread industry adoption by dozens of enterprise partners, no empirical comparison of these protocols exists in the literature. Objective. The goal of this work is to develop the first systematic benchmark comparing tool-integration-only, multi-agent delegation, and hybrid architectures across standardized queries at three complexity levels, and to quantify the trade-offs in response time, context window consumption, monetary cost, error recovery, and implementation complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AI多智能体系统中两种竞争通信协议（工具集成协议与智能体间委托协议）进行首次系统性基准测试比较，涵盖响应时间、上下文窗口消耗、财务成本、错误恢复及实现复杂度等维度的权衡分析。
AI.motivation: 当前AI智能体系统正从单一工具交互向复杂多智能体编排演进，但业界广泛采用的两种通信协议缺乏实证比较研究，导致开发者在架构选择上面临决策困难。
AI.method: 构建标准化基准测试框架，对比三类架构：仅工具集成型、多智能体委托型、混合型；设置三个复杂度级别的标准化查询进行评估。
AI.result: 通过量化分析获取各架构在响应时间、上下文窗口消耗、财务成本、错误恢复能力和实现复杂度五个维度上的权衡数据。
AI.conclusion: 为开发者提供基于实证的架构选择指南，明确各协议在不同场景下的适用性。

title: Large Language Models for Missing Data Imputation: Understanding Behavior, Hallucination Effects, and Control Mechanisms
summary: Data imputation is a cornerstone technique for handling missing values in real-world datasets, which are often plagued by missingness. Despite recent progress, prior studies on Large Language Models-based imputation remain limited by scalability challenges, restricted cross-model comparisons, and evaluations conducted on small or domain-specific datasets. Furthermore, heterogeneous experimental protocols and inconsistent treatment of missingness mechanisms (MCAR, MAR, and MNAR) hinder systematic benchmarking across methods. This work investigates the robustness of Large Language Models for missing data imputation in tabular datasets using a zero-shot prompt engineering approach. To this end, we present a comprehensive benchmarking study comparing five widely used LLMs against six state-of-the-art imputation baselines. The experimental design evaluates these methods across 29 datasets (including nine synthetic datasets) under MCAR, MAR, and MNAR mechanisms, with missing rates of up to 20\%. The results demonstrate that leading LLMs, particularly Gemini 3.0 Flash and Claude 4.5 Sonnet, consistently achieve superior performance on real-world open-source datasets compared to traditional methods. However, this advantage appears to be closely tied to the models' prior exposure to domain-specific patterns learned during pre-training on internet-scale corpora. In contrast, on synthetic datasets, traditional methods such as MICE outperform LLMs, suggesting that LLM effectiveness is driven by semantic context rather than purely statistical reconstruction. Furthermore, we identify a clear trade-off: while LLMs excel in imputation quality, they incur significantly higher computational time and monetary costs. Overall, this study provides a large-scale comparative analysis, positioning LLMs as promising semantics-driven imputers for complex tabular data.

AI.tldr: 本文对大语言模型（LLM）在表格数据缺失值填补中的能力进行了大规模基准测试，对比了5种主流LLM与6种传统填补方法在29个数据集上的表现，涵盖MCAR、MAR、MNAR三种缺失机制。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的缺失值填补研究存在三大局限：可扩展性不足、跨模型对比有限、评估数据集规模小且领域单一；此外，不同研究的实验协议不一致，缺失机制处理方式不统一，亟需系统性基准测试。
AI.method: 采用零样本提示工程（zero-shot prompt engineering）方法，对比了Gemini 3.0 Flash、Claude 4.5 Sonnet等5种主流LLM与MICE等6种传统填补基线方法，实验覆盖29个数据集（含9个合成数据集），在MCAR、MAR、MNAR三种缺失机制下测试，缺失率最高达20%。
AI.result: Gemini 3.0 Flash和Claude 4.5 Sonnet在真实开源数据集上表现最优，显著优于传统方法；但这一优势与其预训练阶段学到的领域特定模式高度相关。在合成数据集上，MICE等传统方法反而优于LLM，表明LLM的优越性源于语义上下文而非纯统计重建能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM是有前景的语义驱动填补工具，适用于复杂表格数据；但存在明显的精度-成本权衡——LLM填补质量更高，却带来显著更高的计算时间和金钱成本。LLM有效性依赖于预训练知识，对缺乏语义规律支持的合成数据表现欠佳。

title: Improving Safety Alignment via Balanced Direct Preference Optimization
summary: With the rapid development and widespread application of Large Language Models (LLMs), their potential safety risks have attracted widespread attention. Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has been adopted to enhance the safety performance of LLMs. As a simple and effective alternative to RLHF, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is widely used for safety alignment. However, safety alignment still suffers from severe overfitting, which limits its actual performance. This paper revisits the overfitting phenomenon from the perspective of the model's comprehension of the training data. We find that the Imbalanced Preference Comprehension phenomenon exists between responses in preference pairs, which compromises the model's safety performance. To address this, we propose Balanced Direct Preference Optimization (B-DPO), which adaptively modulates optimization strength between preferred and dispreferred responses based on mutual information. A series of experimental results show that B-DPO can enhance the safety capability while maintaining the competitive general capabilities of LLMs on various mainstream benchmarks compared to state-of-the-art methods. \color{red}{Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful texts, and reader discretion is recommended.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型安全对齐中的过拟合问题，提出了一种新的优化方法B-DPO（平衡直接偏好优化）。核心发现是偏好对中响应之间的"偏好理解不平衡"现象，通过互信息自适应调节优化强度，在提升安全能力的同时保持模型的通用能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型(LLM)的安全对齐主要采用人类反馈强化学习(RLHF)及其简化版本直接偏好优化(DPO)，但安全对齐仍面临严重的过拟合问题，这限制了模型的实用安全性能。
AI.method: 研究首先重新审视过拟合现象，从模型对训练数据的理解角度分析，发现偏好对中响应之间存在"偏好理解不平衡"现象。基于此，提出了B-DPO方法，利用互信息自适应调节首选响应和被拒响应之间的优化强度。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，B-DPO在多个主流基准测试上，相较于现有最优方法，能够增强模型的安全能力，同时保持具有竞争力的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过解决偏好对中的理解不平衡问题，B-DPO有效缓解了安全对齐的过拟合，为LLM的安全对齐提供了一种简单有效的改进方案。

title: Graph Signal Processing Meets Mamba2: Adaptive Filter Bank via Delta Modulation
comment: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: State-space models (SSMs) offer efficient alternatives to attention with linear-time recurrence. Mamba2, a recent SSM-based language model, uses selective input gating and a multi-head structure, enabling parallel computation and strong benchmark performance. However, its multi-head recurrence operates independently without structured utilization or analysis. In this work, we propose a novel method called Hierarchical ADaptive filter bank for Efficient SSMs (HADES), a Graph Signal Processing (GSP)-inspired framework that reinterprets Mamba2 as an adaptive filter bank on a line graph. Our hierarchical architecture introduces two filter types: shared filters for global low-pass behavior and expert filters for local high-pass behavior, achieved through structured bias on the parameter Δ. HADES achieves comparable performance to baseline models including Mamba2 across various benchmarks in language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and long-context retrieval, while using only 58.9% of the original parameters. In this regard, HADES bridges GSP and neural sequence modeling, enabling efficient, hierarchical, and interpretable filtering within state-space models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HADES（Hierarchical ADaptive filter bank for Efficient SSMs）：把 Mamba2 从图信号处理（GSP）视角重新解释为作用在线图上的自适应图滤波器组，并把多头结构改造为"共享滤波器 + 专家滤波器"的层级滤波器组，通过基于谱残差（spectral residual）的 Top-Q 路由与 Δ 参数的谱偏置调制实现 token 级自适应。370M 配置下仅用 218M 参数（约为基线的 58.9%），在 WikiText/LAMBADA 困惑度、8 项零样本常识推理与长上下文 passkey 检索上达到或超过 Mamba2 等基线，并保持线性时间复杂度。
AI.motivation: Mamba2 虽以线性时间递归高效替代注意力，但其多头递归彼此独立，缺乏结构化约束与理论分析：作者通过有效秩（effective rank）分析发现 Mamba2 的多头学到的谱响应坍缩到低秩谱子空间，多数头工作在高度重叠的频率区间，滤波器组冗余且多为平滑（低通）核，难以同时刻画全局低频与局部高频结构。已有工作或聚焦 delta modulation 的长上下文改进，或提出 polarization 但仅在简化设定下验证，缺乏对"多头如何贡献互补动力学"的理解。同时，现有 GSP 研究多集中于 Transformer（自注意力=全连通图上的低通图滤波），而 SSM 的链式单向结构对应线图，GSP 视角尚未被系统用于 Mamba2。
AI.method:
理论框架：将 token 序列视为线图上的信号，shift 算子取邻接/链式连接。S4 相当于线图上的 LTI 图滤波（y = Σ_k h_k S^k x, h_k = C A^k B）；Mamba 因输入依赖的 A、B、C 可写成节点可变图滤波（NVGF）：y_t = Σ_k (C_t A_{t:t-k} B_{t-k}) S^k x，即每个时间步拥有各自的滤波器系数；多头的多个 LTV 滤波自然构成图滤波器组，每个头对应一条频率响应。

HADES 架构：将 Mamba2 的 M 个头拆为 H 个激活滤波器（H = S 个共享 + E 个专家，H ≪ M），每步只启用 H 个，参数与算力随激活头数线性下降。
- 专家滤波器（局部高频）：路由器输入 [Δ_base ‖ r_t]，其中谱残差 r_t = x_t − μ_t，μ_t 为前缀运行均值；单层线性投影 f_e 给出 E 个选择分数 s_t，Top-Q 选中并对该 token 激活，其 Δ 加入谱偏置 Δ_HADES = Softplus(Δ_base + γ·f_b([Δ_base ‖ r_t]))。
- 共享滤波器（全局低通）：始终激活、无偏置调制，仅用基础 Δ，承担稳定平滑的全局上下文。
- 训练目标：L = L_task + λ1·L_balance + λ2·L_diversity；负载均衡项用选择分数的方差/均值平方惩罚头使用塌缩；多样性项惩罚 L2 归一化滤波器输出两两内积偏离正交，促成分工。
- 实现：prefill/decode 均有伪代码，decode 阶段用 cumsum_state 维护运行均值以算谱残差，路由开销仅占总时间约 2.44%。
AI.result:
370M 配置、200B Pile tokens 训练：HADES(218M) Wiki ppl 31.48（LAMBADA 21.74），8 项常识推理平均 42.91（Mamba2 为 31.34/24.38/41.63；RetNet 41.54、DeltaNet 41.33、Mamba1 39.47、Linear Transformer 39.63），优于所有基线。1.3B 规模（30B FineWeb-Edu tokens）下 HADES(1B) 平均 52.92，略优于 Mamba2(1.3B) 52.46 与 DeltaNet 52.53。对比 MoM（Gated DeltaNet 的 MoE 变体，42.17）亦有优势；三随机种子下 HADES 平均 42.37 vs Mamba2 42.06，方差可控。长上下文 passkey 检索（1K–16K）显著优于 Mamba2。效率：推理 2.49s / 4.50GB，相对 Mamba2(3.43s / 6.20GB) 约 1.37× 加速与降内存；FLOPs 近似按 H/M 缩放。

可解释性分析：Mamba2 滤波器多为平滑低通核且高度冗余，CKA 分析显示大量高相似滤波器对；HADES 出现明显的"波纹"高通核，有效秩更高，输出谱覆盖更宽频带；共享滤波器持续强调低频，专家滤波器响应局部高频；谱偏置使 Δ 整体增大（正偏置为主，偶有负偏置），输出谱上移。路由器选择具语义分区性（Passkey/Query 区域偏好 Filter 0/11/14，Dummy Text 偏好 Filter 4/7/20，任务描述区域选择更多样）。

消融：去掉负载均衡/多样性损失均退化；仅共享（42.21）优于仅专家（41.68）；固定选择优于随机路由但均不及完整版；输入-only 路由尚可，谱残差路由最佳；位置偏置优于无偏置但不如 Δ 偏置；Gumbel Top-K、MoH 式加权聚合均更差；H=16 最优，H=8 时参数量降至 38.64%（143M）仍保持相当性能。
AI.conclusion: HADES 首次将 Mamba2 系统性地重新解释为线图上的 GSP 自适应滤波器组，提出共享（全局低通）与专家（局部高频）双层滤波器设计，结合谱残差路由与 delta 调制，在仅用 58.9% 参数的条件下于语言建模、常识推理与长上下文检索上取得与 Mamba2 相当或更优的表现，并提供了频谱/有效秩/CKA/路由选择等可解释性证据。局限在于谱特性只是通过偏置隐式引导而非显式约束，显式频谱约束可能导致行为过于刚性；作者将显式谱设计理论与新的偏置/选择机制列为未来工作。

title: PhySe-RPO: Physics and Semantics Guided Relative Policy Optimization for Diffusion-Based Surgical Smoke Removal
summary: Surgical smoke severely degrades intraoperative video quality, obscuring anatomical structures and limiting surgical perception.
