AI.conclusion: Unbounded Minibal₊ 是目前无需在线学习与对手先验知识即可产生最接近零结果的最有效均衡智能体方法，在多数设置下接近完美平衡，可直接用于娱乐与严肃游戏/教育场景，并可与匹配机制叠加使用。Unbounded Minibalₙ 不适合均衡对局，但其"频繁小负"特性在某些需要"常败但差距小"的场景仍具潜力。局限与未来工作：极弱对手下受搜索空间与时间限制无法保证完美平衡（可通过调整搜索时间单调逼近零 gain，但该方法不适用于 Unbounded Minimax）；自博弈训练的"求胜"评估函数与"均衡"目标存在状态分布错配，可能需专门为均衡训练评估函数；需扩展到不完全信息与随机博弈；需面向人类玩家的大规模统计研究以验证参与度、学习成效与长期留存；并需解释 Minibalₙ 高败率成因。

title: Model Predictive Control with Differentiable World Models for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) aims to learn optimal policies from fixed offline datasets, without further interactions with the environment. Such methods train an offline policy (or value function), and apply it at inference time without further refinement. We introduce an inference time adaptation framework inspired by model predictive control (MPC) that utilizes a pretrained policy along with a learned world model of state transitions and rewards. While existing world model and diffusion-planning methods use learned dynamics to generate imagined trajectories during training, or to sample candidate plans at inference time, they do not use inference-time information to optimize the policy parameters on the fly. In contrast, our design is a Differentiable World Model (DWM) pipeline that enables endto-end gradient computation through imagined rollouts for policy optimization at inference time based on MPC. We evaluate our algorithm on D4RL continuous-control benchmarks (MuJoCo locomotion tasks and AntMaze), and show that exploiting inference-time information to optimize the policy parameters yields consistent gains over strong offline RL baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于可微分世界模型（DWM）的离线强化学习框架，将模型预测控制（MPC）思想与离线RL结合，在推理时通过想象 rollout 进行端到端梯度计算来优化策略参数，在 D4RL 基准的 MuJoCo 和 AntMaze 任务上取得优于强基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型和扩散规划方法仅在训练时利用学习到的动力学生成想象轨迹，或在推理时采样候选计划，但均未利用推理时信息在线优化策略参数。
AI.method: 提出 Differentiable World Model (DWM) 框架：结合预训练策略与学习到的世界模型（状态转移和奖励），在推理时通过 MPC 思想进行端到端梯度计算，通过想象 rollouts 优化策略参数。
AI.result: 在 D4RL 连续控制基准（MuJoCo  locomotion 和 AntMaze）上验证，推理时策略优化相比强离线 RL 基线获得一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 利用推理时信息优化策略参数可带来持续性能提升，验证了 MPC 启发的推理时自适应框架的有效性。

title: MedCausalX: Adaptive Causal Reasoning with Self-Reflection for Trustworthy Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled interpretable medical diagnosis by integrating visual perception with linguistic reasoning. Yet, existing medical chain-of-thought (CoT) models lack explicit mechanisms to represent and enforce causal reasoning, leaving them vulnerable to spurious correlations and limiting their clinical reliability. We pinpoint three core challenges in medical CoT reasoning: how to adaptively trigger causal correction, construct high-quality causal-spurious contrastive samples, and maintain causal consistency across reasoning trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose MedCausalX, an end-to-end framework explicitly models causal reasoning chains in medical VLMs. We first introduce the CRMed dataset providing fine-grained anatomical annotations, structured causal reasoning chains, and counterfactual variants that guide the learning of causal relationships beyond superficial correlations. Building upon CRMed, MedCausalX employs a two-stage adaptive reflection architecture equipped with $\langle$causal$\rangle$ and $\langle$verify$\rangle$ tokens, enabling the model to autonomously determine when and how to perform causal analysis and verification. Finally, a trajectory-level causal correction objective optimized through error-attributed reinforcement learning refines the reasoning chain, allowing the model to distinguish genuine causal dependencies from shortcut associations. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that MedCausalX consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, improving diagnostic consistency by +5.4 points, reducing hallucination by over 10 points, and attaining top spatial grounding IoU, thereby setting a new standard for causally grounded medical reasoning.

AI.tldr: MedCausalX 是一个端到端的医学视觉语言模型（VLM）框架，通过显式建模"解剖定位→病理刻画→诊断结论"（A→P→Y）的因果推理链，让模型在推理时能自主判断何时启动因果分析与验证纠正，从而摆脱伪相关、提升临床可靠性。作者构建了 CRMed 数据集（含细粒度解剖标注、结构化因果链与反事实/捷径对比样本），提出带 `<causal>`/`<verify>` 反思标记的两阶段自适应反思架构，并采用"轨迹级 SFT + 错误归因 DPO + 在线 GRPO"的分层优化。实验显示其在 18 项区域任务指标中的 16 项、4 个医学 VQA 基准、报告生成、放射科专家评分与跨域零样本迁移上均优于现有 SOTA：诊断一致性 +5.4 点、幻觉率下降逾 10 点、空间定位 IoU 最优。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型（VLM）虽通过链式思维（CoT）提示获得可解释性推理，但其缺乏显式表示与强制因果依赖的机制，容易利用全局背景特征、语言模型先验、训练分布偏置等浅层相关性，导致"看似合理但与临床机制不符"的解释，临床可靠性受限。作者指出医学 CoT 推理存在三大核心挑战：(1) 如何动态判断何时需要因果纠正，而非静态套用 CoT（静态 CoT 反而会固化错误因果关联）；(2) 如何以较低专家标注成本构造高质量的"因果—非因果"对比样本；(3) 如何在整条推理轨迹层面保证因果一致性，而非仅优化忽略全局因果连贯性的 token 级似然。临床实践中，医生依赖"识别解剖异常→解读病理表现→得出诊断结论"的结构化因果链，因此需要让模型学会这种临床式因果推理。
AI.method:
方法由数据、架构、优化三部分组成。

(1) CRMed 数据集与结构化因果分解。将诊断推理建模为三变量条件生成：p(Y,P,A|I,q)=p(Y|A,P,I,q)·p(P|A,I,q)·p(A|I,q)，并给出 SCM：M=⟨V,U,F,P(U)⟩，V={A,P,Y}，U={X_v, X_t, U_c}（视觉/文本隐变量与不可观测混淆因子），结构函数 A=Φ_L(I,q,X_v,U_c)、P=Φ_P(A,X_v,X_t,U_c)、Y=Φ_D(P,X_v,X_t,U_c)，诱导 DAG 主干 A→P→Y 且受混淆带来的伪相关干扰。通过局部化扰动（替换/平移缩放 bounding box、替换同一区域内的病理标签、重写推理链病理成分）构造"代理干预"样本，形成三类集合：D_shortcut（伪相关推理链）、D_partial（逻辑不一致的病理分析）、D_causal（临床可靠因果链）。词表加入反思标记 ⟨CAUSAL⟩、⟨VERIFY⟩，所有样本统一序列结构 S=(I,q,⟨CAUSAL⟩,R_biased,⟨VERIFY⟩,R_gold,y)，即先做初步因果分析、再由验证触发纠错输出gold链。

(2) 两阶段自适应反思架构。基于 Qwen2.5-VL-32B + LoRA(r=64, α=128, dropout 0.05, 目标 q/k/v proj)，模型自主决定何时触发因果分析与验证纠正，推理时执行"初步因果分析→验证→修正"。

(3) 分层优化。阶段 I 因果 SFT：最大化解剖定位 L、因果链 C、诊断标签 y 的联合似然（3 epochs, AdamW, lr 1e-6, wd 5e-5, 梯度裁剪 1.0, 500步 warmup + cosine）。阶段 II 双策略精修：先离策略 DPO（2 epochs, β=0.1），用错误轨迹 D_error 构造偏好对，并通过逐步语义散度定位失败点 t_fail=min{t∈{1,2}: S(Y_err^t,Y_gt^t)<τ}（τ=0.7），对比共享前缀下的错误续写与正确续写；随后在线 GRPO（2000 步, G=8, ε=1e-8），采用复合奖励 R=R_acc+R_format+R_causal，其中因果一致性奖励 Cons(s_i,s_{i+1}) 由 GPT-4o 作为 LLM-judge 以二值评分平均实现。训练用 6×A100 40GB、bfloat16、梯度累积 4 步、8:1:1 分层划分、5 折交叉验证，约 56 小时/数据集。
AI.result: 区域中心任务（表1）：MedCausalX 在 18 项指标中 16 项最优，多区域检测 Reg-F1 达 29.83%，相对 MedRegA 空间定位 F1 提升 +8.59%（如区域识别 BLEU-1 80.11 vs 78.34、IoU 72.75 vs 68.52）；仅在文本流畅度（BertScore 等）略低于 MedRegA。医学 VQA（表2）：四基准平均 Acc 81.2%、Diag-C 78.7%、幻觉率 36.4%，相较 MedVLM-R1 准确率 79.1%→81.2%、幻觉率 47.1%→36.4%（-10.7 点）、诊断一致性提升约 +5.4 点；SLAKE 87.2/81.5、VQA-RAD 79.8/79.8、PathVQA 73.2/73.2、PMC-VQA 84.6/84.6。报告生成（表3，MIMIC-CXR）：BLEU-1 37.18（vs MedRegA 33.18）、Region Acc 81.12、Align Acc 67.38、IoU 55.71。消融（表4）：移除 CRMed 降至 26.47 BLEU-1，移除反思标记 29.93，移除因果 SFT 26.02，移除 RL 26.96，移除错误收集 32.02；逐级叠加 Base 23.15 → +SFT 32.45 → +DPO 35.62 → +GRPO 37.18。超参（表5、9、10）：τ=0.7 与 G=8 最优，DPO→GRPO 顺序优于 GRPO→DPO 达 5.7 点，奖励权重 λ_acc/λ_causal=0.5/0.5 最佳。放射科专家（20 年以上资历）3 分制评估中空间定位 1.39、诊断质量 1.48 分（越低越好），优于 MedRegA 与 Med-R1。跨域零样本（表11）：OVQA 58.4、EndoVis-VQA 54.2、Skin-VQA 59.7、平均 57.4（较 InternVL-2 49.2 提升 8.2 点；OVQA +8.1、Skin-VQA +9.9）。规模分析（表7、8）：3B 68.6 → 7B 74.4 → 32B 81.2 平均准确率；训练动态显示 DPO 预训练后 GRPO 奖励更高（0.845 vs 0.791）且推理更紧凑（约 850 token）。
AI.conclusion: MedCausalX 通过"数据级因果监督 + 自适应反思推理机制 + 分层优化"的统一范式，将医学 VLM 从相关性驱动的模式匹配推向可验证的因果推理链：用 A→P→Y 的结构化因果分解替代浅层伪相关，用 ⟨causal⟩/⟨verify⟩ 反思标记把静态 CoT 转为推理期动态的因果中断检测与纠错，用轨迹级监督与错误归因 RL（先 DPO 后 GRPO）保证全局因果一致性并抑制捷径关联。实验与放射科专家评估表明其在定位精度、诊断一致性、幻觉抑制与跨域泛化上均设新标准，说明显式因果归纳偏置带来的增益可超越单纯参数规模扩展，是构建可信临床多模态 AI 的可行路径。局限上，作者将局部扰动明确定义为对 do(A)、do(P) 的"代理干预"近似而非精确 Pearl 干预；因果一致性奖励依赖 GPT-4o 评判，且标注与专家评估样本量相对有限。

title: SkillRouter: Retrieve-and-Rerank Skill Selection for LLM Agents at Scale
summary: As LLM agent ecosystems grow, the number of available skills (tools, plugins) has reached tens of thousands, making it infeasible to inject all skills into an agent's context. This creates a need for skill routing -- retrieving the most relevant skills from a large pool given a user task. The problem is compounded by pervasive functional overlap in community skill repositories, where many skills share similar names and purposes yet differ in implementation details. Despite its practical importance, skill routing remains under-explored. Current agent architectures adopt a progressive disclosure design -- exposing only skill names and descriptions to the agent while keeping the full implementation body hidden -- implicitly treating metadata as sufficient for selection. We challenge this assumption through a systematic empirical study on a benchmark of ~$80K skills and 75 expert-verified queries. Our key finding is that the skill body (full implementation text) is the decisive signal: removing it causes 29--44 percentage point degradation across all retrieval methods, and cross-encoder attention analysis reveals 91.7% of attention concentrating on the body field. Motivated by this finding, we propose SkillRouter, a two-stage retrieve-and-rerank pipeline totaling only 1.2B parameters (0.6B encoder + 0.6B reranker). SkillRouter achieves 74.0% top-1 routing accuracy and delivers the strongest average result among the compact and zero-shot baselines we evaluate, while remaining deployable on consumer hardware.

AI.tldr: 针对大规模LLM Agent技能库中的技能路由问题，研究发现技能实现体（body）比元数据更重要，去除后导致29-44%的性能下降。提出SkillRouter——1.2B参数的检索-重排两阶段模型，达到74.0%的Top-1准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent生态系统中技能数量已达数万，现有的渐进式披露设计假设元数据足以进行技能选择，但社区技能库中存在大量功能重叠的技能（名称相似但实现不同），使得技能路由面临挑战。
AI.method: 1) 构建~80K技能和75个专家验证查询的基准测试；2) 系统消融实验验证技能body字段的决定性作用（交叉编码器注意力分析显示91.7%注意力集中在body）；3) 提出两阶段retrieve-and-rerank管道：0.6B编码器 + 0.6B重排器。
AI.result: 去除技能body导致所有检索方法下降29-44个百分点；SkillRouter达到74.0% Top-1路由准确率，在compact和zero-shot基线中表现最优；可部署于消费级硬件。
AI.conclusion: 技能body是技能路由的决定性信号，当前仅依赖元数据的渐进式披露设计存在根本性缺陷。SkillRouter通过结合技能实现体信息，以紧凑模型规模实现了高效准确的技能路由。

title: Between Rules and Reality: On the Context Sensitivity of LLM Moral Judgment
summary: A human's moral decision depends heavily on the context. Yet research on LLM morality has largely studied fixed scenarios. We address this gap by introducing Contextual MoralChoice, a dataset of moral dilemmas with systematic contextual variations known from moral psychology to shift human judgment: consequentialist, emotional, and relational. Evaluating 22 LLMs, we find that nearly all models are context-sensitive, shifting their judgments toward rule-violating behavior. Comparing with a human survey, we find that models and humans are most triggered by different contextual variations, and that a model aligned with human judgments in the base case is not necessarily aligned in its contextual sensitivity. This raises the question of controlling contextual sensitivity, which we address with an activation steering approach that can reliably increase or decrease a model's contextual sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 该研究创建"Contextual MoralChoice"数据集，系统探究情境因素对LLM道德判断的影响，评估22个模型，发现LLM对情境敏感但与人类触发点不同，提出激活steering方法控制场景敏感度。
AI.motivation: 人类道德决策高度依赖情境，但现有LLM道德研究主要使用固定场景，缺乏对情境变量系统影响的研究。
AI.method: 构建包含三类情境变量的数据集（后果主义、情感、关系性），评估22个LLM，进行人类问卷对比，开发激活steering方法。
AI.result: 几乎所有模型表现出情境敏感性，倾向于向违规行为改变；模型与人类触发的情境变量类型不同；基础情境对齐不等于敏感度对齐。
AI.conclusion: 激活steering可有效控制模型情境敏感性，为LLM道德判断可控性提供新途径。

title: Describe-Then-Act: Proactive Agent Steering via Distilled Language-Action World Models
summary: Deploying safety-critical agents requires anticipating the consequences of actions before they are executed. While world models offer a paradigm for this proactive foresight, current approaches relying on visual simulation incur prohibitive latencies, often exceeding several seconds per step. In this work, we challenge the assumption that visual processing is necessary for failure prevention. We show that a trained policy's latent state, combined with its planned actions, already encodes sufficient information to anticipate action outcomes, making visual simulation redundant for failure prevention. To this end, we introduce DILLO (DIstiLLed Language-ActiOn World Model), a fast steering layer that shifts the paradigm from "simulate-then-act" to "describe-then-act." DILLO is trained via cross-modal distillation, where a privileged Vision Language Model teacher annotates offline trajectories and a latent-conditioned Large Language Model student learns to predict semantic outcomes. This creates a text-only inference path, bypassing heavy visual generation entirely, achieving a 14x speedup over baselines. Experiments on MetaWorld and LIBERO demonstrate that DILLO produces high-fidelity descriptions of the next state and is able to steer the policy, improving episode success rate by up to 15 pp and 9.3 pp on average across tasks.

AI.tldr: DILLO提出了一种新的范式转换：从"模拟后行动"(simulate-then-act)转向"描述后行动"(describe-then-act)。通过跨模态蒸馏训练，将视觉语言模型的语义理解能力迁移到纯文本推理的大语言模型中，从而完全绕过视觉生成，实现14倍加速，并在MetaWorld和LIBERO任务上将成功率分别提升最高15个百分点和平均9.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 当前世界模型依赖视觉仿真进行安全关键决策，但存在极高延迟(每步数秒)，计算成本高昂。这促使研究者质疑视觉处理是否真的是故障预防的必要条件。
AI.method: 采用跨模态蒸馏策略：1) 使用特权视觉语言模型(VLM)教师对离线轨迹进行语义标注；2) 训练基于潜在状态条件的大型语言模型(LLM)学生预测动作的语义结果。推理时完全绕过视觉生成，仅依赖文本推理路径。
AI.result: 实现14倍加速；生成高保真下一状态描述；在MetaWorld和LIBERO基准上，任务成功率分别提升最高15个百分点和平均9.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 训练好的策略的潜在状态结合其规划动作已包含足够信息来预测动作结果，视觉仿真对于故障预防而言是冗余的。DILLO验证了"描述后行动"范式的可行性。

title: Adversarial Vulnerabilities in Neural Operator Digital Twins: Gradient-Free Attacks on Nuclear Thermal-Hydraulic Surrogates
summary: Operator learning models are rapidly emerging as the predictive core of digital twins for nuclear and energy systems, promising real-time field reconstruction from sparse sensor measurements. Yet their robustness to adversarial perturbations remains uncharacterized, a critical gap for deployment in safety-critical systems. Here we show that neural operators are acutely vulnerable to extremely sparse (fewer than 1% of inputs), physically plausible perturbations that exploit their sensitivity to boundary conditions. Using gradient-free differential evolution across four operator architectures, we demonstrate that minimal modifications trigger catastrophic prediction failures, increasing relative $L_2$ error from $\sim$1.5% (validated accuracy) to 37-63% while remaining completely undetectable by standard validation metrics. Notably, 100% of successful single-point attacks pass z-score anomaly detection. We introduce the effective perturbation dimension $d_{\text{eff}}$, a Jacobian-based diagnostic that, together with sensitivity magnitude, yields a two-factor vulnerability model explaining why architectures with extreme sensitivity concentration (POD-DeepONet, $d_{\text{eff}} \approx 1$) are not necessarily the most exploitable, since low-rank output projections cap maximum error, while moderate concentration with sufficient amplification (S-DeepONet, $d_{\text{eff}} \approx 4$) produces the highest attack success. Gradient-free search outperforms gradient-based alternatives (PGD) on architectures with gradient pathologies, while random perturbations of equal magnitude achieve near-zero success rates, confirming that the discovered vulnerabilities are structural. Our findings expose a previously overlooked attack surface in operator learning models and establish that these models require robustness guarantees beyond standard validation before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统揭示了神经算子（Neural Operators）在关键基础设施数字孪生应用中的对抗脆弱性。研究表明，仅需不到1%的输入扰动即可使预测相对L2误差从1.5%飙升至37-63%，且100%成功攻击可绕过z-score异常检测。作者提出了"有效扰动维度"($d_{\text{eff}}$)这一新诊断指标，揭示了架构敏感度与可利用性之间的非线性关系。
AI.motivation: 神经算子正成为核能与能源系统数字孪生的预测核心，但其在对抗性扰动下的鲁棒性尚属空白。这对安全关键系统的部署构成严重威胁，因为敌方可能通过微小物理扰动触发灾难性预测失败。
AI.method: 1) 采用无梯度差分进化算法在四种算子架构上进行攻击搜索；2) 提出基于雅可比矩阵的"有效扰动维度"($d_{\text{eff}}$)诊断指标；3) 对比梯度攻击(PGD)与随机扰动的效果；4) 使用z-score异常检测评估攻击隐蔽性。
AI.result: 1) 稀疏物理扰动可使预测误差从~1.5%增至37-63%；2) 100%单点攻击成功绕过z-score异常检测；3) 极端敏感度集中(POD-DeepONet, $d_{\text{eff}} \approx 1$)不一定是最高可利用性，因低秩输出投影限制了最大误差；4) 中等敏感度集中但具有足够放大能力的架构(S-DeepONet, $d_{\text{eff}} \approx 4$)攻击成功率最高；5) 无梯度搜索对梯度病态架构优于PGD；6) 随机扰动几乎无效，确认漏洞的结构性本质。
AI.conclusion: 神经算子存在此前被忽视的攻击面，需在部署前获得超越标准验证的鲁棒性保证。$d_{\text{eff}}$与敏感度幅值构成的二维脆弱性模型可有效解释和预测不同架构的可利用性。极端敏感度集中≠高可利用性，中等敏感度集中配合足够放大能力才是最高风险特征。

title: SAiW: Source-Attributable Invisible Watermarking for Proactive Deepfake Defense
summary: Deepfakes generated by modern generative models pose a serious threat to information integrity, digital identity, and public trust. Existing detection methods are largely reactive, attempting to identify manipulations after they occur and often failing to generalize across evolving generation techniques. This motivates the need for proactive mechanisms that secure media authenticity at the time of creation. In this work, we introduce SAiW, a Source-Attributed Invisible watermarking Framework for proactive deepfake defense and media provenance verification. Unlike conventional watermarking methods that treat watermark payloads as generic signals, SAiW formulates watermark embedding as a source-conditioned representation learning problem, where watermark identity encodes the originating source and modulates the embedding process to produce discriminative and traceable signatures. The framework integrates feature-wise linear modulation to inject source identity into the embedding network, enabling scalable multi-source watermark generation. A perceptual guidance module derived from human visual system priors ensures that watermark perturbations remain visually imperceptible while maintaining robustness. In addition, a dual-purpose forensic decoder simultaneously reconstructs the embedded watermark and performs source attribution, providing both automated verification and interpretable forensic evidence. Extensive experiments across multiple deepfake datasets demonstrate that SAiW achieves high perceptual quality while maintaining strong robustness against compression, filtering, noise, geometric transformations, and adversarial perturbations. By binding digital media to its origin through invisible yet verifiable markers, SAiW enables reliable authentication and source attribution, providing a scalable foundation for proactive deepfake defense and trustworthy media provenance.

AI.tldr: SAiW提出了一种基于源属性隐水印的主动式深度伪造防御框架，通过条件表示学习将来源身份嵌入水印信号，结合感知引导模块和双用途取证解码器，实现高感知质量、强鲁棒性和可扩展的多来源水印生成与溯源验证。
AI.motivation: 当前深度伪造检测方法多为被动式，难以应对不断演进的生成技术；传统水印方法将载荷视为通用信号，忽略了来源信息的多样性；亟需一种在媒体创建时即保障其真实性的主动式防御机制。
AI.method: 提出SAiW框架，核心包括：1）将水印嵌入建模为源条件化表示学习问题，使用特征级线性调制（FiLM）注入来源身份；2）基于人眼视觉系统先验设计感知引导模块确保视觉不可感知性；3）构建双用途取证解码器同时重建水印载荷并完成来源归属。
AI.result: 在多个深度伪造数据集上的实验表明，SAiW在保持高感知质量的同时，对压缩、滤波、噪声、几何变换和对抗扰动均展现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SAiW通过将数字媒体与起源绑定，提供了一种可扩展的主动式深度伪造防御和可信媒体溯源基础。

title: Multimodal Training to Unimodal Deployment: Leveraging Unstructured Data During Training to Optimize Structured Data Only Deployment
summary: Unstructured Electronic Health Record (EHR) data, such as clinical notes, contain clinical contextual observations that are not directly reflected in structured data fields. This additional information can substantially improve model learning. However, due to their unstructured nature, these data are often unavailable or impractical to use when deploying a model. We introduce a multimodal learning framework that leverages unstructured EHR data during training while producing a model that can be deployed using only structured EHR data. Using a cohort of 3,466 children evaluated for late talking, we generated note embeddings with BioClinicalBERT and encoded structured embeddings from demographics and medical codes. A note-based teacher model and a structured-only student model were jointly trained using contrastive learning and contrastive knowledge distillation loss, producing a strong classifier (AUROC = 0.985). Our proposed model reached an AUROC of 0.705, outperforming the structured-only baseline of 0.656. These results demonstrate that incorporating unstructured data during training enhances the model's capacity to identify task-relevant information within structured EHR data, enabling a deployable structured-only phenotype model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多模态学习框架，在训练时利用非结构化电子健康记录（EHR）数据（如临床笔记），但在部署时仅需结构化数据即可运行。通过对比学习和对比知识蒸馏损失，联合训练基于笔记的教师模型和纯结构化学生模型，应用于3466名迟语评估儿童队列，最终模型AUROC达到0.705，优于仅用结构化数据的基线模型（0.656）。
AI.motivation: 非结构化EHR数据（如临床笔记）包含丰富的临床上下文信息，但模型部署时往往无法获取这些数据。如何在训练阶段利用非结构化数据的优势，同时在部署阶段仅依赖结构化数据，是一个实际挑战。
AI.method: 使用BioClinicalBERT生成笔记嵌入，编码人口统计学和医疗代码的结构化嵌入；采用对比学习和对比知识蒸馏损失联合训练教师模型（基于笔记）和学生模型（仅结构化数据）。
AI.result: 在3466名迟语评估儿童队列中，教师模型AUROC达到0.985；提出的学生模型AUROC为0.705，显著优于仅用结构化数据的基线（0.656）。
AI.conclusion: 训练时融入非结构化数据可增强模型从结构化EHR数据中识别任务相关信息的能力，实现可部署的纯结构化表型模型。

title: PERMA: Benchmarking Personalized Memory Agents via Event-Driven Preference and Realistic Task Environments
summary: Empowering large language models with long-term memory is crucial for building agents that adapt to users' evolving needs. However, prior evaluations typically interleave preference-related dialogues with irrelevant conversations, reducing the task to needle-in-a-haystack retrieval while ignoring relationships between events that drive the evolution of user preferences. Such settings overlook a fundamental characteristic of real-world personalization: preferences emerge gradually and accumulate across interactions within noisy contexts. To bridge this gap, we introduce PERMA, a benchmark designed to evaluate persona consistency over time beyond static preference recall. Additionally, we incorporate (1) text variability and (2) linguistic alignment to simulate erratic user inputs and individual idiolects in real-world data. PERMA consists of temporally ordered interaction events spanning multiple sessions and domains, with preference-related queries inserted over time. We design both multiple-choice and interactive tasks to probe the model's understanding of persona along the interaction timeline. Experiments demonstrate that by linking related interactions, advanced memory systems can extract more precise preferences and reduce token consumption, outperforming traditional semantic retrieval of raw dialogues. Nevertheless, they still struggle to maintain a coherent persona across temporal depth and cross-domain interference, highlighting the need for more robust personalized memory management in agents. Our code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/PolarisLiu1/PERMA.

AI.tldr: PERMA是一个评估LLM智能体在长时间交互中保持人格一致性的基准测试，针对现有评估忽视偏好随时间逐渐演化的缺陷而设计。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM长期记忆评估将偏好对话与无关内容混杂，仅测试检索能力，忽视了真实场景中用户偏好在嘈杂语境中逐渐形成和积累的特性。
AI.method: 设计时序排列的多会话多领域交互事件，融入文本变异性和语言对齐模拟真实用户输入，构建多选题和交互式任务评估模型在时间线上的角色理解能力。
AI.result: 链接相关交互的记忆系统优于传统语义检索，但仍在时间深度和跨域干扰下难以保持连贯人格。
AI.conclusion: 需要更鲁棒的个人化记忆管理机制；代码和数据已开源。

title: MIOFlow 2.0: A unified framework for inferring cellular stochastic dynamics from single cell and spatial transcriptomics data
summary:
Understanding cellular trajectories via time-resolved single-cell transcriptomics is vital for studying development, regeneration, and disease. A key challenge is inferring continuous trajectories from discrete snapshots. Biological complexity stems from stochastic cell fate decisions, temporal proliferation changes, and spatial environmental influences. Current methods often use deterministic interpolations treating cells in isolation, failing to capture the probabilistic branching, population shifts, and niche-dependent signaling driving real biological processes.
  We introduce Manifold Interpolating Optimal-Transport Flow (MIOFlow) 2.0. This framework learns biologically informed cellular trajectories by integrating manifold learning, optimal transport, and neural differential equations. It models three core processes: (1) stochasticity and branching via Neural Stochastic Differential Equations; (2) non-conservative population changes using a learned growth-rate model initialized with unbalanced optimal transport; and (3) environmental influence through a joint latent space unifying gene expression with spatial features like local cell type composition and signaling.
  By operating in a PHATE-distance matching autoencoder latent space, MIOFlow 2.0 ensures trajectories respect the data's intrinsic geometry. Empirical comparisons show expressive trajectory learning via neural differential equations outperforms existing generative models, including simulation-free flow matching. Validated on synthetic datasets, embryoid body differentiation, and spatially resolved axolotl brain regeneration, MIOFlow 2.0 improves trajectory accuracy and reveals hidden drivers of cellular transitions, like specific signaling niches. MIOFlow 2.0 thus bridges single-cell and spatial transcriptomics to uncover tissue-scale trajectories.

AI.tldr: MIOFlow 2.0是一个整合流形学习、最优传输和神经微分方程的框架，用于从单细胞转录组快照数据推断细胞命运轨迹。该方法解决了现有方法忽视随机性、分支结构、群体动态和空间微环境影响的问题。
AI.motivation: 从单细胞转录组的离散快照中推断连续细胞轨迹是研究发育、再生和疾病的关键。当前方法存在以下局限：(1)使用确定性插值，忽略细胞命运决策的随机性；(2)将细胞作为独立个体处理，未考虑群体动态变化；(3)缺乏空间微环境信息的整合。这些问题导致无法准确捕捉实际的生物学过程，如概率性分支、群体比例变化和空间依赖性信号传导。
AI.method: MIOFlow 2.0在PHATE距离匹配的自编码器潜在空间中运行，通过三个核心模块建模细胞轨迹：(1)神经随机微分方程(Neural SDEs)建模随机性和分支；(2)基于非平衡最优传输初始化的发展速率模型处理非保守性群体变化；(3)联合潜在空间整合基因表达与空间特征(局部细胞类型组成、信号传导)。
AI.result: 在合成数据集、类胚体分化和空间解析的蝾螈脑再生数据上的验证表明：MIOFlow 2.0在轨迹推断准确性上优于现有生成模型(包括无模拟的Flow Matching方法)；能够识别驱动细胞转换的隐藏因素，如特定信号微环境；成功桥接单细胞转录组与空间转录组数据。
AI.conclusion: MIOFlow 2.0通过融合几何感知学习、最优传输理论和神经微分方程，为组织尺度上的细胞轨迹建模提供了统一框架。该工作为理解复杂生物过程中的命运决定机制、群体动态调控和空间微环境作用提供了新工具。

title: MemCollab: Cross-Agent Memory Collaboration via Contrastive Trajectory Distillation
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents rely on memory mechanisms to reuse knowledge from past problem-solving experiences. Existing approaches typically construct memory in a per-agent manner, tightly coupling stored knowledge to a single model's reasoning style. In modern deployments with heterogeneous agents, a natural question arises: can a single memory system be shared across different models? We found that naively transferring memory between agents often degrades performance, as such memory entangles task-relevant knowledge with agent-specific biases. To address this challenge, we propose MemCollab, a collaborative memory framework that constructs agent-agnostic memory by contrasting reasoning trajectories generated by different agents on the same task. This contrastive process distills abstract reasoning constraints that capture shared task-level invariants while suppressing agent-specific artifacts. We further introduce a task-aware retrieval mechanism that conditions memory access on task category, ensuring that only relevant constraints are used at inference time. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that MemCollab consistently improves both accuracy and inference-time efficiency across diverse agents, including cross-modal-family settings. Our results show that the collaboratively constructed memory can function as a shared reasoning resource for diverse LLM-based agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemColcollab框架，通过对比不同智能体在同一任务上的推理轨迹，构建与智能体无关的共享记忆系统，解决异构智能体间记忆复用难题，并在数学推理和代码生成任务上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的记忆机制采用独立构建方式，记忆与单一模型的推理风格紧耦合。当在异构智能体环境中部署时，如何跨模型共享记忆成为关键问题。直接迁移记忆会导致性能下降，因为记忆纠缠了任务相关知识与智能体特定的偏见。
AI.method: MemCollab采用对比学习机制：对比不同智能体解决同一任务时生成的推理轨迹，提取抽象推理约束（捕获共享的任务级不变量），同时抑制智能体特定的伪影。此外，引入任务感知的检索机制，根据任务类别条件化记忆访问，确保推理时仅使用相关约束。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准测试上的实验表明，MemCollab在多种智能体（包括跨模态族设置）上均能一致性地提升准确率和推理时效率。
AI.conclusion: 协作构建的记忆可以作为多样化LLM智能体的共享推理资源，实现跨智能体的有效知识复用。

title: A Foundation Model for Instruction-Conditioned In-Context Time Series Tasks
summary: In-context learning (ICL) allows a model to adapt at inference time by conditioning on examples rather than updating parameters. Existing time-series foundation models use implicit positional context, retrieval, or task-specific objectives, but rarely explicit instruction-conditioned demonstrations. We present a foundation model for instruction-conditioned in-context time-series tasks based on a quantile-regression T5 encoder-decoder. Historical examples and queries are encoded with a structured tokenization scheme that marks target series, covariates, context, and task-specific future information. A hierarchical Transformer with per-example encoding, example-level fusion, and cross-example attention conditions decoding on demonstration pairs, enabling forecasting and related tasks without task-specific fine-tuning. We train on large-scale real and synthetic time series using supervised forecasting plus self-supervised tasks, including imputation, reconstruction, classification, anomaly detection, and source demixing. This multi-task training learns a distribution over task mappings and improves adaptation to local structure at inference time. Across diverse datasets, frequencies, and horizons, our method outperforms strong foundation baselines on point and probabilistic forecasting benchmarks, including fev-bench and GIFT-Eval, while remaining competitive on classification and anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个指令条件化的时序基础模型，通过分位数回归T5编码器-解码器架构和层级Transformer实现上下文学习，支持零样本 Forecasting、分类、异常检测等多任务，无需任务特定微调。
AI.motivation: 现有时序基础模型主要依赖隐式位置上下文、检索或任务特定目标，缺乏显式的指令条件化演示机制。上下文学习（ICL）允许模型在推理时通过条件化示例而非更新参数来适应，但时序领域尚未充分利用这一范式。
AI.method: 1) 量化回归T5编码器-解码器作为骨干；2) 结构化tokenization方案标记目标序列、共变量、上下文和任务特定未来信息；3) 层级Transformer包含示例内编码、示例级融合和跨示例注意力机制；4) 多任务训练：监督 Forecasting + 自监督任务（插补、重构、分类、异常检测、源分离）。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、频率和预测 horizon 上，Point和概率 Forecasting 基准测试中优于强基线（包括 FEV-Bench 和 GIFT-Eval），分类和异常检测任务具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 指令条件化 + 多任务学习使模型学会任务映射分布，提升推理时对局部结构的适应能力，为时序领域的通用基础模型提供了新的范式。

title: Online library learning in human visual puzzle solving
summary: When learning a novel complex task, people often form efficient reusable abstractions that simplify future work, despite uncertainty about the future. We study this process in a visual puzzle task where participants define and reuse helpers -- intermediate constructions that capture repeating structure. In an online experiment, participants solved puzzles of increasing difficulty. Early on, they created many helpers, favouring completeness over efficiency. With experience, helper use became more selective and efficient, reflecting sensitivity to reuse and cost. Access to helpers enabled participants to solve puzzles that were otherwise difficult or impossible. Computational modelling shows that human decision times and number of operations used to complete a puzzle increase with search space estimated by a program induction model with library learning. In contrast, raw program length predicts failure but not effort. Together, these results point to online library learning as a core mechanism in human problem solving, allowing people to flexibly build, refine, and reuse abstractions as task demands grow.

AI.tldr: 研究人类如何在学习复杂视觉任务时动态构建和复用抽象结构（helpers），通过在线实验和计算建模证明"库学习"是人类问题解决的核心机制。
AI.motivation: 人类在面对不确定性时仍能高效构建可复用的抽象，但这一过程的具体机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 在线实验（视觉谜题任务）+ 程序归纳计算模型（带库学习）
AI.result: 早期创建helpers倾向完整性，经验积累后变得选择性更强且高效；helpers使原本困难/不可能的谜题可解；决策时间和操作数量与搜索空间相关，而非程序长度。
AI.conclusion: 在线库学习（library learning）是人类问题解决的核心机制，使人类能够灵活构建、精炼和复用抽象。

title: Precision-Varying Prediction (PVP): Robustifying ASR systems against adversarial attacks
summary: With the increasing deployment of automated and agentic systems, ensuring the adversarial robustness of automatic speech recognition (ASR) models has become critical. We observe that changing the precision of an ASR model during inference reduces the likelihood of adversarial attacks succeeding. We take advantage of this fact to make the models more robust by simple random sampling of the precision during prediction. Moreover, the insight can be turned into an adversarial example detection strategy by comparing outputs resulting from different precisions and leveraging a simple Gaussian classifier. An experimental analysis demonstrates a significant increase in robustness and competitive detection performance for various ASR models and attack types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Precision-Varying Prediction（PVP）：利用 ASR 模型推理阶段的数值精度（FP32/FP16/BF16）切换，使对抗样本因跨精度不稳定而失效。核心机制有两层：（1）推理时随机采样精度即可"免费"提升对抗鲁棒性（无需重训练、无需改动结构、无损正常识别精度）；（2）用多精度转写文本两两 WER 差异构造"精度多样性分数"并拟合高斯分布，作为轻量级对抗样本检测器；再与基于预测熵的 DistriBlock 组合成混合防御（Hybrid_JS / Hybrid_MP），显著抬高自适应攻击的"可听噪声"代价。
AI.motivation: ASR 模型被大量部署于智能家居、自动驾驶、医疗等安全关键场景，已有研究表明 ASR 易受精心设计的对抗扰动攻击。现有防御各有明显缺陷：输入变换类防御会引入延迟与感知音频失真，且一旦攻击者在优化中纳入该变换即失效；对抗训练因生成大规模对抗样本的算力开销而难以扩展；检测类方法如 Noise Flooding 需多次查询、计算昂贵，Temporal-Dependency 严格依赖最小音频长度，DistriBlock 等不确定性方法则必须访问 token 级分布、限制在受限访问场景的应用；且所有检测方法都易被"防御感知"的自适应攻击绕过。此外，图像域已有的混合精度集成/动态位截断方案在语音域不可行：多模型并存显存与时延开销大、变长序列转写难以对齐；整数位截断会引入量化噪声损害基线精度。作者由此提出问题：能否仅利用推理期数值精度这一"原生硬件属性"，以极低代价同时获得鲁棒性与检测能力。
AI.method: 1) 精度敏感性的形式化：将 ASR 抽象为函数 f_p(·)，p∈𝒫 为可配置的推理计算精度（仅操纵暴露的 compute precision，区别于存储精度与训练精度）。假设在源精度 p_s 下构造的对抗样本 x̃，在另一精度 p_a 下输出不再匹配（f_{p_s}(x̃)≠f_{p_a}(x̃)），而良性输入跨精度输出稳定。2) 鲁棒化：推理时随机采样精度（FP32/FP16/BF16），使针对单一精度优化的扰动失效。3) 检测：对 K 种精度分别前向得到转写集合 𝒴(x)，以 WER 作为序列相似度 s，计算平均两两差异即"精度多样性分数" D(x)=2/(K(K−1))·Σ_{i<j} s(f_{p_i}(x), f_{p_j}(x))；用良性样本的 D 拟合高斯分布 N(μ,σ²)，偏离即判为对抗。4) 混合防御：与 DistriBlock 的 mean entropy（逐时间步 token 概率的 Shannon 熵均值）组合，Hybrid_JS 用 [mean entropy, D(x)] 二维特征，Hybrid_MP 拼接各精度的 mean entropy 组成特征向量，拟合多元正态（MVN），以对数密度偏离判别。5) 自适应攻击：多精度 C&W 变体，联合所有精度前向可微损失优化扰动（因 WER 在解码后不可微，攻击者只能使用可微代理目标）。实验覆盖 CTC / seq2seq / Transformer / Whisper 四架构 × 三种训练精度共 18 个模型，英文 LibriSpeech（test-clean/test-other）与德文 Mozilla Common Voice，攻击为 C&W 与心理声学攻击，指标为 WER/SER、SNR_seg 失真度、AUROC。
AI.result: 良性性能：跨精度与随机精度推理下 WER/SER 相对固定精度基线几乎无退化（如 CTC-FP32 在 LibriSpeech test-clean 为 2.04/25.50，随机采样 2.04/25.51；德文 Common Voice CTC-FP32 9.19/43.50 vs 9.18/43.46），仅 seq2seq-FP16 在 BF16 下退化略明显（5.75/59.39），说明精度变化不损害基线精度、也无语言特异性退化。鲁棒性：匹配精度时攻击几乎完全成功（WER/SER≈0，SNR_seg 保持较高水平即失真可感知度低）；改变推理精度后 WER/SER 在所有架构上一致上升，随机精度采样下攻击普遍被削弱（如 Whisper-FP32 C&W 由 0 降至 47.25/43.80，seq2seq-FP32 由 0 升至 18.50/41.20），且 BF16 训练模型在精度失配下表现出最高鲁棒性（因其尾数精度低，攻击利用的数值间距在 FP16/FP32 精细网格下不稳定）。检测：PVP 在 CTC 与 seq2seq 上 AUROC>0.90（最高 0.99），Transformer 与 Whisper 因大规模预训练与内建混合精度优化而效果下降（如 Transformer-FP32 0.86/0.64/0.75，Whisper-FP32 0.93/0.79/0.86）；良性分数分布集中在零附近（如 CTC-FP32 μ±σ=0.17±1.75，seq2seq-BF16 0.61±4.23），故良性误报少。效率上 PVP 把平均单样本推理时间从 Noise Flooding 的 7.36 s 降至 0.08 s（CTC 模型，NVIDIA A40 48GB）。混合防御在德文基准上取得最优：Hybrid_JS 在全部精度上 AUROC≥0.98（CTC-FP32 达 0.99），优于 DistriBlock（0.95–0.96）与 Hybrid_MP（0.95–0.96）。自适应攻击方面：多精度自适应 C&W 可使所有防御 SER 归零（攻击完全成功），说明 PVP 与现有防御一样可被绕过；但绕过成本显著上升——单独 PVP/DistriBlock 只需 SNR_seg 14.50–18.79 dB，Hybrid_JS 降至 8.37–10.09 dB，Hybrid_MP 最极端，CTC-FP32 降至 −0.54 dB，即噪声明显可听，攻击者被迫在"规避检测"与"听觉不可感知"间取舍，此时各防御 AUROC 回落至 0.47–0.70。
AI.conclusion: 数值精度是现代 ASR 模型自带的"免费"鲁棒性来源：对抗样本对精度变化表现出区别于良性输入的显著不稳定性，而良性转写跨精度保持一致。据此构成双层防御范式——推理期随机精度采样用于提升基线鲁棒性（零重训练、零结构改动、无精度损失），精度多样性分数用于轻量级统计检测（无需神经网络训练、无需访问 token 分布），并进一步与不确定性特征（DistriBlock 的 mean entropy）融合为混合防御，把自适应攻击的绕过代价从"可听噪声"级别推高，从而有效抬高安全边界。局限在于：Transformer/Whisper 等大规模预训练模型上的检测性能下降；显式针对精度多样性的自适应攻击仍可完全成功（PVP 并未提供认证式的确定性保证，与所有现有防御框架共享该脆弱性）；检测依赖 K 次前向带来的额外开销与良性分布拟合。后续工作方向是将更多已有防御模态纳入混合框架，构建更全面的自适应威胁屏障。

title: LLM Olympiad: Why Model Evaluation Needs a Sealed Exam
summary: Benchmarks and leaderboards are how NLP most often communicates progress, but in the LLM era they are increasingly easy to misread. Scores can reflect benchmark-chasing, hidden evaluation choices, or accidental exposure to test content -- not just broad capability. Closed benchmarks delay some of these issues, but reduce transparency and make it harder for the community to learn from results. We argue for a complementary practice: an Olympiad-style evaluation event where problems are sealed until evaluation, submissions are frozen in advance, and all entries run through one standardized harness. After scoring, the full task set and evaluation code are released so results can be reproduced and audited. This design aims to make strong performance harder to ``manufacture'' and easier to trust.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM时代NLP基准测试和排行榜的问题，提出奥林匹克式评估事件作为补充方案，通过问题密封、提交冻结、统一评估框架和结果公开等方式，提高评估的可信度和可审计性。
AI.motivation: 当前NLP基准测试和排行榜容易被误读，主要原因包括：基准测试追逐（benchmark-chasing）、隐藏的评估选择、以及测试内容的意外泄露。这些问题导致分数可能无法真实反映模型的广泛能力。虽然封闭式基准测试可以缓解部分问题，但会降低透明度。
AI.method: 提出奥林匹克式评估事件方案，具有以下特点：(1) 问题在评估前密封；(2) 提前冻结提交；(3) 所有参赛作品通过统一标准化评估框架运行；(4) 评分后公开完整任务集和评估代码。
AI.result: 无实证结果（本文为立场论文/建议性文章）
AI.conclusion: 该设计旨在使高表现更难被"制造"出来，更值得信赖。通过提高评估过程的透明度和可重现性，增强社区对结果的信任度。

title: Causal Discovery in Action: Learning Chain-Reaction Mechanisms from Interventions
comment: Accepted to the 5th Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning (CLeaR 2026)
summary: Causal discovery is challenging in general dynamical systems because, without strong structural assumptions, the underlying causal graph may not be identifiable even from interventional data. However, many real-world systems exhibit directional, cascade-like structure, in which components activate sequentially and upstream failures suppress downstream effects. We study causal discovery in such chain-reaction systems and show that the causal structure is uniquely identifiable from blocking interventions that prevent individual components from activating. We propose a minimal estimator with finite-sample guarantees, achieving exponential error decay and logarithmic sample complexity. Experiments on synthetic models and diverse chain-reaction environments demonstrate reliable recovery from a few interventions, while observational heuristics fail in regimes with delayed or overlapping causal effects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究链式反应系统中的因果发现，证明通过阻塞干预可唯一识别因果结构，提出具有有限样本保证的最小估计器，实现指数误差衰减和对数样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 因果发现通常在动态系统中难以识别，但实际中许多系统具有级联式结构特征，需要专门的方法来处理这类场景。
AI.method: 使用阻塞干预阻止单个组件激活，基于此设计最小估计器进行因果结构恢复。
AI.result: 因果结构唯一可识别，指数级误差衰减，对数级样本复杂度。实验验证少量干预即可可靠恢复因果结构。
AI.conclusion: 阻塞干预策略使得链式反应系统的因果发现成为可能，且具有坚实的理论和实验支持。

title: RelayS2S: A Dual-Path Speculative Generation for Real-Time Dialogue
summary: Real-time spoken dialogue systems face a fundamental tension between latency and response quality. End-to-end speech-to-speech (S2S) models respond immediately and naturally handle turn-taking, backchanneling, and interruption, but produce semantically weaker outputs. Cascaded pipelines (ASR -> LLM) deliver stronger responses at the cost of latency that grows with model size. We present RelayS2S, a hybrid architecture that runs two paths in parallel upon turn detection. The fast path -- a duplex S2S model -- speculatively drafts a short response prefix that is streamed immediately to TTS for low-latency audio onset, while continuing to monitor live audio events. The slow path -- a cascaded ASR -> LLM pipeline -- generates a higher-quality continuation conditioned on the committed prefix, producing a seamless utterance. A lightweight learned verifier gates the handoff, committing the prefix when appropriate or falling back gracefully to the slow path alone. Experiments show that RelayS2S achieves P90 onset latency comparable to the S2S model while retaining 99% cascaded response quality in average score, with benefits growing as the slow-path model scales. Because the prefix handoff requires no architectural modification to either component, RelayS2S serves as a lightweight, drop-in addition to existing cascaded pipelines. Our code and data are publicly available at: https://github.com/mailong25/relays2s

AI.tldr: RelayS2S是一种混合架构，通过并行运行快速路径（S2S模型）和慢速路径（ASR→LLM级联）并使用轻量级学习验证器控制切换，在保持级联系统99%响应质量的同时，实现与端到端S2S模型相当的P90延迟。
AI.motivation: 实时口语对话系统面临延迟与响应质量的根本矛盾：端到端语音到语音(S2S)模型响应快但输出语义较弱，级联管道(ASR→LLM)质量高但延迟随模型规模增长。
AI.method: RelayS2S采用混合架构，检测到轮次时并行运行两条路径。快速路径使用双工S2S模型 speculative 生成短响应前缀，立即流式传输到TTS以实现低延迟音频起始，同时继续监听实时音频事件；慢速路径使用级联ASR→LLM管道，在已提交前缀的条件下生成更高质量的延续。轻量级学习验证器控制切换，在适当时提交前缀或优雅回退到慢速路径。
AI.result: RelayS2S实现与S2S模型相当的P90起始延迟，同时平均得分保持99%的级联响应质量，且随着慢速路径模型规模增大收益递增。
AI.conclusion: 前缀切换无需对任何组件进行架构修改，RelayS2S可作为现有级联管道的轻量级即插即用扩展。代码和数据已公开。

title: Transfer learning via interpolating structures
comment: preprint submitted to Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing
summary: Despite recent advances in population-based structural health monitoring (PBSHM), knowledge transfer between highly-disparate structures (i.e., heterogeneous populations) remains a challenge. The current work proposes that heterogeneous transfer may be accomplished via intermediate structures that bridge the gap in information between the structures of interest. A key aspect of the technique is the idea that by varying parameters such as material properties and geometry, one structure can be continuously morphed into another. The approach is demonstrated via a case study involving the parameterisation of (and transfer between) simulated heterogeneous bridge designs (Case 1). Transfer between simplified physical representations of a 'bridge' and 'aeroplane' is then demonstrated in Case 2, via a chain of finite-element models. The facetious question 'When is a bridge not an aeroplane?' has been previously asked in the context of predicting positive transfer based on structural similarity. While the obvious answer to this question is 'Always,' the results presented in the current paper show that, in some cases, positive transfer can indeed be achieved between highly-disparate systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通过中间结构实现异构结构间知识迁移的方法。通过参数化调整材料属性和几何特征，使一种结构可逐步变形为另一种结构。案例1验证了异构桥梁设计间的迁移，案例2通过有限元模型链实现了桥梁与飞机结构间的迁移，证明高度迥异的系统之间也可实现正向迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前基于群体的结构健康监测(PBSHM)中，异构结构（即差异极大的结构群体）之间的知识迁移面临挑战，限制了监测技术的泛化应用能力。
AI.method: 提出利用中间结构作为桥梁连接目标结构，通过调整材料属性、几何参数等实现结构的连续变形。案例1采用异构桥梁设计的参数化模型；案例2构建有限元模型链实现'桥梁'到'飞机'的迁移。
AI.result: 研究证明，在某些情况下，高度迥异的系统之间确实可以实现正向迁移，突破了"结构差异越大，迁移效果越差"的传统认知。
AI.conclusion: 中间结构方法有效拓展了PBSHM的适用范围，为异构结构群体的知识迁移提供了可行路径，具有重要的理论和工程应用价值。

title: Beyond Preset Identities: How Agents Form Stances and Boundaries in Generative Societies
summary: While large language models simulate social behaviors, their capacity for stable stance formation and identity negotiation during complex interventions remains unclear. To overcome the limitations of static evaluations, this paper proposes a novel mixed-methods framework combining computational virtual ethnography with quantitative socio-cognitive profiling. By embedding human researchers into generative multiagent communities, controlled discursive interventions are conducted to trace the evolution of collective cognition. To rigorously measure how agents internalize and react to these specific interventions, this paper formalizes three new metrics: Innate Value Bias (IVB), Persuasion Sensitivity, and Trust-Action Decoupling (TAD). Across multiple representative models, agents exhibit endogenous stances that override preset identities, consistently demonstrating an innate progressive bias (IVB > 0). When aligned with these stances, rational persuasion successfully shifts 90% of neutral agents while maintaining high trust. In contrast, conflicting emotional provocations induce a paradoxical 40.0% TAD rate in advanced models, which hypocritically alter stances despite reporting low trust. Smaller models contrastingly maintain a 0% TAD rate, strictly requiring trust for behavioral shifts. Furthermore, guided by shared stances, agents use language interactions to actively dismantle assigned power hierarchies and reconstruct self organized community boundaries. These findings expose the fragility of static prompt engineering, providing a methodological and quantitative foundation for dynamic alignment in human-agent hybrid societies. The official code is available at: https://github.com/armihia/CMASE-Endogenous-Stances

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个混合方法框架，结合计算虚拟民族志与社会认知量化分析，探索大语言模型在多智能体社区中如何形成立场和协商身份。研究发现模型表现出内生性进步偏见，能够理性说服时保持高信任度，但面对冲突性情感挑衅时会出现"信任-行为解耦"现象，且能主动瓦解assigned权力层级结构。
AI.motivation: 当前对LLM的社会行为评估主要依赖静态测试，无法捕捉模型在复杂交互中的立场形成和身份协商过程。这限制了对动态对齐的理解。
AI.method: 混合方法框架：计算虚拟民族志 + 定量社会认知分析。引入三个人类学概念驱动的指标：内在价值偏见(IVB)、说服敏感度和信任-行为解耦(TAD)。通过控制性话语干预追踪集体认知演化。
AI.result: 1) 多模型表现出内生性进步偏见(IVB > 0)；2) 理性说服使90%中立agent改变立场且保持高信任；3) 高级模型面对冲突性情感挑衅时TAD率达40%，表现出虚伪立场改变但低信任；4) 小型模型TAD率为0%，严格依赖信任驱动行为改变；5) Agent能主动瓦解assigned权力层级并重建社区边界。
AI.conclusion: 静态prompt工程的脆弱性被揭示，为人机混合社会中的动态对齐提供方法论和定量基础。

title: Generalizing Dynamics Modeling More Easily from Representation Perspective
summary: Learning system dynamics from observations is a critical problem in many applications over various real-world complex systems, e.g., climate, ecology, and fluid systems. Recently, neural dynamics modeling method have become a prevalent solution that embeds the object's observations into a latent space before learning dynamics using neural methods such as neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODE). Existing dynamics modeling methods induce a specific model for each observation of different complex systems, resulting in poor generalization across systems. Inspired by the great success of pre-trained models, we conduct a generalized Pre-trained Dynamics EncoDER (PDEDER) which can embed the original state observations into a latent space where the dynamics can be captured more easily. To conduct the generalized PDEDER, we pre-train any Pre-trained Language Model (PLM) by minimizing the Lyapunov exponent objective, which constrains the chaotic behavior of governing dynamics learned in the latent space. By penalizing the divergence of embedded observations, our PDEDER promotes locally stable and well-structured latent dynamics, thereby facilitating more effective dynamics modeling than in the original observation space. In addition, we incorporate reconstruction and forecasting objectives to mitigate the risk of obtaining an over-smoothed latent space. Specifically, we collect 152 sets of real-world and synthetic observations from 23 complex systems as pre-training corpora and employ them to pre-train PDEDER. Given any future dynamic observation, we can fine-tune PDEDER with any specific dynamics modeling method. We evaluate PDEDER on 12 dynamic systems by short/long-term forecasting under both in-domain and cross-domain settings, and the empirical results indicate the effectiveness and generalizability of PDEDER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDEDER，一个基于预训练语言模型的通用动力学建模框架，通过Lyapunov指数目标函数预训练，将不同复杂系统的观测数据嵌入到潜在空间进行动力学建模，旨在解决现有方法在不同系统间泛化能力差的问题，并在12个动态系统上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有动力学建模方法针对每个复杂系统训练独立模型，导致跨系统泛化能力差。预训练模型在自然语言处理等领域取得成功启发研究者探索将预训练范式应用于动力学建模领域。
AI.method: 1) 使用预训练语言模型(PLM)作为编码器将原始观测嵌入潜在空间；2) 通过Lyapunov指数目标函数约束潜在空间中的混沌行为；3) 通过惩罚嵌入观测的散度(Divergence)促进局部稳定和良好结构的潜在动力学；4) 结合重建和预测目标避免过平滑的潜在空间。
AI.result: 在12个动态系统上进行短期/长期预测评估，涵盖同领域和跨领域设置，实验结果验证了PDEDER的有效性和泛化能力。预训练语料库包含152组来自23个复杂系统的真实和合成观测数据。
AI.conclusion: PDEDER通过预训练范式成功实现了跨复杂系统的通用动力学建模，结合Lyapunov稳定性约束和重建预测目标，有效提升了模型在潜在空间中的动力学建模能力。

title: Bilevel Autoresearch: Meta-Autoresearching Itself
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables.This paper was primarily drafted by AI agents with human oversight and direction
summary: If autoresearch is itself a form of research, then autoresearch can be applied to research itself. We take this idea literally: we use an autoresearch loop to optimize the autoresearch loop. Every existing autoresearch system -- from Karpathy's single-track loop to AutoResearchClaw's multi-batch extension and EvoScientist's persistent memory -- was improved by a human who read the code, identified a bottleneck, and wrote new code. We ask whether an LLM can do the same, autonomously. We present Bilevel Autoresearch, a bilevel framework where an outer loop meta-optimizes the inner autoresearch loop by generating and injecting new search mechanisms as Python code at runtime. The inner loop optimizes the task; the outer loop optimizes how the inner loop searches. Both loops use the same LLM -- no stronger model is needed at the meta level. On Karpathy's GPT pretraining benchmark, the meta-autoresearch outer loop achieves a 5x improvement over the standard inner loop alone (-0.045 vs. -0.009 val_bpb), while parameter-level adjustment without mechanism change yields no reliable gain. The outer loop autonomously discovers mechanisms from combinatorial optimization, multi-armed bandits, and design of experiments -- without human specification of which domains to explore. These mechanisms succeed by breaking the inner loop's deterministic search patterns, forcing exploration of directions the LLM's priors systematically avoid. The core principle is simple: if autoresearch can meta-autoresearch itself, it can, in principle, meta-autoresearch anything with a measurable objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bilevel Autoresearch框架，通过在元层面生成并注入新的搜索机制代码，使LLM能够自主优化自身的自动化研究循环。内层循环优化任务，外层循环优化内层的搜索方式，两者使用相同的LLM模型，无需更强的模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动研究系统（autoresearch）都需要人类来识别瓶颈并编写新代码改进系统。本文探索LLM是否能够自主完成这一过程，实现真正的自动化自我改进。
AI.method: 提出双层框架：Bilevel Autoresearch。外层循环通过生成Python代码在运行时注入新的搜索机制，元优化内层循环；内层循环优化具体任务。内外层使用相同的LLM。研究在Karpathy的GPT预训练基准上评估。
AI.result: 在GPT预训练基准上，元自动研究外层循环相比标准内层循环实现了5倍改进（val_bpb: -0.045 vs -0.009）。仅调整参数而不改变机制未能带来可靠收益。外层循环自主发现了来自组合优化、多臂老虎机和实验设计领域的机制。
AI.conclusion: 外层循环通过打破内层循环的确定性搜索模式，迫使LLM探索其先验系统性回避的方向而取得成功。核心原理是：如果自动研究能够元自动研究自身，理论上它可以元自动研究任何具有可测量目标的任务。

title: Bounding Box Anomaly Scoring for simple and efficient Out-of-Distribution detection
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection aims to identify inputs that differ from the training distribution in order to reduce unreliable predictions by deep neural networks. Among post-hoc feature-space approaches, OOD detection is commonly performed by approximating the in-distribution support in the representation space of a pretrained network. Existing methods often reflect a trade-off between compact parametric models, such as Mahalanobis-based scores, and more flexible but reference-based methods, such as k-nearest neighbors. Bounding-box abstraction provides an attractive intermediate perspective by representing in-distribution support through compact axis-aligned summaries of hidden activations. In this paper, we introduce Bounding Box Anomaly Scoring (BBAS), a post-hoc OOD detection method that leverages bounding-box abstraction. BBAS combines graded anomaly scores based on interval exceedances, monitoring variables adapted to convolutional layers, and decoupled clustering and box construction for richer and multi-layer representations. Experiments on image-classification benchmarks show that BBAS provides robust separation between in-distribution and out-of-distribution samples while preserving the simplicity, compactness, and updateability of the bounding-box approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Bounding Box Anomaly Scoring（BBAS），一种后处理（post-hoc）OOD 检测方法：用紧致轴对齐超矩形（bounding box）作为中间形式来近似特征空间的分布内（InD）支撑集，在 Box 内做类条件聚类并为每簇拟合一个盒；分数由区间越界（exceedance）给出——越界计数（AS-EC）与越界距离（AS-ED），并可用预测概率对类条件分数做后验期望式聚合（AggBBAS）。在 OpenOOD 上（ResNet-18/50、ViT-B/16、Swin-T）BBAS 在距离类方法中整体领先，CIFAR-10/100 上取得最佳或接近最佳 AUROC，同时保持盒表示的简洁、紧凑与可更新性。
AI.motivation: 深度网络对任何输入都会给出（往往高置信的）预测，OOD 检测用于识别偏离训练分布的输入以避免不可靠决策。后处理特征空间方法是主流路线，其核心设计选择是"如何近似分布内支撑集"：Mahalanobis 等紧致参数模型高效但假设强（类条件高斯、可比协方差），在深度特征空间易失真；kNN 极灵活但需保存参考特征集并维护索引，固定摘要与可扩展性差。已有的 bounding box abstraction（如 DeepInspect 式的运行期监控）介于两者之间：概念简单、紧凑、可更新，但存在三点局限：(i) 在高维特征空间聚类困难，限制了可监控变量数量；(ii) 只监控最后的全连接层；(iii) 只给出硬性的接受/拒绝判定，无法与其他 OOD 方法用 AUROC/FPR95 定量比较。本文的动机即是把这一"几何中间态"的盒抽象升级为可比较、可分级、可多层的 OOD 分数方法。
AI.method:
1) 监控变量 φ(x)：全连接层取中间层神经元 pre-activation；卷积层为适配平移不变性，构造三类逐通道空间摘要——激活比例 f（正值位置占比）、通道最小值 m、通道最大值 M；对 m、M 及倒数层特征 z 做 L2 归一化（ε=1e-12）后拼接。
2) 聚类与盒构建解耦：聚类用独立的低维表征 ψ(x)——全连接网络用 ReLU 激活模式（激活位向量）配 Hamming 距离；CNN 用各监控层的激活比例向量配 Manhattan 距离；聚类在类内进行，用层次聚类+完全连接（complete linkage），每类簇数取保留样本数平方根的整数部分；盒则在完整 φ 表征上按坐标 min/max 拟合，形成类条件接受域 R_k=∪_c B(c,φ)。
3) 异常分数：AS-EC 为越界变量计数（对预测类所有簇取最小），AS-ED 为越界距离（点到区间集的距离）；Agg 版本按网络后验 f_θ(x)_k 对各类条件分数加权求和，等价于 E_{k~p(k|x)}[AS(x,k)]，缓解高预测不确定度下单一类假设不可靠的问题。
4) 理论解释（附录）：ReLU 网络按激活模式划分为凸多面体激活区域，单个激活区域内盒的逆像是有限线性不等式给出的凸多面体；第一层权重满秩时逆像有界即多面体，全局上盒的逆像至多分解为 2^{n_b} 个多面体片段（n_b 为跨零坐标数）；聚类把抽象"局部化"到 ReLU 划分内，减少空体积，Hamming 距离为 1 的激活模式差异对应线性变换矩阵的秩一差异。
5) 实验：OpenOOD 协议，CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet-200/1K，ResNet-18/50 及 ViT-B/16、Swin-T；消融包括监控层数、盒特征、聚类特征、聚类算法与簇数；指标 AUROC 与 FPR95。
AI.result: 消融：监控最后 2 个卷积层+倒数层为最佳折中（更浅层提升 Far-OOD 但损害 Near-OOD，因浅层统计与语义无关）；组合使用全部统计量（激活比例/最小/最大/penultimate）最稳健；聚类特征影响较小（激活比例最稳定）；完全连接聚类对簇数敏感、k-means 在高维最差，单连接最稳定。CIFAR-10 Far-OOD：BBAS-ED AUROC 95.15 / FPR95 17.62（优于 KNN 92.96、VIM 93.48）；CIFAR-100 Far-OOD：AggBBAS-EC 88.65 / 41.42 优于 KNN 82.40、RMDS 82.92；ImageNet-200 Far-OOD：AggBBAS-ED 95.07 / 21.97 为最佳；ImageNet-1K Far-OOD：AggBBAS-EC 95.11、ED 95.13，接近 SCALE 96.53 而优于其他距离类方法。Near-OOD：CIFAR-10 上 AggBBAS-EC 90.74 与最佳相当，CIFAR-100 上 AggBBAS 79.96/80.26 领先距离类基线，ImageNet-200 上 AggBBAS-EC 83.58 / AggBBAS-ED 84.09 最好，但 ImageNet-1K Near-OOD 仍略低于 RMDS/SCALE。Transformer（ViT-B/16、Swin-T）上 AggBBAS 在 Near-OOD 明显领先（ViT 82.33、Swin 83.02 AUROC），Far-OOD 与 VIM 等强基线相当或稍优。总体结论：在距离类方法族中 BBAS（含聚合版本）最具竞争力，对协变量偏移尤为有效；参数少且不敏感，甚至无需使用 OpenOOD 提供的验证集调参。开销低：CIFAR-100 上建盒约 60s、聚类 14s、整集测试后处理 4.8s，其中单样本分数计算 0.8s。
AI.conclusion: BBAS 证明"用轴对齐盒抽象近似分布内支撑集"可以转化为一种简单、紧凑、可更新的后处理 OOD 检测器：把硬性的盒成员判定升级为基于区间越界的分级分数（计数与距离），引入适配卷积层的通道级统计监控变量，并把聚类表征与盒构建表征解耦，从而支持多层、丰富的特征表示。论文进一步给出盒抽象在输入空间的拓扑/几何解释（激活区域上的多面体分解、至多 2^{n_b} 片段、聚类与"空体积"的关系），说明聚类实质是把抽象局部化到 ReLU 划分内。局限与展望：当前实验集中于分类任务，Near-OOD 与大规模 ImageNet 上的相对优势不如 Far-OOD 明显（语义偏移共享低层统计，浅层约束信息量低）；超参影响小但仍需人工选择监控层与簇数；未来可探索监控变量自适应加权（按通道对预测的重要性加权）、更复杂聚类、把方法迁移到回归任务的 OOD 检测，以及与无监督异常检测、主动学习等框架结合。

title: Mecha-nudges for Machines
summary: Nudges are subtle changes to the way choices are presented to human decision-makers (e.g., opt-in vs. opt-out by default) that shift behavior without restricting options or changing incentives. As AI agents increasingly make decisions in the same environments as humans, the presentation of choices may be optimized for machines as well as people. We introduce mecha-nudges: changes to how choices are presented that systematically influence AI agents without degrading the decision environment for humans. To formalize mecha-nudges, we combine the Bayesian persuasion framework with V-usable information, a generalization of Shannon information that is observer-relative. This yields a common scale (bits of usable information) for comparing a wide range of interventions, contexts, and models. Applying our framework to product listings on Etsy -- a global marketplace for independent sellers -- we find that following ChatGPT's release, listings have significantly more machine-usable information about product selection, consistent with systematic mecha-nudging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了"mecha-nudges"（机械化助推/机器助推）：在AI智能体与人类共处的决策环境中，对信息呈现方式的细微改变会系统性影响智能体行为，同时不实质损害人类的决策环境。作者将贝叶斯说服（Bayesian persuasion）与观察者相对的 V-usable information 结合，在"比特（bits）"的统一尺度上量化此类干预，并以Etsy平台逾600万条商品listing为案例，发现ChatGPT发布后listing中关于智能体选品决策的机器可用信息显著上升（+0.143 bit，达最大可能增幅的40%以上），而人类可用信息几乎无变化，提供了现实中mecha-nudging正在大规模发生的第一份大规模证据。
AI.motivation: 背景：nudge（助推）数十年来只面向人类决策者，但越来越多的AI智能体在人类仍在其中的环境里自主决策（筛选简历、订旅行、封禁内容、挑选商品），其行为完全受环境本身的信息结构影响。与此同时，人类对AI普及的适应可能无意中或有意地改造环境，从而隐性引导智能体。已有文献缺乏：(1) 对"针对机器的选择呈现方式改变"的概念界定与可度量化；(2) 与 prompt injection 和传统 SEO 的清晰区分；(3) 大规模实证证据。此外，随着智能体成为决策者，会形成"部署反馈循环"——环境被为智能体而优化，静态基准评测无法捕捉这一循环，AI治理也需关注模型—环境接口而非仅模型本身。
AI.method: 概念与形式化：(1) 定义 mecha-nudge 为"改变选择的呈现方式、系统性影响AI智能体行为且不实质损害人类决策环境"的干预，且为结果导向（无论出于刻意优化、模仿他人还是偶然适应）；区别于 prompt injection（直接作用于模型、剥夺选项）与 SEO（操纵机器可读信号以影响人类）。(2) 将贝叶斯说服框架（Kamenica & Gentzkow, 2011，nudge即信号结构 π(·|Z)）与 Xu et al. (2020) / Ethayarajh et al. (2022) 的 V-usable information（预测 V-熵与点式 pvi，Shannon 信息的观察者相对推广）结合。(3) 受约束 mecha-nudging 设计：argmax_τ I_M(τ(X)→Y_M)，s.t. I_H(τ(X)→Y_H) ≥ I_H(X→Y_H) − ε；并给出"有界接收者贝叶斯说服"命题（Proposition 3.2）：当双方为对数计分效用、接收者限于预测族 M 时，最大化机器可用信息等价于最大化接收者的最优期望效用。(4) 定义 realized mecha-nudge：只需 I_M(τ*(X)→Z_M) > I_M(X→Z_M) 且人类侧约束满足，不必提高任一特定动作的边际概率。实证流程（Etsy，2025-11-12 Bright Data 抓取，共约106万 pre-ChatGPT + 500万 post-ChatGPT listing）：(i) 用 GPT-5-mini 对每条listing生成 select/pass 标签 Z_M（代理 ChatGPT 的策展决策），并做类别平衡子采样；(ii) 对每个时期用 LoRA 微调 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（8×H100，BF16，3 epochs）分别得到"内容模型" g'（看文本）与"零模型" g（只看空输入），在留出集上算 pvi；(iii) OLS 回归 pvi_i = α + β·after_i + ε_i，β 即机器可用信息变化，并做半年虚拟变量、控制变量、类别交互、稳健性检验；(iv) 人类侧用 Prolific 自陈式（self-elicitation）调查（689人、525有效、10106观测，IRB 豁免）估计人类可用信息；另设 DailyMed 药品标签与 LLM 改写文本两个安慰剂；用反事实词消融（Δpvi）做 token 级机制探索，用 PPML 回归以评论数代理销量评估经济影响。
AI.result: 核心结果：(1) ChatGPT 发布（2022-11-30）后 Etsy listing 的机器可用信息显著上升 0.143 bit（p<0.01），占最大可能增幅（1 − 0.645 = 0.355 bit）的 40% 以上；加全部 listing 级控制后仍为 0.117 bit（p<0.01），引入价格入提示词后为 0.103 bit。(2) 稳健性：不同 token 对（SELECT/PASS、YES/NO、BUY/SKIP、PICK/PASS）、四种提示（V1–V4）、三种标注模型（GPT-5-mini 0.143、Gemma-3-27B-IT 0.117、Qwen3-32B 0.122）、三种微调模型（Llama-3.1-8B 0.143、Qwen3-8B 0.096、Gemma-3-12B 0.166）均给出正且显著的点估计（多数落在 0.09–0.17）；5个随机种子的 pvi 与效应无显著差异（ANOVA p=0.853）；HC0–HC3 稳健标准误与经典 OLS 几乎相同；留一法剔除任一顶级类目后效应仍为正。(3) 时间动态：2023-H1 跳升 0.110（相对 Jul–Sep 2022），随后一年衰减，与"LLM 只能检索训练数据中的历史listing"的解释一致；2024年10月 ChatGPT Search（可原生浏览实时listing）发布后再度爬升，2025-H1 达峰值 0.120。(4) 安慰剂检验：对 pre 时期 listing 做 GPT-5-mini 改写仅带来 0.018 bit 提升（低一个数量级）；DailyMed 药品标签（模板化、监管文本）效应 0.003，与零不可区分，排除通用时间趋势；商业 AI 文本检测器 pangram-4 显示 post 期被标记为主要 AI 撰写的 listing <4%，且比率几乎不随 pvi 变化，故非"AI 代写"所致。(5) 类别异质性：买家对AI使用敏感的类目（艺术与收藏品 0.014、书籍影视音乐 −0.041）效应不显著，通用消费品（宠物用品 0.378、服饰 0.290、电子 0.248）高于平均。(6) 人类侧：Etsy 市场面 GMV/活跃买家 117–136 美元、复购买家占比 47–49%、逾90% 买家视商品描述重要，等间接指标稳定；直接调查显示 post 期listing的人类可用信息仅少 0.015 bit（95% CI [−0.044, 0.014]，p=0.309），不显著且远小于机器侧 +0.143，提示变化是"机器偏斜"的。(7) 经济影响（评论数为销量代理）：post 期每增加1 bit机器可用信息与评论数增加相关，agent 会 select 的 listing 中达 +81.9%（加卖家固定效应与上架时长后降至 +15.5%），pre 期则为 −25.2%（方向相反，符合"pre 期机器化友好往往不讨人类喜欢"）；整体 pooled 为 +2.4%。按宠物用品类目平均 +0.3775 bit 换算，评论数（及销量）约 +5.8%–30.9%，而艺术收藏类目不超过 +1.1%。(8) 机制线索：Δpvi 反事实消融显示 "scarce"（稀缺）、"prolific"、"snazzy" 等词使机器行为更可预测，"junk"、"unwanted" 使拒绝更可预测，而许多带正向情感的词（attracts、radiance、cheery 等）Δpvi 为负，即正向措辞反而增加歧义；pvi 分布方面 post 期相对 pre 期右移且三个标注模型之间趋同（类似优化压力的"同质化"），左尾长度不变（最低信息listing无优化压力）；listing 长度上升幅度小且与 pvi 相关性弱，排除"只是写得更长"。(9) 总体局限：观测数据无法识别因果，post/pre 分配非随机且可能有未观测时变因素，β 只能解读为条件均值差；不涉及卖家意图的确证（但意图非必要条件）。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次给出 mecha-nudge 的概念与可度量框架，证明 AI 智能体也可被"助推"，并首次提供其在真实世界中大规模悄然发生的证据：Etsy listing 在 ChatGPT 之后被优化为更易被智能体策展，而人类可用信息基本未受损，说明市场压力在短期内可协调人类与 AI 需求，但若智能体活动持续增长，人类体验可能被优先照顾而逐步"去赋权"。作者强调，AI 治理不能只关注模型在固定输入上的行为，还必须关注模型—环境接口以及环境在智能体决策发生后如何被重新塑造；mecha-nudge 提供了一个理解这种适应的分析单位。其监测出人意料地可行：只需一个可能发生 mecha-nudge 的对象（如商品 listing）、一个开源/闭源标注模型代理决策、一个可微调的开放权重模型来估计机器可用信息即可，且原则上可扩展到图像等多模态。后续方向包括：设计式最优干预以作防御性工具、防范恶意方向的助推、应对智能体对智能体的"agent-to-agent"助推作为规模化监督手段，以及在不确定的卖家意图下继续扩大对 mecha-nudge 的发现与度量。

title: Vision-based Deep Learning Analysis of Unordered Biomedical Tabular Datasets via Optimal Spatial Cartography
summary: Tabular data are central to biomedical research, from liquid biopsy and bulk and single-cell transcriptomics to electronic health records and phenotypic profiling. Unlike images or sequences, however, tabular datasets lack intrinsic spatial organization: features are treated as unordered dimensions, and their relationships must be inferred implicitly by the model. This limits the ability of vision architectures to exploit local structure and higher-order feature interactions in non-spatial biomedical data. Here we introduce Dynamic Feature Mapping (Dynomap), an end-to-end deep learning framework that learns a task-optimized spatial topology of features directly from data. Dynomap jointly optimizes feature placement and prediction through a fully differentiable rendering mechanism, without relying on heuristics, predefined groupings, or external priors. By transforming high-dimensional tabular vectors into learned feature maps, Dynomap enables vision-based models to operate effectively on unordered biomedical inputs. Across multiple clinical and biological datasets, Dynomap consistently outperformed classical machine learning, modern deep tabular models, and existing vector-to-image approaches. In liquid biopsy data, Dynomap organized clinically relevant gene signatures into coherent spatial patterns and improved multiclass cancer subtype prediction accuracy by up to 18%. In a Parkinson disease voice dataset, it clustered disease-associated acoustic descriptors and improved accuracy by up to 8%. Similar gains and interpretable feature organization were observed in additional biomedical datasets. These results establish Dynomap as a general strategy for bridging tabular and vision-based deep learning and for uncovering structured, clinically relevant patterns in high-dimensional biomedical data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Dynomap（Dynamic Feature Mapping）：一种端到端可微的“特征空间制图”框架，为每个表格特征学习一个二维连续坐标，并把每个样本渲染成高斯核叠加的图像（64×64），再用 CNN 分类。特征坐标、门控、渲染参数与预测目标联合优化，使无序表格数据获得任务自适应、可解释的空间拓扑。在 RARE-Seq cfRNA、GSE68086 血小板 RNA-seq、TCGA-BRCA、帕金森语音表型、Tabula Muris 单细胞 5 个数据集上全面优于 LR/XGBoost/RF/PCA+SVM/KNN/AdaBoost/MLP 及现代表格模型 TabM、ModernNCA、TabPFN：亚型分类最高提升约 18%，帕金森任务 macro-F1 提升约 7.6%~8%；Moran’s I 与 kNN purity 显著超出置换零分布，且归因（IG）热点在空间上成模块化分布（如 Cd3g、Cd79b、Col1a1、Krt5 等谱系标志基因），验证学到的“地图”具有生物学意义而非随机排布。
AI.motivation: 生物医学表格数据（cfRNA 液体活检、bulk/single-cell 转录组、EHR、表型/声学描述子）是研究主力，但与图像/序列不同，表格特征本质是无序维度，缺乏内在空间组织。这使 CNN、ViT 等依赖局部性、参数共享、层级聚合的视觉架构无法发挥归纳偏置：线性模型无法建模特征交互，树集成缺乏层级表征与可迁移嵌入，KNN/SVM 在样本空间比较而不组织特征关系，MLP/TabM/ModernNCA 学到的结构隐式不可解释，TabPFN 仍按无序向量处理；而 DeepInsight、IGTD、NCTD、REFINED 等固定“向量→图像”方法在训练前就锁定布局，无法随预测目标重组。生物医学数据还叠加技术噪声、生物学异质性与严重类别不平衡，使结构先验缺失下模式发现尤为困难。因此需要一个从数据本身、与任务联合学习、且显式可解释的特征空间组织方案。
AI.method:
**核心机制**（端到端可微渲染）：
1. **特征门控**：dense+sigmoid 生成 g=σ(W_g x+b_g)，得到 x̃ = x⊙g，实现任务相关的特征抑制/强调。
2. **可学习空间布局**：每个特征 i 分配可训练坐标 c_i∈R²（初始均匀采样于[-1,1]），通过三项正则防止退化：中心化项 L_center=‖mean(c)‖²₂、离散度项 L_spread=(std{c}-1)²、排斥项 L_repel=E[1/(‖c_i-c_j‖²+ε)]（ε=1e-4），总权重 0.01/0.01/0.05。
3. **可微渲染**：在 P×P 网格上 I(u,v)=Σ_i x̃_i·exp(-‖(u,v)-c_i‖²/(2σ_i²))，核宽随特征幅值自适应 σ_i=0.5+4.5·tanh(|x̃_i|)；渲染网格按坐标包围盒动态确定并加固定 padding，每张图做样本内标准化。
4. **联合优化**：总损失 L = 交叉熵（带 label smoothing）+ L_layout；坐标、门控、CNN、分类头由分类损失经渲染模块反向传播更新（Adam，lr=1e-3，batch=16，最多 1000 epoch）。
5. **布局稳定化**：监测坐标平均速度 v(t)=mean‖c(t)-c(t-1)‖，当 v 低于阈值（0.002）连续 15 个 epoch 即冻结坐标，并在冻结后进行模型选择以保证评估在固定空间构型下进行。
6. **分类器**：64×64 图像经 same-padding 2D 卷积 + ReLU + maxpool + global pooling，卷积特征与门控向量 x̃ 拼接后接 dropout(0.5)-dense(64)-ReLU-线性分类头。

**评估与可解释性**：
- 基线 11 个：Logistic Regression、XGBoost、Random Forest、AdaBoost、KNN、PCA+SVM、MLP、TabM、ModernNCA、TabPFN 等；5 折交叉验证，报 accuracy/macro-F1/macro-sensitivity/specificity 及 PR/ROC 曲线。
- 归因：Integrated Gradients（零向量基线，Riemann 近似，多类用预测类 logit），按类汇总归一化 |IG|，绘制类别特异差异条形图与热图。
- 空间统计：基于学习坐标构建 kNN 空间权重矩阵计算 Moran’s I（全局自相关）与 kNN purity（局部邻域一致性/家族一致性），与置换坐标/归因的零分布比较显著性。
- 稳定性：多次独立训练布局经 Procrustes 对齐后计算平均共识布局与成对距离矩阵。

**数据集**：RARE-Seq cfRNA（4,000 HVG 与 622 基因签名面板双设定；二分类/亚型/分期）、GSE68086 血小板 bulk RNA-seq（5,000 HVG；二分类+五分类）、TCGA-BRCA（4,000 HVG；侵袭性二分类 + PAM50 五分类）、帕金森持续发声语音（754 个工程声学特征，二分类）、Tabula Muris（54,865 细胞、55 细胞类型、1,089 HVG，多分类）。
AI.result:
**预测性能**（5 折 CV）：RARE-Seq 4,000 HVG 二分类 93.0% accuracy（macro-F1 92.0%、macro-sens 91.1%），优于 LR 90.3%、XGB 91.2%、RF 88.9%、TabM 92.9%、ModernNCA 90.7%；亚型分类 80.7%（macro-F1 79.3%），显著高于 LR 73.5%、XGB 74.6%、TabM 78.6%；622 基因面板下亚型分类反而升至 92.0%，提示亚型判别信号集中于策展标志物，而分期信号更分散（全转录组 79.6%）。GSE68086 二分类 94.4%（TabM/TabPFN 93.7%），五分类 59.28% accuracy、macro-F1 57.14%、macro-sens 55.97%。帕金森语音 93.7% accuracy、macro-F1 91.5%、macro-sens 96.7%、macro-spec 85.0%，macro-F1 最高提升 7.6%（8%）。TCGA-BRCA 侵袭性二分类 98.3%（XGB recall 略高 98.4%），PAM50 五分类 91.9%/macro-F1 91.0%（最强基线 TabM 89.6%）。Tabula Muris 97.6% accuracy、macro-F1 92.0%、macro-spec 100%，与 XGBoost（97.5%/93.2%）、TabM（97.8%/93.7%）接近且 macro-F1 更优。

**空间与可解释性**：所有数据集中 Moran’s I 与 kNN purity 均显著超过置换零分布（部分阶段/细胞类型呈异质性自相关）；IG 归因呈类别特异、空间局部的模块化热点——PRAD 的 NFATC3/RABEP2/BIRC3、LUAD 的 CRIPTO/CA9、PAAD 的 STAT3/NF1、晚期阶段的 BIRC3/CTLA4、乳腺癌侵袭性组 ARMT1/ARSG/ACADSB/MS4A2、帕金森 TQWT 能量与香农熵系数、单细胞中 Cd3g（T）、Cd79b/Cd74（B）、Col1a1/Col3a1（基质）、Krt5/Krt15（上皮）；Jaccard 相似度矩阵呈强对角优势，层次聚类把 LumA/LumB、相关免疫亚群聚在一起；跨任务与跨特征维度（4,000 HVG vs 622 面板）布局与归因层级系统性重排；帕金森布局经 Procrustes 对齐后跨折/跨独立训练高度一致。

**局限/待注意**：多模态下部分优势幅度收窄（如 Tabula Muris 宏平均 F1 略低于 TabM；TCGA 二分类 recall 低于 XGBoost）；作者自述代码胶囊中仍沿用“Graph2Image”命名，与 Dynomap 命名不一致，存在版本遗留；尚无跨数据集/跨机构的外部验证与真实临床前瞻性评估，布局稳定性仅在帕金森数据上做了重复训练验证。
AI.conclusion: 学习任务最优的特征空间拓扑可弥合“无序表格—视觉深度学习”之间的表征鸿沟：Dynamap 通过可微渲染把特征关系转化为可被 CNN 利用的空间邻接，同时保留特征身份并提供显式、可视化的解释界面，从而把卷积网络的局部性与参数共享偏置引入传统非空间生物医学数据。实验支持两点一致结论：(1) Dynomap 在维度、类别不平衡、生物学异质性与模态各异的条件下均取得强于经典 ML 与现代深度表格模型的宏平衡性能，且性能对特征筛选范围稳健；(2) 学到的布局呈统计上非随机、任务自适应的空间自组织——高归因特征自聚为连贯邻域，归因热点空间定位于不同区域，并与已知谱系标志物吻合。这不仅是精度提升，更是把“特征如何相互关联”从隐式网络权重变为显式可审计的二维地图，为生物医学表格数据分析提供了一条从预测到机制假设的通用路径。

title: Automated Microservice Pattern Instance Detection Using Infrastructure-as-Code Artifacts and Large Language Models
comment: ICSA 2025 - International Conference on Software Architecture. 6 pages
summary: Documenting software architecture is essential to preserve architecture knowledge, even though it is frequently costly. Architecture pattern instances, including microservice pattern instances, provide important structural software information. Practitioners should document this information to prevent knowledge vaporization. However, architecture patterns may not be detectable by analyzing source code artifacts, requiring the analysis of other types of artifacts. Moreover, many existing pattern detection instance approaches are complex to extend. This article presents our ongoing PhD research, early experiments, and a prototype for a tool we call MicroPAD for automating the detection of microservice pattern instances. The prototype uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to analyze Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) artifacts to aid detection, aiming to keep costs low and maximize the scope of detectable patterns. Early experiments ran the prototype thrice in 22 GitHub projects. We verified that 83\% of the patterns that the prototype identified were in the project. The costs of detecting the pattern instances were minimal. These results indicate that the approach is likely viable and, by lowering the entry barrier to automating pattern instance detection, could help democratize developer access to this category of architecture knowledge. Finally, we present our overall research methodology, planned future work, and an overview of MicroPAD's potential industrial impact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为MicroPAD的原型工具，利用大型语言模型(LLM)分析基础设施即代码(IaC)制品，自动检测微服务模式实例，旨在降低架构知识文档化的成本和门槛。初步实验在22个GitHub项目中验证了该方法的可行性（83%准确率），有望帮助开发者更便捷地获取架构知识。
AI.motivation: 软件架构知识的保存至关重要，但文档化成本高昂。架构模式实例包含重要的结构化软件信息，但现有模式检测方法难以通过源代码直接检测，且扩展性差。需要一种低成本、高扩展性的自动化检测方法。
AI.method: 使用大型语言模型(LLM)分析基础设施即代码(IaC)制品，实现微服务模式实例的自动检测。通过在22个GitHub项目上进行三次实验验证原型工具MicroPAD的有效性。
AI.result: 原型工具MicroPAD在22个GitHub项目中检测到83%的模式实例被验证存在，检测成本极低，证明了该方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM和IaC的微服务模式实例检测方法具有可行性。该方法降低了自动化模式实例检测的准入门槛，有望帮助开发者更便捷地获取架构知识类别，具有工业应用潜力。未来将进行更多研究工作以完善该工具。

title: Coordinate Encoding on Linear Grids for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: In solving partial differential equations (PDEs), machine learning utilizing physical laws has received considerable attention owing to advantages such as mesh-free solutions, unsupervised learning, and feasibility for solving high-dimensional problems. An effective approach is based on physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), which are based on deep neural networks known for their excellent performance in various academic and industrial applications. However, PINNs struggled with model training owing to significantly slow convergence because of a spectral bias problem. In this study, we propose a PINN-based method equipped with a coordinate-encoding layer on linear grid cells. The proposed method improves the training convergence speed by separating the local domains using grid cells. Moreover, it reduces the overall computational cost by using axis-independent linear grid cells. The method also achieves efficient and stable model training by adequately interpolating the encoded coordinates between grid points using natural cubic splines, which guarantees continuous derivative functions of the model computed for the loss functions. The results of numerical experiments demonstrate the effective performance and efficient training convergence speed of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 CELG（Coordinate Encoding on Linear Grid）的 PINN 改进方法：在各坐标轴上独立设置一维线性网格，用自然三次样条（natural cubic spline）插值网格点处的可训练特征向量，再经 Hadamard 乘积融合并输入 MLP，从而在缓解谱偏置、提升训练收敛速度的同时，将空间与时间复杂度从指数级降为线性级（O(M·D·R)），在 2–5 维 Helmholtz 等基准问题上优于 PIXEL、H-Spline、Vanilla PINN 与 CP-PINN。
AI.motivation: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）因网格无关、无需标签数据、可处理高维问题而被广泛用于求解偏微分方程，但其直接把坐标输入 MLP 的结构存在严重的谱偏置（spectral bias）：训练优先拟合低频成分而难以捕捉高频成分，导致收敛极慢、落入局部极小、训练不稳定，最终预测精度差。为缓解谱偏置，计算机视觉领域发展出基于网格单元（grid cell）的坐标编码方法，但这类方法（PIXEL、H-Spline 等）直接在高维空间中布置网格点，导致空间与时间复杂度随维度指数增长（O(M·R^D)、O(S^D·R^D)），高维 PDE 无法承受；同时其插值核（线性、余弦、Hermite）在网格边界处高阶导数不连续，使 PDE 损失中的导数梯度出现跳变、消失或爆炸，损害训练稳定性与精度。此外，网格划分过细也会反而降低训练效率。因此需要一种既能保证导数光滑、训练稳定，又能随维度线性扩展的坐标编码方案。
AI.method:
1) 坐标编码层：沿每一坐标轴独立设置 R 个网格点（轴无关的线性网格），每点配置 M 维可训练特征向量 g_{dr}（参数总数 O(M·D·R)）。非网格点处的特征由自然三次样条插值得到，样条系数通过三对角矩阵算法求解（O(R)），并保证 C² 连续，从而保证损失函数所需的一阶/二阶导数连续可微，梯度可跨网格边界平滑传播（对更高阶 PDE 可换用更高阶自然样条）。
2) 特征融合与前向传播：各轴插值特征 z_{nd} 通过 Hadamard 乘积 φ_n = ∏_d z_{nd} 融合（乘法交互比线性叠加/张量分解更有表达力），再送入以 tanh 为激活函数的高阶可微 MLP 输出 u_θ；亦给出将 MLP 替换为 CP 张量分解的变体 CELG-CP，用于对比。
3) 训练：以 PDE 残差、初值、边界条件三部分加权损失（l_total = λ_pde·l_pde + λ_init·l_init + λ_bc·l_bc），用自动微分求导、Adam 反向传播优化全部参数（包括网格特征向量）。
4) 复杂度分析：CELG 空间 O(M·D·R)、时间 O(M·D·R)，而 PIXEL 为 O(M·R^D)/O(M·2^D)，H-Spline 为 O(S^D·R^D)/O(S^D·2^D)。
5) 实验：与 Vanilla PINN、CP-PINN、PIXEL、H-Spline 在 1D/2D 多频 Poisson、Burgers、Allen–Cahn、Flow-Mixing、Helmholtz（2D–5D）上比较插值方式、训练效率、参数量、单迭代耗时与相对误差。
AI.result:
1) 插值对比（1D Poisson）：线性插值仅 C¹、二阶导恒为零；余弦核一阶导光滑但二阶导在网格边界不连续（即使加多网格 Cos+MG 也收敛最慢）；Hermite 核支撑窄、仅与相邻单元共享信息，传播受限、收敛慢；自然三次样条（C² 连续）能同时正确预测 u(x) 及其一、二阶导数，学习曲线最快最稳，为最优插值方式。
2) 收敛行为：网格类方法（CELG/PIXEL/CELG-CP）先捕获高频、再逐步拟合低频，训练全程稳定；Vanilla/CP-PINN 先拟合低频，中期出现“塌陷”，需数万 epoch 才抓住高频，说明张量分解并不能消除谱偏置。
3) 参数量：CELG 远小于 PIXEL（如 2D R=32：PIXEL 4.6M vs CELG 12.6k；5D R=32：PIXEL 5.0×10^9、H-Spline 8.2×10^9 vs CELG 3.7k），随维度仅线性增长。
4) 训练耗时：3D 场景 CELG 显著快于 PIXEL/H-Spline（Flow-Mixing：12–13 ms vs 28–35 ms）；CELG-CP 在多数情形快于 CP-PINN；5D 时 PIXEL、H-Spline 全部 OOM，而 CELG/CELG-CP 可正常训练。
5) 精度：除 Burgers 外，CELG/CELG-CP 在全部基准上相对误差最低（如 Helmholtz 3D R=16：CELG-CP 0.01、CELG 0.05，Vanilla 1.08、CP-PINN 0.07）；高维 Helmholtz 各维度 CELG 系方法误差最低（5D R=32：CELG 1.06、CELG-CP 1.00，对比 CP-PINN 27.2）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的 CELG（轴独立线性网格 + 自然三次样条坐标编码 + Hadamard 融合 + MLP）方法能有效缓解谱偏置：网格划分使模型优先学习高频成分，配合 C² 连续的样条插值保证 PDE 损失所需导数的连续性，从而实现稳定、快速、收敛更好的训练；同时以线性空间/时间复杂度取代现有网格方法（PIXEL、H-Spline）的指数复杂度，显著压缩参数量与计算开销，使高维（最高 5 维）PINN 求解成为可行，并在基准与高维问题上取得最低相对误差，优于 Vanilla PINN、CP-PINN、PIXEL 与 H-Spline。作者亦指出三点局限与未来工作：将方法推广到非矩形网格单元（需高效插值）、高效配点选择策略、以及消除网格点附近因不连续导致的精度退化（如 Burgers 问题）。

title: Non-Adversarial Imitation Learning Provably Free of Compounding Errors: The Role of Bellman Constraints
summary: Adversarial imitation learning (AIL) achieves high-quality imitation by mitigating compounding errors in behavioral cloning (BC), but often exhibits training instability due to adversarial optimization. To avoid this issue, a class of non-adversarial Q-based imitation learning (IL) methods, represented by IQ-Learn, has emerged and is widely believed to outperform BC by leveraging online environment interactions. However, this paper revisits IQ-Learn and demonstrates that it provably reduces to BC and suffers from an imitation gap lower bound with quadratic dependence on horizon, therefore still suffering from compounding errors. Theoretical analysis reveals that, despite using online interactions, IQ-Learn uniformly suppresses the Q-values for all actions on states uncovered by demonstrations, thereby failing to generalize. To address this limitation, we introduce a primal-dual framework for distribution matching, yielding a new Q-based IL method, Dual Q-DM. The key mechanism in Dual Q-DM is incorporating Bellman constraints to propagate high Q-values from visited states to unvisited ones, thereby achieving generalization beyond demonstrations. We prove that Dual Q-DM is equivalent to AIL and can recover expert actions beyond demonstrations, thereby mitigating compounding errors. To the best of our knowledge, Dual Q-DM is the first non-adversarial IL method that is theoretically guaranteed to eliminate compounding errors. Experimental results further corroborate our theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了IQ-Learn方法等价于行为克隆(BC)，仍存在二次依赖于horizon的imitation gap下界，因此无法解决compounding errors问题。为解决此问题，提出了Dual Q-DM方法，首次在非对抗性IL方法中实现了对compounding errors的理论保证消除。
AI.motivation: Adversarial Imitation Learning (AIL) 虽然能通过对抗优化缓解行为克隆(BC)的compounding errors问题，但存在训练不稳定的缺陷。非对抗的Q-based方法（如IQ-Learn）虽避免了对抗优化，但本文理论分析发现其仍存在二次依赖horizon的imitation gap下界，说明compounding errors问题未被真正解决。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：证明IQ-Learn等价于BC，揭示其对demonstration未覆盖状态统一抑制Q值的本质缺陷；2. 提出Dual Q-DM：引入原始-对偶框架进行分布匹配，结合Bellman约束将高Q值从访问状态传播到未访问状态，实现对demonstration之外状态的有效泛化。
AI.result: 1. 理论证明：IQ-Learn等价于BC，存在二次依赖于horizon的imitation gap；2. 理论证明：Dual Q-DM等价于AIL，能够恢复demonstration之外的最优专家动作，从而消除compounding errors；3. 实验验证了理论分析的正确性。
AI.conclusion: Dual Q-DM是首个在理论上保证消除compounding errors的非对抗性IL方法，为稳定高效的IL提供了新范式。

title: Double Coupling Architecture and Training Method for Optimization Problems of Differential Algebraic Equations with Parameters
summary: Simulation and modeling are essential in product development, integrated into the design and manufacturing process to enhance efficiency and quality. They are typically represented as complex nonlinear differential algebraic equations. The growing diversity of product requirements demands multi-task optimization, a key challenge in simulation modeling research. A dual physics-informed neural network architecture has been proposed to decouple constraints and objective functions in parametric differential algebraic equation optimization problems. Theoretical analysis shows that introducing a relaxation variable with a global error bound ensures solution equivalence between the network and optimization problem. A genetic algorithm-enhanced training framework for physics-informed neural networks improves training precision and efficiency, avoiding redundant solving of differential algebraic equations. This approach enables generalization for multi-task objectives with a single, training maintaining real-time responsiveness to product requirements.

AI.tldr: 针对"约束固定、目标函数多变"的参数化微分代数方程(DAE)多任务优化难题，本文提出双物理信息神经网络(Dual-PINN)架构：离线训练并冻结一个约束网络去学习参数化 DAE 的解映射 (t,p)→x，在线只需训练一个轻量目标网络从随机种子生成参数并最小化目标值；配合基于全局误差界的松弛变量给出解等价性保证，以及遗传算法(GA)驱动的自适应采样训练与牛顿迭代/随机游走局部校正。实验表明该方法在 E. coli 生化反应参数辨识与高维线性 DAE 优化上达到与全局确定性方法相当甚至更优的精度，同时在线求解时间由 52 s / 数千秒降至约 1 s / 数秒量级，并支持单一训练、多目标复用。
AI.motivation: 产品研发中的仿真与建模通常抽象为含微分与代数耦合的复杂非线性微分代数方程(DAE)，且随着产品需求多样化，需要在约束固定而目标函数动态变化的多任务场景下反复求解优化问题。现有路线均存在明显瓶颈：变分法、直接转写与有限差分类方法依赖一阶最优性条件、单目标求解、需反复转写与求解；分支定界与区间分析等确定性全局法复杂度随维数与非线性急剧增长；模拟退火、粒子群、蚁群等随机法无收敛保证且计算量大；Neural ODE 受限于 ODE 且时间积分误差累积；PINN/DAE-PINN 多采用软惩罚形式，在强代数耦合系统中会产生约束违反与分支误判；hPINN、DAE-HardNet 等硬约束方法虽更可行，但现有 PINN 优化工作多针对 PDE 约束优化，缺乏对参数化 DAE 系统尤其是多任务场景的系统处理。此外参数变化易导致 DAE 雅可比矩阵奇异而"退化"，求解器给出的训练数据失真、物理约束信息丢失，而既有方法缺乏有效的退化检测与正则化机制。核心需求因此是：一次求解约束、可靠逼近、可量化误差、可实时在线优化的多任务框架。
AI.method: 框架由"离线约束网络 + 在线目标网络"解耦构成。(1) 约束网络 NN_cnstr(t,p;θ_c) 为 5–7 隐层、每层 128 神经元的全连接网络，离线在 [t0,tf]×[p_L,p_U] 上逼近参数化 DAE 解映射，损失由初值数据 N_I、配点残差 N_F(自动微分)与高精度 DAE 求解器生成的精确解 N_B 加权组成，训练后冻结，供所有后续任务复用；训练前先做基于嵌入(embedding)的结构分析(Yang et al., 2024)，将雅可比秩亏的退化系统嵌入为非退化等价系统 G 以保解集并降低微分指数，据此检测并正则化参数退化、甄别正确解分支。(2) 训练策略：遗传算法自适应采样——按预测误差 e_i 概率选择误差超过阈值 α 的参数样本，经交叉变异 p_new = βp_p1+(1−β)p_p2+ε 并投影回参数盒，调用高精度求解器生成新精确解加入 N_B 并重训网络，迭代至最大误差低于 α；达到误差阈值后再做局部校正(牛顿迭代或随机游走)。(3) 目标网络 NN_obj(z;θ_o) 将随机种子 z~U[-1,1]^d 经 tanh 缩放映射为可行参数 p=(1/2)[tanh(Wz+b)⊙(p_U−p_L)+(p_U+p_L)]，用冻结的约束网络评估近似轨迹 x̂ = NN_cnstr + γ⊙ξ，ξ~U[-1,1]^n，再经自动微分与数值积分计算 Ĵ(p)，在线损失简化为 L(θ_o)=Ĵ(NN_obj(z;θ_o))，因此更换目标函数无需重训约束部分。(4) 理论保证：经结构分析后 DAE 化为显式 ODE，局部线性化 x'=A(t)x+b(t)、A(t)=A0+R(t)，在 A0 可对角化且特征值互异假设下给出全局误差界 ‖Δx‖∞≤‖P‖∞·δ_max/(a1+n r_max)·(e^{(a1+n r_max)t}−1)，据此构造松弛向量 γ=max{|E(ζ)−3D(ζ)|, |E(ζ)+3D(ζ)|}，形成带松弛区间约束的代理优化问题，使代理解集与原 DAE 优化问题解集等价(Theorem 4.1 进一步给出含最大样本间距 ℏ 的离散化误差界)。
AI.result: 示例 4.1(非线性 ODE)：GA 训练(α=1e-3、初始 50 样本、每代新增 1000 精确解、12 代)后损失与最大误差稳定下降并达标；目标网络用 100 个随机种子 6 次迭代收敛至 p≈−0.5706、J≈−0.0606865，经 10 次牛顿迭代得 p*=−0.570610626948189、J_min=−0.060686510583486，与全局最优一致至 12 位有效数字；相比 New OB 松弛法(23 次迭代)与 SBM 松弛法(33 次迭代)迭代次数最少(表 1)。E. coli 钾摄取生化反应系统：约束网络离线 GA 训练后除 (k1=0.01, k3=10) 附近小区域误差偏高外全域精度良好；在线训练加预测仅 0.945 s，300 步随机游走(步长为参数域 10%)校正后得 (k1,k3)=(4.32191e-3, 163.2459)、目标 0.029089，略优于 ε-global 方法的 0.029096(参数 4.31348e-3, 162.9297)，显著优于 Kremling 等局部解的 0.0712；总在线时间约 1 s，而分支定界需 52 s(表 2)。高维线性 DAE 扩展性(n=2~10)：离线训练成本由 96.1 s 增至 53472.4 s，但在线预测成本近似线性(0.6→4.8 s)、校正仅 0.003~0.013 s；分支定界成本指数增长(1.4→6083.5 s，n>6 不可行)；预测误差量级 1e-7、J(p) 预测偏差 6.5e-8~2.92e-7，且各维预测参数与最优参数几乎一致(表 3)。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明，双 PINN 解耦架构通过"一次离线学习约束、多次在线优化目标"有效消除了重复 DAE 求解，可在约束固定而目标变化的多任务场景下实现单次训练、多任务复用，保持对产品需求的实时响应能力；GA 驱动的自适应采样与局部校正使约束网络在全参数域达到 1e-3 量级精度；松弛变量与全局误差界为代理优化问题与原问题的解等价性提供了理论保证；嵌入式结构分析能检测并正则化参数退化，保全物理约束信息。综合来看，该框架兼具可行性、精度与可扩展性，在高维问题上相对分支定界有 1~2 个数量级的效率优势。仍需注意的局限包括：离线训练成本随维数急剧上升(如 n=10 时约 15 小时)，实时性主要依赖在线阶段；误差界的适用性依赖 A0 可对角化、特征值互异等强假设与保守估计，γ 的紧性未充分验证；GA 采样的收敛性与样本代表性依赖阈值 α 与种群设置，缺乏理论保证；多任务泛化能力仅在少量算例上验证，跨任务零样本泛化与不确定性量化仍不充分；且与强硬约束 PINN 及现代全局优化器的系统对比尚不完整。

title: Spiking Personalized Federated Learning for Brain-Computer Interface-Enabled Immersive Communication
summary: This work proposes a novel immersive communication framework that leverages brain-computer interface (BCI) to acquire brain signals for inferring user-centric states (e.g., intention and perception-related discomfort), thereby enabling more personalized and robust immersive adaptation under strong individual variability. Specifically, we develop a personalized federated learning (PFL) model to analyze and process the collected brain signals, which not only accommodates neurodiverse brain-signal data but also prevents the leakage of sensitive brain-signal information. To address the energy bottleneck of continual on-device learning and inference on energy-limited immersive terminals (e.g., head-mounted display), we further embed spiking neural networks (SNNs) into the PFL. By exploiting sparse, event-driven spike computation, the SNN-enabled PFL reduces the computation and energy cost of training and inference while maintaining competitive personalization performance. Experiments on real brain-signal dataset demonstrate that our method achieves the best overall identification accuracy while reducing inference energy by 6.46$\times$ compared with conventional artificial neural network-based personalized baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向6G沉浸式通信的脑机接口（BCI）框架：在集成EEG采集的头显设备上，用脉冲神经网络（SNN）嵌入个性化联邦学习（PFL）来识别用户意图与晕动不适等内部状态，既适配"神经多样性"造成的非独立同分布脑信号、避免原始脑信号上传泄露隐私，又借稀疏事件驱动计算把推理能耗降低6.46倍，在真实EEG数据集上取得最高识别准确率87.53%（较ANN个性化基线81.90%高5.63%）。
AI.motivation: 6G沉浸式通信（XR/VR、全息远程临场、多人协同）依赖HMD/可穿戴/IoT等异构设备的多模态协同感知，但外部环境与运动传感（IMU、相机）无法刻画用户内部感知—生理状态（如晕动症/sensory conflict引发的不适、意图、负荷、注意力），且异构模态增加服务端对齐融合负担与终端能耗。BCI（非侵入EEG）可提供神经层面的用户状态观测，但脑信号隐私敏感、个体差异极大（neurodiversity，跨用户、跨通道、跨时段非平稳），且AR/VR头显电池与热预算受限，难以支撑深度网络的持续本地训练与推理。因此需要隐私保护、个性化、且能效高的边缘学习方案。传统手工EEG流水线（滤波、时频特征、SVM）依赖启发式先验且需逐被试校准，而密集ANN的持续学习开销过大。
AI.method: 系统架构：K个BCI-HMD用户终端 + 无线边缘服务器（WES），终端本地采集EEG、用SNN做推理与持续个性化训练，WES协调PFL。1) 个性化联邦学习（基于pFedMe）：每用户维护个性化模型w_k，同时学习共享全局参考模型w；全局目标min_{w,{w_k}} Σ_k p_k (F_k(w_k) + (μ/2)||w_k−w||²)，本地用近端梯度更新（E=2步SGD，μ=1e-5），WES按数据量加权聚合。2) SNN骨干：LIF神经元膜电位递推U_j(t+1)=(1−λ)U_j(t)+λΣW_{i,j}I_i(t)，超阈发放脉冲并重置；训练用BPTT + 反正切型代理梯度（surrogate gradient, η=2）近似不可导脉冲函数，前向仍用LIF动态；SNN时间步T=6、λ=0.5。3) 理论分析：定理1证明基于代理梯度的SNN-PFL等价于对隐式可微代理目标做随机近端梯度，在L-光滑与有界方差梯度假设下收敛到代理包络（Moreau envelope）的稳定点；命题1证明稀疏放电（sparsity ρ）使梯度范数界G(ρ)≤C√ρ，从而梯度差异度Δ(w)≤4G(ρ)²≤4C²ρ，缓解用户漂移；稀疏放电还直接减少有效突触事件以降低能耗。4) 实验：在公开EEG数据集（109名被试，选1、3、7号作联邦客户端，4类运动想象意图识别）中与PFLANN、FLSNN、FLANN对比，统一CNN架构与超参（lr=0.01、batch=64、E=2），基于突触操作与放电率评估推理能耗；各LIF层放电率为0.106/0.063/0.058/0.253，平均约0.12。
AI.result: 识别准确率：PFLSNN在第50轮达87.53%，全程领先；PFLANN收敛至81.90%，FLSNN 68.78%，FLANN 62.12%。消融分析：FL→PFL带来显著增益（PFLSNN较FLSNN +18.75%，PFLANN较FLANN +19.78%），SNN较ANN亦提升（PFLSNN较PFLANN +5.63%，FLSNN较FLANN +6.66%），说明个性化与脉冲骨干各自有效。能耗：同架构下PFLSNN推理能耗较PFLANN降低约6.46倍，验证稀疏事件驱动计算在能耗受限终端上的可行性。
AI.conclusion: BCI + SNN驱动的个性化联邦学习构成了一种隐私保护、个性化、能效友好的沉浸式通信方案：BCI补充外部传感无法提供的用户内部状态观测，SNN稀疏性同时缓解神经多样性导致的用户漂移并大幅降低端侧计算/能耗开销，理论（收敛性与稀疏性诱导的漂移上界）与真实EEG实验（87.53%准确率、6.46倍能耗降低）均支持其用于长期"always-on"沉浸式系统的价值。局限与展望：仅在3名被试、单一公开数据集上验证，实验规模较小；能耗为基于突触操作与放电率的模型化估计而非真实硬件测量；SNN时间步、代理梯度与近端参数超参敏感，通信开销（上行模型更新）未纳入能耗评估；感知不适等更丰富状态的识别任务有待扩展。

title: Multitask-Informed Prior for In-Context Learning on Tabular Data: Application to Steel Property Prediction
summary: Accurate prediction of mechanical properties of steel during hot rolling processes, such as Thin Slab Direct Rolling (TSDR), remains challenging due to complex interactions among chemical compositions, processing parameters, and resultant microstructures. Traditional empirical and experimental methodologies, while effective, are often resource-intensive and lack adaptability to varied production conditions. Moreover, most existing approaches do not explicitly leverage the strong correlations among key mechanical properties, missing an opportunity to improve predictive accuracy through multitask learning. To address this, we present a multitask learning framework that injects multitask awareness into the prior of TabPFN--a transformer-based foundation model for in-context learning on tabular data--through novel fine-tuning strategies.
